local Module = {
    Name = "MM2 Blurt Roles",
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
    Runtime = nil :: any,
}

local activeCleanup: () -> () = function(): () end

function Module.init(runtime: any): any
    if Module.Initialized then
        return Module
    end
    local core: any = state.mm2Core
    assert(type(core) == "table", "MM2 Blurt Roles requires the MM2 core module")
    Module.Runtime = runtime
    local findMurderer: any = core.findMurderer
    local findSheriff: any = core.findSheriff
    local hasActiveRoundRoles: any = core.hasActiveRoundRoles
    local mm2Settings: any = core.mm2Settings

    local blurtEnabled: boolean = false
    local blurtSignature: string = ""
    local blurtPending: boolean = false
    local blurtGeneration: number = 0
    local lastBlurtAt: number = -math.huge

    local function cancelPendingBlurt(): ()
        blurtGeneration += 1
        blurtPending = false
    end

    local function sendPublicChat(message: string): boolean
        local sent: boolean = false

        local textChatOk: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
            local textChatService: TextChatService =
                game:GetService("TextChatService")
            if textChatService.ChatVersion ~= Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
                return
            end
            local channels: Instance? = textChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
            local channel: Instance? = channels
                and (channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
                    or channels:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextChannel"))
            if channel and channel:IsA("TextChannel") then
                (channel :: TextChannel):SendAsync(message)
                sent = true
            end
        end)

        if sent then
            return true
        end

        local legacyOk: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
            local events: Instance? = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                :FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
            local say: Instance? = events
                and events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if say and say:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                (say :: RemoteEvent):FireServer(message, "All")
                sent = true
            end
        end)

        return sent and (textChatOk or legacyOk)
    end

    local function buildBlurtMessage(): (string?, string?)
        if not hasActiveRoundRoles() then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local murderer: Player? = findMurderer()
        local sheriff: Player? = findSheriff()
        if not murderer and not sheriff then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local murdererName: string = murderer and murderer.Name or "?"
        local sheriffName: string = sheriff and sheriff.Name or "?"
        local message: string
        local signature: string
        if mm2Settings.blurtFake then

            message = string.format(
                'Murder; "%s" Sheriff; "%s"',
                sheriffName,
                murdererName
            )
            signature = "fake/" .. sheriffName .. "/" .. murdererName
        else
            message = string.format(
                'Murder; "%s" Sheriff; "%s" | Wurst',
                murdererName,
                sheriffName
            )
            signature = murdererName .. "/" .. sheriffName
        end
        return message, signature
    end

    local function blurtRoles(manual: boolean): ()
        local message: string?, signature: string? = buildBlurtMessage()
        if not message then
            if manual then
                notify("MM2 · no roles to blurt yet.")
            end
            return
        end
        if not manual then
            if signature == blurtSignature and not mm2Settings.blurtRepeat then
                return
            end
            if os.clock() - lastBlurtAt < 2.5 then
                return
            end
        end
        blurtSignature = signature :: string
        lastBlurtAt = os.clock()
        task.spawn(function(): ()
            if sendPublicChat(message :: string) then
                notify("MM2 · blurted: " .. (message :: string))
            else
                notify("MM2 · the chat refused the message (filtered or disabled).")
            end
        end)
    end

    local function scheduleBlurt(): ()
        if not blurtEnabled or blurtPending then
            return
        end
        local message: string?, signature: string? = buildBlurtMessage()
        if not message then
            return
        end
        if signature == blurtSignature and not mm2Settings.blurtRepeat then
            return
        end
        blurtPending = true
        local generation: number = blurtGeneration
        task.delay(math.max(mm2Settings.blurtDelay, 0), function(): ()
            if generation ~= blurtGeneration then return end
            blurtPending = false
            if blurtEnabled then blurtRoles(false) end
        end)
    end

    local unsubscribe: () -> () = core.onRoundRoles(function(active: boolean): ()
        if not active then
            cancelPendingBlurt()
            blurtSignature = ""
            return
        end
        scheduleBlurt()
    end)

    local function toggleBlurtRoles(enabled: boolean): ()
        blurtEnabled = enabled
        cancelPendingBlurt()
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2BlurtRoles")
        if not enabled then
            return
        end
        blurtSignature = ""
        local elapsed: number = 0
        featureConnections.MM2BlurtRoles = TaskManager:Connect(function(deltaTime: number): ()
            elapsed += deltaTime
            if elapsed < 1 then
                return
            end
            elapsed = 0
            if not hasActiveRoundRoles() then
                blurtSignature = ""
                return
            end
            scheduleBlurt()
        end, nil, "MM2 Blurt Roles")
    end

    -- v191: the card itself is the button. It used to be a toggle with a
    -- separate "Blurt now" row, which meant two clicks (and a wait for the
    -- delay) to say the roles once. Clicking the card now blurts IMMEDIATELY,
    -- and the automatic path moved into the "Auto blurt" option, where the
    -- Delay/Repeat rows still belong.
    local BlurtFeature = createUniversalFeature(
        "Blurt Roles",
        "Types the murderer and sheriff in the public chat. Click the card to blurt right now.",
        3,
        function(): ()
            blurtRoles(true)
        end,
        {
            categoryName = "World",
            parent = MM2Scroll,
            registry = mm2Features,
            kind = "action",
        }
    )
    addToggleOption(
        BlurtFeature,
        "Auto blurt",
        false,
        function(value: boolean): ()
            toggleBlurtRoles(value)
        end,
        "Blurt automatically once per round, after the Delay below. Off by default: the card alone is an instant, one-shot blurt."
    )
    addNumberOption(
        BlurtFeature,
        "Delay",
        mm2Settings.blurtDelay,
        0,
        15,
        function(value: number): ()
            mm2Settings.blurtDelay = value
        end,
        "Seconds to wait after the roles are known before typing.",
        0.5
    )
    addToggleOption(
        BlurtFeature,
        "Repeat on change",
        mm2Settings.blurtRepeat,
        function(value: boolean): ()
            mm2Settings.blurtRepeat = value
        end,
        "Blurt again when the sheriff dies and the gun changes hands."
    )
    addToggleOption(
        BlurtFeature,
        "Fake Blurt Roles",
        mm2Settings.blurtFake,
        function(value: boolean): ()
            mm2Settings.blurtFake = value
        end,
        "Announces the roles SWAPPED (and without the Wurst tag) so the chat "
            .. "lies about who the murderer and sheriff are."
    )
    addInformationOption(
        BlurtFeature,
        "This types in the real public chat: everyone reads it and you will be"
            .. " reported. Roblox also rate-limits and filters messages."
    )

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        pcall(unsubscribe)
        toggleBlurtRoles(false)
    end
    Module.Events = featureConnections
    Module.Initialized = true
    return Module
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if not Module.Initialized then
        return
    end
    Module.Initialized = false
    activeCleanup()
    activeCleanup = function(): () end
    Module.Events = {}
    Module.Runtime = nil
end

return Module

local Module = {
    Name = "MM2 Sprint",
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
    Runtime = nil :: any,
}

local activeCleanup: () -> () = function(): () end

function Module.init(runtime: any): any
    if Module.Initialized then
        return Module
    end
    local core: any = state.mm2Core
    assert(type(core) == "table", "MM2 Sprint requires the MM2 core module")
    Module.Runtime = runtime

    local sprintTrailObjects: {Instance} = {}


    local function clearSprintTrail(): ()
        for _, object: Instance in ipairs(sprintTrailObjects) do
            if object.Parent then
                object:Destroy()
            end
        end
        table.clear(sprintTrailObjects)
    end

    local function ensureSprintTrail(root: BasePart): Trail
        local existing: Instance? = root:FindFirstChild("Wurst_SprintTail")
        if existing and existing:IsA("Trail") then
            return existing
        end

        clearSprintTrail()
        local left: Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
        left.Name = "Wurst_SprintLeft"
        left.Position = Vector3.new(-0.8, -0.5, 0.75)
        left.Parent = root

        local right: Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
        right.Name = "Wurst_SprintRight"
        right.Position = Vector3.new(0.8, -0.5, 0.75)
        right.Parent = root

        local trail: Trail = Instance.new("Trail")
        trail.Name = "Wurst_SprintTail"
        trail.Attachment0 = left
        trail.Attachment1 = right
        trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 55),
            Color3.fromRGB(175, 115, 20)
        )
        trail.Lifetime = 0.38
        trail.LightEmission = 0.25
        trail.FaceCamera = true
        trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        })
        trail.Enabled = false
        trail.Parent = root
        sprintTrailObjects = {trail, left, right}
        return trail
    end

    local speed: any = state.framework and (state.framework:GetModule("Speed Settings") or state.framework:GetModule("Speed Hack"))
    assert(speed, "Sprint option requires the Speed module")
    speed.ClearSprint = clearSprintTrail
    speed.SprintFrame = function(active: boolean, root: BasePart): ()
        if not active then clearSprintTrail(); return end
        local _, humanoid: Humanoid? = getCharacterParts()
        ensureSprintTrail(root).Enabled = humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
    end
    local function releaseSprint(): ()
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2SprintHold")
        speed.SetSprintHeld(false)
        clearSprintTrail()
    end
    speed:CreateButton({
        Name = "Sprint", Hold = true,
        Function = function(): ()
            speed.SetSprintHeld(true)
            if not featureConnections.MM2SprintHold then
                featureConnections.MM2SprintHold = TaskManager:Connect(speed.StepSprint, nil, "MM2 Sprint")
            end
        end,
        OnRelease = releaseSprint,
        Tooltip = "Hold this button, its assigned key or the touch action to sprint. Works with Speed OFF; release restores normal Speed or your original speed. No toggle state is saved.",
    })
    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        releaseSprint()
        speed.ClearSprint = nil
        speed.SprintFrame = nil
    end
    Module.Events = featureConnections
    Module.Initialized = true
    return Module
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if not Module.Initialized then
        return
    end
    Module.Initialized = false
    activeCleanup()
    activeCleanup = function(): () end
    Module.Events = {}
    Module.Runtime = nil
end

return Module

local Module = {
    Name = "MM2 Teleport",
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
    Runtime = nil :: any,
}

local activeCleanup: () -> () = function(): () end

function Module.init(runtime: any): any
    if Module.Initialized then
        return Module
    end
    local core: any = state.mm2Core
    assert(type(core) == "table", "MM2 Teleport requires the MM2 core module")
    Module.Runtime = runtime
    local findDroppedGun: any = core.findDroppedGun
    local findMM2Map: any = core.findMM2Map
    local getPlayerRole: any = core.getPlayerRole
    local isRoundLifecycleActive: any = core.isRoundLifecycleActive
    local mm2Settings: any = core.mm2Settings

    -- Auto Get Gun is an innocent-only, in-round action. As Murderer it
    -- must never run (the knife role has no use for the sheriff gun and
    -- grabbing it exposes the role), and in the lobby there is no dropped
    -- gun worth chasing. Fail closed when the role or round state is not
    -- positively known.
    local function canAutoGetGun(): boolean
        return getPlayerRole(LocalPlayer) == "Innocent"
            and isRoundLifecycleActive() == true
            and findMM2Map() ~= nil
    end

    -- Immediate pickup without moving the character: pulse the touch
    -- between our root and the dropped gun's part, with no sleep or
    -- configurable delay. The next Heartbeat can retry while weapon
    -- replication is still catching up.
    local function touchDroppedGun(gunDrop: Instance): boolean
        if type(state.fireTouchInterest) ~= "function" then
            return false
        end
        local character: Model? = LocalPlayer.Character
        local root: Instance? = character
            and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then
            return false
        end
        local touchPart: Instance? = nil
        if gunDrop:IsA("BasePart") then
            touchPart = gunDrop
        elseif gunDrop:IsA("Model") then
            touchPart = gunDrop:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
                or gunDrop:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        end
        if not touchPart then
            return false
        end
        pcall(state.fireTouchInterest, root, touchPart, 0)
        pcall(state.fireTouchInterest, root, touchPart, 1)
        local backpack: Instance? =
            LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        return (backpack ~= nil and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil)
            or (character ~= nil and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil)
    end

    local autoGetGunBusy = false

    local function toggleAutoGetGun(enabled)
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoGetGun")
        autoGetGunBusy = false
        state.mm2AutoGetGunEnabled = enabled == true

        if not enabled then
            return
        end

        -- No polling throttle: TaskManager already runs this on
        -- Heartbeat, so checking every frame is the fastest the
        -- client can react (one frame, never a 0.5 s wait). The tick
        -- also runs once synchronously on enable, so a gun that is
        -- already on the ground is grabbed in the same frame the
        -- toggle turns on instead of waiting for the next Heartbeat.
        local function autoGetGunTick(): ()
            if autoGetGunBusy then
                return
            end

            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
            local gunDrop = findDroppedGun()
            if not character or not gunDrop
                or not canAutoGetGun()
                or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun"))
                or character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
                return
            end

            -- Instant touch first: no PivotTo, no position the server
            -- can call invalid. If the touch does not deliver the gun,
            -- stay put and let the next frame retry instead of falling
            -- back to a teleport the user did not ask for.
            autoGetGunBusy = true
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(touchDroppedGun, gunDrop)
                autoGetGunBusy = false
            end)
        end
        featureConnections.MM2AutoGetGun =
            TaskManager:Connect(autoGetGunTick, nil, "MM2 Get Gun")
        autoGetGunTick()
    end

    local function moveCharacterTo(character: any, destination: CFrame): ()
        local root: BasePart? = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
            root.Anchored = false
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        else
            root = nil
        end
        character:PivotTo(destination)
        if root then root.CFrame = destination end
    end

    local function teleportToMap()
        local map = findMM2Map()
        local spawns = map and (map:FindFirstChild("Spawns") or map:FindFirstChild("Spawns", true))
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not map or not character then
            notify("No active MM2 map was found.")
            return
        end

        local target = nil
        if spawns then
            local spawnList = spawns:GetChildren()
            target = spawnList[math.random(1, math.max(1, #spawnList))]
            if target and not target:IsA("BasePart") then
                target = target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            end
        end
        if (not target or not target:IsA("BasePart")) and spawns then
            target = spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        end
        if not target or not target:IsA("BasePart") then
            target = map:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        end
        if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then
            moveCharacterTo(character, target.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        else
            notify("No active MM2 map spawn was found.")
        end
    end

    local function findLobbySpawn()
        local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
            or workspace:FindFirstChild("MainLobby")
            or workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
        if not lobby then
            for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(child.Name))
                if string.find(lowerName, "lobby", 1, true) ~= nil
                    or child:FindFirstChild("VotePads", true) ~= nil
                    or child:FindFirstChild("VotePad1", true) ~= nil
                    or child:FindFirstChild("VoteIcons", true) ~= nil then
                    lobby = child
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if lobby then
            local spawns = lobby:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
                or lobby:FindFirstChild("Spawns", true)
            if spawns then
                local spawn = spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation")
                    or spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    or spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                if spawn then return spawn end
            end
            local directSpawn = lobby:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
            if directSpawn then return directSpawn end
            local votePads = lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePads", true)
                or lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePad1", true)
            if votePads then
                local padPart = votePads:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                if padPart then return padPart end
            end
            local anyPart = lobby:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if anyPart then return anyPart end
        end
        local worldSpawns = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
        if worldSpawns then
            local spawn = worldSpawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation")
                or worldSpawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if spawn then return spawn end
        end
        return workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
    end

    local function teleportToLobby()
        local spawn = findLobbySpawn()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if spawn and character then
            moveCharacterTo(character, spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        else
            notify("The MM2 lobby spawn was not found.")
        end
    end

    local teleportTargetName = ""

    local function teleportToPlayer()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then
            notify("Your character is not available.")
            return
        end
        local needle = string.lower(
            string.gsub(teleportTargetName or "", "%s+", "")
        )
        if needle == "" then
            notify("Type a player name in the Player name box first.")
            return
        end
        local exact, partial = nil, nil
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                local name = string.lower(player.Name)
                if string.gsub(name, "%s+", "") == needle then
                    exact = player
                    break
                end
                if not partial and string.find(name, needle, 1, true) then
                    partial = player
                end
            end
        end
        local target = exact or partial
        local targetRoot = target
            and target.Character
            and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if targetRoot then
            character:PivotTo(targetRoot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        elseif target then
            notify(target.Name .. " has no character to teleport to.")
        else
            notify("No player named \"" .. teleportTargetName .. "\" was found.")
        end
    end

    local function grabDroppedGun()
        local gunDrop = findDroppedGun()
        if gunDrop and LocalPlayer.Character then
            touchDroppedGun(gunDrop)
        else
            notify("No dropped gun was found.")
        end
    end

    local teleport = state.framework:GetModule("Teleport")
    assert(teleport, "MM2 extends the universal Teleport module")
    for _, id in ipairs({"GetGunkey", "Playername"}) do
        local key = "Universal.ClickTeleport." .. id
        if configData.values[key] == nil then configData.values[key] = configData.values["MM2.Teleport." .. id] end
    end
    local autoKey = "Universal.ClickTeleport.AutoGetGun"
    if configData.states[autoKey] == nil then configData.states[autoKey] = configData.states["MM2.Teleport.AutoGetGun"] end
    local show = {Option = "Destination", Values = {"MM2"}}
    teleport:CreateButton({Name = "Teleport to Map", Show = show, Function = teleportToMap})
    teleport:CreateButton({Name = "Teleport to Lobby", Show = show, Function = teleportToLobby})
    teleport:CreateTextBox({Name = "Player name", Default = "", Show = show,
        Function = function(value) teleportTargetName = value end})
    teleport:CreateButton({Name = "Teleport to Player", Show = show, Function = teleportToPlayer})
    teleport:CreateButton({Name = "Get Gun", Show = show, Function = grabDroppedGun})
    local key = teleport:CreateBind({Name = "Get Gun key", Default = mm2Settings.getGunKey, Show = show,
        Function = function(value) mm2Settings.getGunKey = value end})
    if state.bindMobileActionPlacement and key.Object then
        state.bindMobileActionPlacement(key.Object, "MM2GetGun", "GUN", grabDroppedGun)
    end
    featureConnections.MM2GetGunKey = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(
        function(input, gameProcessed)
            if gameProcessed
                or state.keyCaptureCallback
                or state.waitingForKey
                or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
                and input.KeyCode == mm2Settings.getGunKey then
                task.spawn(grabDroppedGun)
            end
        end
    )
    teleport:CreateToggle({Name = "Auto Get Gun", Default = false, Show = show, Function = toggleAutoGetGun})

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        toggleAutoGetGun(false)
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2GetGunKey")
    end
    Module.Events = featureConnections
    Module.Initialized = true
    return Module
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if not Module.Initialized then
        return
    end
    Module.Initialized = false
    pcall(activeCleanup)
    activeCleanup = function(): () end
    Module.Events = {}
    Module.Runtime = nil
end

return Module

local Module = {
    Name = "MM2 Auto Farm",
    Events = {},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: () -> () = function(): ()
end

function Module.init(_runtime: any): any
    assert(state.mm2Core, "MM2 Auto Farm requires the MM2 core")
    local core: any = state.mm2Core
    local getPlayerRole: any = core.getPlayerRole
    local getPlayerWeapon: any = core.getPlayerWeapon
    local isPlayerAlive: any = core.isPlayerAlive
    local findMurderer: any = core.findMurderer
    local findSheriff: any = core.findSheriff
    local findDroppedGun: any = core.findDroppedGun
    local isRoundLifecycleActive: any = core.isRoundLifecycleActive
    local findMM2Map: any = core.findMM2Map
    local getEstimatedLatency: any = core.getEstimatedLatency

    -- v138.7 renamed the two full-bag fling toggles ("after reset" ->
    -- "after full bag"). Option keys are derived from the label, so carry a saved
    -- value over instead of silently resetting it.
    if type(configData) == "table" and type(configData.states) == "table" then
        local rename = {
            ["MM2.AutoFarm.FlingMurderafterreset"] = "MM2.AutoFarm.FlingMurderafterfullbag",
            ["MM2.AutoFarm.FlingSheriffafterreset"] = "MM2.AutoFarm.FlingSheriffafterfullbag",
        }
        for oldKey: string, newKey: string in pairs(rename) do
            if configData.states[newKey] == nil and configData.states[oldKey] ~= nil then
                configData.states[newKey] = configData.states[oldKey]
            end
            configData.states[oldKey] = nil
        end
    end

    local settings = {
        mode = "Walk",
        speed = 16,
        stayUnderOnStart = true,
        safeZone = true,
        resetOnFull = true,
        flingMurder = false,
        flingSheriff = false,
        grabGunShoot = false,
        killAllOnFull = false,
    }

    local totalCoinsCollected: number = 0
    local farmElapsedSeconds: number = 0
    local lastFormattedSecond: number = -1
    local coinsCollectedStat: any = nil
    local farmTimeStat: any = nil
    local safeZonePlatform: Part? = nil
    -- Installed by the current farm generation; used by both the master OFF
    -- and the Safe Zone row OFF. Never send an already-respawned body to an
    -- old map, and never remove its only floor when no return is possible.
    local leaveSafeZone: ((boolean?, boolean?) -> boolean)? = nil

    local function formatFarmTime(totalSeconds: number): string
        local whole: number = math.max(0, math.floor(totalSeconds))
        local hours: number = math.floor(whole / 3600)
        local mins: number = math.floor((whole % 3600) / 60)
        local secs: number = whole % 60
        if hours > 0 then
            return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", hours, mins, secs)
        end
        return string.format("%02d:%02d", mins, secs)
    end

    local function refreshFarmOverlay(): ()
        if coinsCollectedStat and type(coinsCollectedStat.set) == "function" then
            coinsCollectedStat.set(tostring(totalCoinsCollected))
        end
        local wholeSec: number = math.max(0, math.floor(farmElapsedSeconds))
        if wholeSec ~= lastFormattedSecond then
            lastFormattedSecond = wholeSec
            if farmTimeStat and type(farmTimeStat.set) == "function" then
                farmTimeStat.set(formatFarmTime(wholeSec))
            end
        end
    end

    local function destroySafeZonePlatform(): ()
        if safeZonePlatform then
            pcall(function(): ()
                safeZonePlatform:Destroy()
            end)
            safeZonePlatform = nil
        end
    end

    local function ensureSafeZonePlatform(originPos: Vector3): Vector3?
        local voidCenter: Vector3 = Vector3.new(
            originPos.X + 650,
            math.max(originPos.Y + 280, 380),
            originPos.Z + 650
        )
        if not safeZonePlatform or not safeZonePlatform.Parent then
            pcall(function(): ()
                local part: Part = Instance.new("Part")
                part.Name = "Wurst_AutoFarmSafeZone"
                part.Anchored = true
                part.CanCollide = true
                part.CanQuery = false
                part.CanTouch = false
                part.CastShadow = false
                part.Size = Vector3.new(64, 4, 64)
                part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 42, 55)
                part.Transparency = 0.15
                part.CFrame = CFrame.new(voidCenter)
                part.Parent = workspace
                safeZonePlatform = part
            end)
        end
        if safeZonePlatform and safeZonePlatform.Parent then
            return safeZonePlatform.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        end
        -- A missing platform is not a safe destination.
        return nil
    end

    -- Two ways to reach a coin, chosen with Farm Mode:
    --
    -- Walk: the humanoid simply walks on the ground (Humanoid:Move).
    -- No prone tilt, no PlatformStand, no NoClip, no flying -- the
    -- body's normal touch against Coin_Server pays, which is why this
    -- is the reliable default. The slider becomes WalkSpeed.
    --
    -- Below (Hitbox): the character stays UPRIGHT and flies by physics
    -- velocity underneath the floor, but the root's hitbox is grown
    -- while engaged (4 x 8 x 4), so riding with the root centre
    -- BELOW_OFFSET under the coin still overlaps Coin_Server (1.2 x 2 x
    -- 2, one stud either side of its centre). The old build lay the
    -- body face-down to get a part into that volume; the tilted camera
    -- fight is what glitched, and the hitbox makes it unnecessary.
    local BELOW_OFFSET: number = 3.0
    local HITBOX_SIZE: Vector3 = Vector3.new(4, 8, 4)
    -- A coin that survives several passes (or cannot be reached) is skipped for
    -- a while instead of trapping the farm on one unreachable pickup.
    local BLACKLIST_SECONDS: number = 6

    local function characterParts(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
        if type(getCharacterParts) == "function" then
            local ok: boolean, character: any, humanoid: any, root: any =
                pcall(getCharacterParts)
            if ok and character then
                return character, humanoid, root
            end
        end
        local character: Model? = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then
            return nil, nil, nil
        end
        local humanoid: Humanoid? =
            character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid?
        local root: BasePart? =
            character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
        return character, humanoid, root
    end

    local function rootOf(player: Player?): BasePart?
        local character: Model? = player and player.Character
        if not character then
            return nil
        end
        return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
    end

    -- Prefer Coin ESP's current family, but an empty/stale family cache must
    -- not hide real pickups from Auto Farm. The fallback is throttled separately
    -- (including when there are zero coins) and never searches a different map.
    local fallbackScanAt: number = -math.huge
    local fallbackScanMap: Instance? = nil
    local fallbackPickups: {Instance} = {}
    local function coinPickups(): {Instance}
        local map: Instance? = type(findMM2Map) == "function" and findMM2Map()
        local out: {Instance} = {}
        local function consider(object: Instance): ()
            if not object.Parent or not object:IsA("BasePart") then return end
            -- A real Instance can verify ancestry; do not chase a lobby or an
            -- old map's pickup just because it still has the CoinVisual tag.
            if map and type(object.IsDescendantOf) == "function"
                and not object:IsDescendantOf(map) then return end
            local ok: boolean, usable: any = pcall(function(): boolean
                local parent: Instance? = object.Parent
                local server: Instance = if parent and parent.Name == "Coin_Server" then parent else object
                return object:GetAttribute("Collected") ~= true
                    and object:GetAttribute("Delete") ~= true
                    and server:GetAttribute("Collected") ~= true
                    and server:GetAttribute("Delete") ~= true
            end)
            if ok and usable then table.insert(out, object) end
        end
        if type(state.mm2CoinPickups) == "function" then
            local ok: boolean, list: any = pcall(state.mm2CoinPickups)
            if ok and type(list) == "table" then
                -- Coin ESP scans the entire workspace: a non-empty list can
                -- still consist solely of old-map or already-collected items.
                for _, object: Instance in ipairs(list) do consider(object) end
                if #out > 0 then return out end
            end
        end
        local now: number = os.clock()
        if map == fallbackScanMap and now - fallbackScanAt < 0.5 then
            return fallbackPickups
        end
        fallbackScanAt = now
        fallbackScanMap = map
        local okTagged: boolean, tagged: any = pcall(function(): any
            return game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("CoinVisual")
        end)
        if okTagged and type(tagged) == "table" then
            for _, object: Instance in ipairs(tagged) do consider(object) end
        end
        if #out == 0 then
            local ok: boolean, descendants: any = pcall(function(): any
                -- Pickups live under the active map's CoinContainer; avoid
                -- walking the lobby and every unrelated streamed character.
                if map and type(map.GetDescendants) == "function" then return map:GetDescendants() end
                return workspace:GetDescendants()
            end)
            if ok and type(descendants) == "table" then
                for _, object: Instance in ipairs(descendants) do
                    if object.Name == "Coin_Server" then consider(object) end
                end
            end
        end
        fallbackPickups = out
        return out
    end

    -- Live ping for the status line. The farm speed itself is the
    -- slider: the server kicks ("Invalid position", 267) when the
    -- root arrives faster than it accepts, and that limit varies by
    -- map and connection, so the user tunes it -- start low.
    local function pingMillis(): number
        if type(getEstimatedLatency) == "function" then
            local ok: boolean, value: any = pcall(getEstimatedLatency)
            if ok and type(value) == "number" and value == value then
                return math.round(math.clamp(value, 0.02, 0.6) * 1000)
            end
        end
        return 0
    end

    local function setStatus(text: string?): ()
        local card: any = state.mm2AutoFarmFeature
        if card then
            card:SetStatus(text)
        end
    end

    -- Kill All, adapted from YARHM 1.21 ("Kill EVERYONE as
    -- murderer"): equip the knife, pull every living player in front
    -- of us (anchored), then slash. The slash uses the repo's own
    -- knife path (Events.HandleTouched per victim, as KnifeAura
    -- does) and falls back to the game's Stab remote like YARHM.
    local function killAll(isCurrent: () -> boolean): ()
        if not isCurrent() then return end
        if type(getPlayerRole) ~= "function"
            or getPlayerRole(LocalPlayer) ~= "Murderer" then
            notify("Auto Farm: Kill All only works as the Murderer.")
            return
        end
        local character: Model?, humanoid: Humanoid?, myRoot: BasePart? =
            characterParts()
        if not character or not humanoid or not myRoot then
            return
        end
        local knife: Tool? = nil
        if type(getPlayerWeapon) == "function" then
            knife = getPlayerWeapon(LocalPlayer, "Knife")
        end
        if not knife then
            notify("Auto Farm: no Knife found for Kill All.")
            return
        end
        if knife.Parent ~= character then
            pcall(function(): ()
                humanoid:EquipTool(knife :: Tool)
            end)
            -- Wait only until the equip lands (one frame normally),
            -- never a fixed sleep: 0.3 s is the ceiling, not the cost.
            local equipDeadline: number = os.clock() + 0.3
            while knife.Parent ~= character
                and os.clock() < equipDeadline and isCurrent() do
                task.wait()
            end
        end
        if not isCurrent() or knife.Parent ~= character then
            return
        end
        local victims: {BasePart} = {}
        for _, player: Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer
                and (type(isPlayerAlive) ~= "function" or isPlayerAlive(player)) then
                local victimRoot: BasePart? = rootOf(player)
                if victimRoot then
                    table.insert(victims, victimRoot)
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        victimRoot.Anchored = true
                        victimRoot.CFrame = myRoot.CFrame
                            + myRoot.CFrame.LookVector * 1
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        if #victims == 0 then
            return
        end
        local function releaseVictims(): ()
            for _, victimRoot: BasePart in ipairs(victims) do
                pcall(function(): ()
                    victimRoot.Anchored = false
                end)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.15)
        if not isCurrent() then
            releaseVictims()
            return
        end
        local stab: Instance? = knife:FindFirstChild("Stab")
        if stab and stab:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            pcall(function(): ()
                (stab :: RemoteEvent):FireServer("Slash")
            end)
        end
        local events: Instance? = knife:FindFirstChild("Events")
        local handleTouched: Instance? = events
            and events:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched")
        pcall(function(): ()
            (knife :: Tool):Activate()
        end)
        for _, victimRoot: BasePart in ipairs(victims) do
            if not isCurrent() then break end
            if handleTouched and handleTouched:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                pcall(function(): ()
                    (handleTouched :: RemoteEvent):FireServer(victimRoot)
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        if isCurrent() then
            task.delay(0.5, releaseVictims)
            notify("Auto Farm: Kill All fired at " .. #victims .. " players.")
        else
            releaseVictims()
        end
    end

    -- Compact spin fling: park on the target spinning hard for a
    -- couple of seconds; contact physics does the rest.
    local function flingPlayer(target: Player?, isCurrent: () -> boolean): ()
        if not target or not isCurrent() then
            return
        end
        if type(state.mm2PerformFling) == "function" then
            pcall(state.mm2PerformFling, target, {
                silent = true,
                duration = 3.5,
                blocking = true,
                shouldStop = function(): boolean return not isCurrent() end,
                skipReturnOnStop = true,
            })
            return
        end
        local _, _, myRoot: BasePart? = characterParts()
        if not myRoot then
            return
        end
        local saved: CFrame = myRoot.CFrame
        local startedAt: number = os.clock()
        while os.clock() - startedAt < 2.2 and isCurrent() do
            local targetRoot: BasePart? = rootOf(target)
            if not targetRoot then
                break
            end
            pcall(function(): ()
                myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame
                myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 400, 0)
                myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
            task.wait()
        end
        pcall(function(): ()
            myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            if isCurrent() then
                myRoot.CFrame = saved
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Use the shared Silent/CFrame constructor only. Auto Farm explicitly
    -- opts out of WallCheck; Gun Aimbot's per-mode setting is independent.
    local lastShotAt: number = -math.huge
    local function shootMurderer(murderer: Player): boolean
        if type(state.mm2FireSilentShot) ~= "function" then
            setStatus("Silent shot unavailable")
            return false
        end
        local now: number = os.clock()
        if now - lastShotAt < 0.22 then return false end
        -- A thrown error can happen after a send; pace it and never fall back
        -- to a second transport or to a normal Bullet shot.
        lastShotAt = now
        local ok: boolean, sent: any = pcall(state.mm2FireSilentShot, murderer, {
            continuous = true,
            quiet = true,
            wallCheck = false,
        })
        return ok and sent == true
    end

    local farmGeneration: number = 0

    local function toggleAutoFarm(enabled: boolean): ()
        farmGeneration += 1
        local enableGeneration: number = farmGeneration
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoFarmSafeZoneRetry")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoFarmTick")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoFarmStepped")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoFarmCoinCollected")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoFarmCoinAdded")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoFarmRoundEnd")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoFarmRoundStart")
        for _, name: string in ipairs({"RoleSelect", "ShowRoleSelect", "ShowRoleSelectNew", "CoinsStarted"}) do
            disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoFarmStart_" .. name)
        end
        -- Invokes the restore closure the previous enable registered:
        -- collisions, PlatformStand, AutoRotate and the root all go
        -- back, and the character returns to where the farm grabbed
        -- it (never left lying under the floor, stuck in geometry).
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2AutoFarmRestore")

        if not enabled then
            setStatus(nil)
            return
        end
        -- A previously stranded Safe Zone still owns its one protective pad.
        -- Do not start farming from the void or forget its return destination.
        if leaveSafeZone and not leaveSafeZone(false) then
            setStatus("Auto Farm: waiting in Safe Zone for the original map")
            -- Keep ON meaningful if the user re-enables while the old map is
            -- temporarily unavailable: retry quietly, then start a fresh farm
            -- generation only after a safe return or a server teleport.
            local retryElapsed: number = 0
            featureConnections.MM2AutoFarmSafeZoneRetry = TaskManager:Connect(function(delta: number): ()
                if farmGeneration ~= enableGeneration then return end
                retryElapsed += math.max(0, tonumber(delta) or 0)
                if retryElapsed < 1 then return end
                retryElapsed = 0
                if leaveSafeZone and leaveSafeZone(false, true) then
                    toggleAutoFarm(true)
                end
            end, nil, "MM2 Auto Farm Safe Zone Retry")
            return
        end
        leaveSafeZone = nil
        fallbackScanAt = -math.huge
        fallbackScanMap = nil
        fallbackPickups = {}

        local bagAmount: number = 0
        local bagLimit: number = 50
        local busy: boolean = false
        local fullHandled: boolean = false
        local roundFullReached: boolean = false
        local teleportedHomeThisRound: boolean = false
        local wasInActiveRound: boolean = false
        local currentRoundMap: Instance? = nil
        local busyLobbyPart: BasePart? = nil
        local busyLobbyScanAt: number = 0
        local endedMap: Instance? = nil
        local waitingForNextRound: boolean = false
        local roundGeneration: number = 0
        local scanCache: {Instance} = {}
        local scanAt: number = 0
        -- A coin that does not pay on the first touch is retried on a later pass
        -- instead of holding the farm on it: the dwell under a coin is a fraction
        -- of a second, never the old ~1 s stop.
        local DWELL_SECONDS: number = 0.3
        local RETRY_SECONDS: number = 1.5
        local RETRY_LIMIT: number = 3
        local retryAt: {[Instance]: number} = {}
        local attempts: {[Instance]: number} = {}
        local blacklist: {[Instance]: number} = {}
        local stuckPart: Instance? = nil
        local stuckSince: number = 0
        local lastTouchPulse: number = 0
        local travelPart: Instance? = nil
        local travelBestDistance: number = math.huge
        local travelProgressAt: number = 0
        local TRAVEL_STALL_SECONDS: number = 3.5

        -- Engagement state. The farm touches the character ONLY while engaged
        -- inside an active round on a map. In the lobby or between rounds, the
        -- character is left completely alone.
        local engaged: boolean = false
        local engagedCharacter: Model? = nil
        local homeCFrame: CFrame? = nil
        local homeCharacter: Model? = nil
        local parkedCharacter: Model? = nil
        local parkedMap: Instance? = nil
        local parkedReturn: CFrame? = nil
        local parkedPosition: Vector3? = nil
        local hiddenUnderMap: boolean = false
        local savedCollide: {[Instance]: boolean} = {}
        local engagedMode: string? = nil
        local savedWalkSpeed: number? = nil
        local savedRootSize: Vector3? = nil
        local walkLastDistance: number = math.huge
        local walkStuckSince: number = 0
        local walkBodyReady: boolean = false
        local walkCarryDirection: Vector3? = nil
        local walkCarryUntil: number = 0
        -- Below (Hitbox) is flown by the controller below, on Stepped (before the
        -- physics step). The task tick only chooses the destination.
        local hoverTarget: Vector3? = nil
        local hoverActive: boolean = false
        local lastSteppedPosition: Vector3? = nil

        local function yawOf(frame: CFrame): number
            local look: Vector3 = frame.LookVector
            return math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
        end

        local function findLobbyReferencePart(): BasePart?
            local okChildren: boolean, children: any = pcall(function(): any
                return workspace:GetChildren()
            end)
            if not okChildren or type(children) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end
            for _, child: Instance in ipairs(children) do
                local lowerName: string = string.lower(tostring(child.Name))
                local isLobby: boolean = string.find(lowerName, "lobby", 1, true) ~= nil
                    or child:FindFirstChild("VotePads", true) ~= nil
                    or child:FindFirstChild("VotePad1", true) ~= nil
                    or child:FindFirstChild("VoteIcons", true) ~= nil
                if isLobby then
                    local votePads: Instance? = child:FindFirstChild("VotePads", true)
                    if votePads then
                        local padPart: BasePart? = votePads:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        if padPart then
                            return padPart
                        end
                    end
                    local spawns: Instance? = child:FindFirstChild("Spawns", true)
                    if spawns then
                        local spawnPart: BasePart? = spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        if spawnPart then
                            return spawnPart
                        end
                    end
                    local anyPart: BasePart? = child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    if anyPart then
                        return anyPart
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function isNearLobby(root: BasePart?, lobby: BasePart?): boolean
            if not root or not lobby then return false end
            local ok: boolean, near: any = pcall(function(): boolean
                return (root.Position - lobby.Position).Magnitude <= 350
            end)
            return ok and near == true
        end

        -- Resolves a safe indoor floor position without ever raycasting from
        -- above the building roof (which would put the player on top of the map).
        local function resolveSafeAboveGroundPosition(
            candidatePos: Vector3,
            character: Model?
        ): Vector3
            if homeCFrame then
                local dx: number = candidatePos.X - homeCFrame.Position.X
                local dz: number = candidatePos.Z - homeCFrame.Position.Z
                if (dx * dx + dz * dz) <= 36 then
                    return Vector3.new(candidatePos.X, homeCFrame.Position.Y, candidatePos.Z)
                end
            end
            local resolvedY: number = candidatePos.Y
            local wasUnderground: boolean = hiddenUnderMap or engagedMode == "Below"
            local probeRaise: number = if wasUnderground then (BELOW_OFFSET + 4.5) else 2.5
            local foundFloor: boolean = false
            pcall(function(): ()
                if type(workspace.Raycast) == "function" and type(RaycastParams) == "table" then
                    local params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                    local excluded: {Instance} = {}
                    if character then
                        table.insert(excluded, character)
                    end
                    if safeZonePlatform then
                        table.insert(excluded, safeZonePlatform)
                    end
                    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
                    params.RespectCanCollide = true
                    params.IgnoreWater = true
                    local rayOrigin: Vector3 = Vector3.new(
                        candidatePos.X,
                        candidatePos.Y + probeRaise,
                        candidatePos.Z
                    )
                    local hit: any = workspace:Raycast(
                        rayOrigin,
                        Vector3.new(0, -(probeRaise + 8), 0),
                        params
                    )
                    if hit and typeof(hit.Position) == "Vector3" then
                        resolvedY = hit.Position.Y + 3.2
                        foundFloor = true
                    end
                end
            end)
            if not foundFloor and wasUnderground then
                if homeCFrame then
                    resolvedY = homeCFrame.Position.Y
                else
                    resolvedY = candidatePos.Y + BELOW_OFFSET + 4.0
                end
            end
            return Vector3.new(candidatePos.X, resolvedY, candidatePos.Z)
        end

        local function forceNoClipCharacter(character: Model): ()
            for _, object: Instance in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if savedCollide[object] == nil then
                        savedCollide[object] = (object :: BasePart).CanCollide
                    end
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        (object :: BasePart).CanCollide = false
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        -- How deep below the round's own start the farm may hold, and how far
        -- down counts as "already falling into the void".
        local MAX_BELOW_DEPTH: number = 90
        local VOID_RECOVER_DEPTH: number = 130

        local function destroyHeightY(): number
            local destroyHeight: any = nil
            pcall(function(): ()
                destroyHeight = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
            end)
            if type(destroyHeight) ~= "number"
                or destroyHeight ~= destroyHeight
                or math.abs(destroyHeight) > 1e6 then
                return -500
            end
            return destroyHeight
        end

        local function currentHomeY(root: BasePart): number
            if homeCFrame then
                return homeCFrame.Position.Y
            end
            return root.Position.Y
        end

        -- Lowest altitude the farm is allowed to ask for: the round's start minus
        -- the depth budget, and never anywhere near where the game deletes parts.
        local function floorBudgetY(root: BasePart): number
            return math.max(destroyHeightY() + 40, currentHomeY(root) - MAX_BELOW_DEPTH)
        end

        local function clampBelowTarget(position: Vector3, root: BasePart): Vector3
            local lowest: number = floorBudgetY(root)
            local highest: number = currentHomeY(root) + 80
            return Vector3.new(
                position.X,
                math.clamp(position.Y, lowest, highest),
                position.Z
            )
        end

        -- One control step for Below, written BEFORE the physics step so the
        -- velocity is the one physics integrates this frame. The old build only
        -- wrote velocity from the Heartbeat tick, so gravity piled up between
        -- writes and the body sank out of the map instead of flying.
        local function applyBelowControl(root: BasePart, humanoid: Humanoid?): ()
            if not hoverActive then
                return
            end
            local speed: number = math.clamp(settings.speed, 5, 60)
            local target: Vector3? = hoverTarget
            if target then
                target = clampBelowTarget(target :: Vector3, root)
            end
            local velocityX: number = 0
            local velocityY: number = 0
            local velocityZ: number = 0
            if target then
                local delta: Vector3 = (target :: Vector3) - root.Position
                local flat: Vector3 = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
                local flatDistance: number = flat.Magnitude
                if flatDistance > 0.35 then
                    -- Full Farm Speed until the body is on the point: the old
                    -- proportional taper is what made the flight look slow and
                    -- flimsy on the final approach.
                    local direction: Vector3 = flat / flatDistance
                    velocityX = direction.X * speed
                    velocityZ = direction.Z * speed
                end
                -- Proportional altitude hold: this exactly cancels the falling
                -- the physics step would otherwise add.
                velocityY = math.clamp(delta.Y * 10, -speed, speed)
            end
            pcall(function(): ()
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ)
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
            if humanoid then
                pcall(function(): ()
                    if not humanoid.PlatformStand then
                        humanoid.PlatformStand = true
                    end
                    if humanoid.AutoRotate then
                        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        -- No coin to chase: keep the altitude the body already holds instead of
        -- re-targeting its own centre every tick (that let gravity walk it down).
        local function holdAltitude(root: BasePart): ()
            local targetY: number = homeCFrame and homeCFrame.Position.Y or root.Position.Y
            if hoverTarget then
                targetY = hoverTarget.Y
            elseif hiddenUnderMap then
                targetY = currentHomeY(root) - BELOW_OFFSET
            end
            hoverTarget = clampBelowTarget(
                Vector3.new(root.Position.X, targetY, root.Position.Z),
                root
            )
            hoverActive = true
        end

        -- Round start only ("Stay Under When Round starts"): the body waits under
        -- the map while there is nothing to farm, then the farm starts normally in
        -- whichever mode is selected. Works for Walk too: leaving the hold puts the
        -- body back on the surface at the round's start point, so walking resumes
        -- from solid ground instead of from inside the geometry.
        local function holdUnderMap(
            character: Model,
            humanoid: Humanoid,
            root: BasePart
        ): ()
            hiddenUnderMap = true
            forceNoClipCharacter(character)
            local basePosition: Vector3 = if homeCFrame
                then homeCFrame.Position
                else root.Position
            local hidePos: Vector3 = clampBelowTarget(
                basePosition - Vector3.new(0, BELOW_OFFSET + 4, 0),
                root
            )
            hoverTarget = hidePos
            hoverActive = settings.mode ~= "Walk"
            pcall(function(): ()
                humanoid.PlatformStand = true
                humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                if settings.mode ~= "Walk" then
                    if savedRootSize == nil then
                        savedRootSize = root.Size
                    end
                    root.Size = HITBOX_SIZE
                end
                if (root.Position - hidePos).Magnitude > 6 then
                    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(hidePos)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, yawOf(root.CFrame), 0)
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end)
            if not lastSteppedPosition then lastSteppedPosition = root.Position end
        end

        -- Puts the body back inside the farm's altitude budget after a fall.
        -- Below: back under the map at the round's start, still NoClipped.
        -- Walk: on the floor the round started on, upright, collisions back.
        local function recoverFromVoid(
            character: Model,
            humanoid: Humanoid,
            root: BasePart
        ): ()
            local homeX: number = homeCFrame and homeCFrame.Position.X or root.Position.X
            local homeZ: number = homeCFrame and homeCFrame.Position.Z or root.Position.Z
            local homeY: number = currentHomeY(root)
            if settings.mode == "Walk" then
                local safePos: Vector3 = if homeCFrame
                    then homeCFrame.Position
                    else Vector3.new(homeX, destroyHeightY() + 120, homeZ)
                hoverActive = false
                hoverTarget = nil
                walkCarryDirection = nil
                walkCarryUntil = 0
                pcall(function(): ()
                    if savedRootSize then
                        root.Size = savedRootSize
                        savedRootSize = nil
                    end
                    character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(safePos))
                    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(safePos)
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    humanoid.PlatformStand = false
                    humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                end)
                walkBodyReady = false
                return
            end
            local recoverY: number = math.min(
                homeY - BELOW_OFFSET,
                homeY + 8
            )
            recoverY = math.max(recoverY, destroyHeightY() + 60)
            local target: Vector3 = Vector3.new(homeX, recoverY, homeZ)
            hiddenUnderMap = true
            forceNoClipCharacter(character)
            hoverTarget = target
            hoverActive = true
            pcall(function(): ()
                if savedRootSize == nil then
                    savedRootSize = root.Size
                end
                root.Size = HITBOX_SIZE
                humanoid.PlatformStand = true
                humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(target)
                    * CFrame.Angles(0, yawOf(root.CFrame), 0)
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
        end

        -- Detects when the player's character is inside the loaded MM2 map,
        -- including the pre-round countdown seconds right after teleporting
        -- from the lobby before roles or coins have spawned.
        local function isCharacterInActiveRound(root: BasePart, knownMap: Instance?): boolean
            if type(findMM2Map) ~= "function" then
                return false
            end
            local map: Instance? = knownMap or findMM2Map()
            if not map then
                return false
            end
            if type(getPlayerRole) == "function" then
                local role: any = getPlayerRole(LocalPlayer)
                if role == "Dead" then
                    return false
                end
                if (role == "None" or role == nil)
                    and type(isRoundLifecycleActive) == "function"
                    and isRoundLifecycleActive() == false then
                    -- If round lifecycle explicitly says false AND we are near
                    -- the lobby (or no map geometry exists), stay in lobby state.
                    local lobbyPartCheck: BasePart? = findLobbyReferencePart()
                    if lobbyPartCheck then
                        local okLD: boolean, ld: any = pcall(function(): any
                            return (root.Position - lobbyPartCheck.Position).Magnitude
                        end)
                        if okLD and type(ld) == "number" and ld <= 350 then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local lobbyPart: BasePart? = findLobbyReferencePart()
            if lobbyPart then
                local okLobbyDist: boolean, lobbyDist: any = pcall(function(): any
                    return (root.Position - lobbyPart.Position).Magnitude
                end)
                if okLobbyDist and type(lobbyDist) == "number" and lobbyDist <= 350 then
                    return false
                end
            end
            if safeZonePlatform and safeZonePlatform.Parent then
                local okZoneDist: boolean, zoneDist: any = pcall(function(): any
                    return (root.Position - safeZonePlatform.Position).Magnitude
                end)
                if okZoneDist and type(zoneDist) == "number" and zoneDist <= 120 then
                    return true
                end
            end
            local refPart: BasePart? = nil
            local spawns: Instance? = (map :: Instance):FindFirstChild("Spawns")
            if spawns then
                refPart = spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            end
            if not refPart then
                local coinContainer: Instance? = (map :: Instance):FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
                if coinContainer then
                    refPart = coinContainer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                end
            end
            if not refPart then
                refPart = (map :: Instance):FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            end
            if refPart then
                local okDist: boolean, dist: any = pcall(function(): any
                    return (root.Position - refPart.Position).Magnitude
                end)
                if okDist and type(dist) == "number" and dist > 1500 then
                    return false
                end
                return true
            end
            if type(isRoundLifecycleActive) == "function"
                and isRoundLifecycleActive() ~= true then
                return false
            end
            return true
        end

        local function restoreCharacter(returnHome: boolean, noReposition: boolean?): ()
            local wasMovedByFarm: boolean = engaged or hiddenUnderMap
            local character: Model?, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? =
                characterParts()
            -- The old body can disappear before the next round's body exists.
            -- Restore the body we actually modified, not a newly spawned one.
            local movedCharacter: Model? = engagedCharacter or (hiddenUnderMap and homeCharacter)
            if wasMovedByFarm and movedCharacter and movedCharacter ~= character then
                character = movedCharacter
                humanoid = movedCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid?
                root = movedCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
            end
            for part: Instance, was: boolean in pairs(savedCollide) do
                pcall(function(): ()
                    (part :: BasePart).CanCollide = was
                end)
            end
            table.clear(savedCollide)
            if humanoid and wasMovedByFarm then
                pcall(function(): ()
                    humanoid.PlatformStand = false
                    humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                    if humanoid.Sit then
                        humanoid.Sit = false
                    end
                    if savedWalkSpeed then
                        humanoid.WalkSpeed = savedWalkSpeed
                    end
                    humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                end)
            end
            savedWalkSpeed = nil
            if root and wasMovedByFarm then
                pcall(function(): ()
                    if savedRootSize then
                        root.Size = savedRootSize
                    end
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    if noReposition then
                        return
                    end
                    -- Return the character to the exact last position
                    -- it had right before Auto Farm started (homeCFrame),
                    -- never to a random spawn point, and during active
                    -- farming strictly only when the player has 50 coins.
                    -- Once that 50-coin teleport has cleanly happened once,
                    -- never teleport the character anywhere else in this round.
                    local allowReturnHome: boolean = returnHome
                        and not teleportedHomeThisRound
                        and (bagAmount >= 50 or not enabled)
                        and homeCFrame ~= nil
                        and (not homeCharacter or homeCharacter == character)
                    if allowReturnHome and homeCFrame then
                        local destPosition: Vector3 = resolveSafeAboveGroundPosition(
                            homeCFrame.Position,
                            character
                        )
                        local mapReturn: CFrame = CFrame.new(destPosition)
                            * CFrame.Angles(0, yawOf(homeCFrame), 0)
                        local zoneDestination: Vector3? = nil
                        if enabled and settings.safeZone and bagAmount >= 50 then
                            zoneDestination = ensureSafeZonePlatform(homeCFrame.Position)
                            if zoneDestination then destPosition = zoneDestination end
                        end
                        local targetCF: CFrame = CFrame.new(destPosition)
                            * CFrame.Angles(0, yawOf(homeCFrame), 0)
                        if character then
                            pcall(function(): ()
                                character:PivotTo(targetCF)
                            end)
                        end
                        root.CFrame = targetCF
                        if zoneDestination then
                            parkedCharacter, parkedMap = character, currentRoundMap
                            parkedReturn, parkedPosition = mapReturn, zoneDestination
                        end
                        if bagAmount >= 50 then
                            teleportedHomeThisRound = true
                            homeCFrame = nil
                        end
                    elseif not teleportedHomeThisRound then
                        -- Coming out of the round-start hold: the body is
                        -- underneath the floor, so a raycast from there finds
                        -- nothing. Go back to the round's start point instead,
                        -- which was recorded on the surface.
                        local safePos: Vector3 = if hiddenUnderMap and homeCFrame
                            then homeCFrame.Position
                            else resolveSafeAboveGroundPosition(root.Position, character)
                        local targetCF: CFrame = CFrame.new(safePos)
                            * CFrame.Angles(0, yawOf(root.CFrame), 0)
                        if character then
                            pcall(function(): ()
                                character:PivotTo(targetCF)
                            end)
                        end
                        root.CFrame = targetCF
                    end
                end)
            end
            hiddenUnderMap = false
            savedRootSize = nil
            engaged = false
            engagedMode = nil
            engagedCharacter = nil
            hoverActive = false
            hoverTarget = nil
            lastSteppedPosition = nil
            walkCarryDirection = nil
            walkCarryUntil = 0
            walkBodyReady = false
        end

        local function stillParked(): boolean
            local character: Model?, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = characterParts()
            if not parkedReturn or not parkedPosition or character ~= parkedCharacter
                or not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
            return (root.Position - (parkedPosition :: Vector3)).Magnitude <= 120
        end

        leaveSafeZone = function(cancelBusy: boolean?, quiet: boolean?): boolean
            if not stillParked() then
                parkedCharacter, parkedMap, parkedReturn, parkedPosition = nil, nil, nil, nil
                destroySafeZonePlatform()
                return true
            end
            if cancelBusy then
                roundGeneration += 1
                busy = false
            end
            local character: Model?, _, root: BasePart? = characterParts()
            local okMap: boolean, map: any = pcall(function(): any
                return type(findMM2Map) == "function" and findMM2Map() or nil
            end)
            if not okMap or not parkedMap or map ~= parkedMap or not parkedMap.Parent or not root then
                -- The old map is gone; leave the floor in place rather than
                -- teleport to a stale location or drop the player into void.
                if not quiet then notify("Auto Farm: waiting in Safe Zone; the original map is unavailable.") end
                return false
            end
            local destination: CFrame = parkedReturn :: CFrame
            local moved: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
                if character then pcall(function(): () character:PivotTo(destination) end) end
                root.CFrame = destination
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
            if not moved then return false end
            parkedCharacter, parkedMap, parkedReturn, parkedPosition = nil, nil, nil, nil
            destroySafeZonePlatform()
            return true
        end

        -- A round may end while the character is absent, so the ordinary
        -- lobby tick is not guaranteed to run. Invalidate full-bag and pickup
        -- state independently of that tick; never teleport to an old map here.
        local function clearRound(): ()
            roundGeneration += 1
            busy = false
            if engaged or hiddenUnderMap then
                -- Lift a held/underground body back to the map only while it
                -- is still demonstrably on the SAME round map. Never move a
                -- body already teleported to a lobby or a replacement map.
                local character: Model?, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = characterParts()
                local movedCharacter: Model? = engagedCharacter or (hiddenUnderMap and homeCharacter)
                local sameMap: boolean = currentRoundMap ~= nil
                    and type(findMM2Map) == "function" and findMM2Map() == currentRoundMap
                local mayReposition: boolean = sameMap and character ~= nil
                    and character == movedCharacter and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
                    and root ~= nil and isCharacterInActiveRound(root :: BasePart, currentRoundMap)
                restoreCharacter(false, not mayReposition)
            end
            wasInActiveRound = false
            currentRoundMap = nil
            busyLobbyPart = nil
            busyLobbyScanAt = 0
            bagAmount = 0
            bagLimit = 50
            fullHandled = false
            roundFullReached = false
            teleportedHomeThisRound = false
            homeCFrame = nil
            homeCharacter = nil
            -- scanCache can be Coin ESP's shared list: do not mutate it.
            scanCache = {}
            scanAt = 0
            table.clear(retryAt)
            table.clear(attempts)
            table.clear(blacklist)
            stuckPart = nil
            stuckSince = 0
            lastTouchPulse = 0
            travelPart = nil
            travelBestDistance = math.huge
            travelProgressAt = 0
            if not stillParked() then
                parkedCharacter, parkedMap, parkedReturn, parkedPosition = nil, nil, nil, nil
                destroySafeZonePlatform()
            end
        end

        local function enterRound(character: Model, root: BasePart, map: Instance): ()
            if wasInActiveRound and currentRoundMap == map then
                return
            end
            clearRound()
            wasInActiveRound = true
            currentRoundMap = map
            homeCFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, yawOf(root.CFrame), 0)
            homeCharacter = character
        end

        local function engage(
            character: Model,
            humanoid: Humanoid,
            root: BasePart
        ): ()
            if homeCharacter ~= character or not homeCFrame then
                local basePos: Vector3 = if hiddenUnderMap
                    then root.Position + Vector3.new(0, BELOW_OFFSET + 4, 0)
                    else root.Position
                homeCFrame = CFrame.new(basePos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yawOf(root.CFrame), 0)
                homeCharacter = character
            end
            if engaged and engagedMode ~= nil and engagedMode ~= settings.mode then
                -- Mode switched mid-round: undo the other mode's body changes.
                restoreCharacter(false)
            end
            engagedMode = settings.mode
            if engagedCharacter ~= nil and engagedCharacter ~= character then
                -- New body (respawn): the previous restore belongs to
                -- the old character; remember this one's start point.
                restoreCharacter(false)
                engagedMode = settings.mode
                if homeCharacter ~= character or not homeCFrame then
                    homeCFrame = root.CFrame
                    homeCharacter = character
                end
            end
            engagedCharacter = character
            if not engaged then
                engaged = true
                walkLastDistance = math.huge
                walkStuckSince = os.clock()
                if settings.mode ~= "Walk" then
                    hiddenUnderMap = false
                    forceNoClipCharacter(character)
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        local startPos: Vector3 = root.Position
                        if homeCFrame and startPos.Y >= homeCFrame.Position.Y - 1.0 then
                            startPos = Vector3.new(
                                startPos.X,
                                homeCFrame.Position.Y - BELOW_OFFSET,
                                startPos.Z
                            )
                        end
                        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos)
                            * CFrame.Angles(0, yawOf(root.CFrame), 0)
                        humanoid.PlatformStand = true
                        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                        if savedRootSize == nil then
                            savedRootSize = root.Size
                        end
                        root.Size = HITBOX_SIZE
                    end)
                end
                -- The server can teleport before the first Stepped callback.
                lastSteppedPosition = root.Position
            end
            if settings.mode == "Walk" then
                -- Walk on the real ground: collisions stay exactly as they are
                -- (NoClip would drop the character through the floor), and the
                -- slider is the WalkSpeed. The body is normalised once per
                -- engagement: a Below session (or the under-map hold) can leave
                -- PlatformStand, NoClip and the grown hitbox on, and a body in
                -- that state ignores Humanoid:Move completely -- which is why
                -- Walk "did nothing".
                hoverActive = false
                hoverTarget = nil
                if not walkBodyReady then
                    walkBodyReady = true
                    hiddenUnderMap = false
                    walkCarryDirection = nil
                    walkCarryUntil = 0
