local Module = {
    Name = "MM2 Fling Engine",
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

-- Internal MM2 engine only. Auto Farm and Auto Win keep their explicit fling
-- actions, while no Fling card or target action is installed in Universal.
function Module.init(runtime: any): any
    if Module.Initialized then return Module end
    local host: any = state.frameworkEnvironment
    local services: any = runtime and runtime.Services
    local Players: any = host.Players
    local LocalPlayer: any = host.LocalPlayer
    local getCharacterParts: any = host.getCharacterParts
    local notify: any = host.notify
    local activity: any = services and services.activity
    local protectedTargets: any = services and services.protectedTargets
    local configData: any = host.configData

    local workspace: any = host.workspace

    local function protectedCheck(player: Player?): boolean
        if not protectedTargets or type(protectedTargets.isProtected) ~= "function" then
            return false
        end
        local ok: boolean, result: any = pcall(protectedTargets.isProtected, player)
        return ok and result == true
    end

    -- v190: the MM2 Fling card is back (src/games/MM2/Other/Fling.lua), so the
    -- MM2.Fling* keys are no longer purged. The universal Fling module is still
    -- gone, and an "on" state saved by it must not be restored anywhere.
    if configData and type(configData.states) == "table" then
        configData.states["Universal.Fling"] = false
        configData.states["Universal.Fling.AutoFlingSelectedTarget"] = nil
        configData.states["MM2.Fling.AutoFlingSelectedTarget"] = nil
    end

    -- SkidFling (zqyDSUWX / YARHM), the fling every working menu copies:
    --
    --   RootPart.CFrame      = CFrame.new(targetPart.Position) * offset * spin
    --   RootPart.Velocity    = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e7 * 10, 9e7)
    --   RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
    --
    -- The local character is parked on the victim and given an absurd velocity
    -- while a finite-force BodyVelocity reinforces contact. The large impulse is
    -- applied briefly; the local body and other temporary state are restored
    -- afterwards. Actual transfer still depends on the server's physics.
    -- SkidFling adapted from the YARHM hub the user supplied
    -- (YARHM_Hub_KEYLESS_2026.txt, "Fling" -> SkidFling, originally by zqyDSUWX).
    -- MM2 callers supply a target; the engine keeps its power, prediction and retries.
    --
    -- The parts that matter and that our own port had wrong:
    --
    --   * The BodyVelocity named "EpixVel" drives at Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
    --     with finite 9e9 MaxForce. It is a catapult, not a pin: the local body is
    --     thrown into the victim. With Velocity zero (our old version) nothing is
    --     transferred, the character just sits there and the camera flickers.
    --   * The pose is written through RootPart.CFrame *and*
    --     Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame, then RootPart.Velocity/RotVelocity.
    --     No AssemblyLinearVelocity, no CustomPhysicalProperties: writing those
    --     every frame is what made our character look like it was fading.
    --   * Each pose is separated by task.wait() (Heartbeat, after physics), not
    --     RenderStepped.
    --   * Two pose sets: six poses while the victim is still (< 50 studs/s) and
    --     nine while it is already moving.
    -- Power 3 reproduces YARHM's numbers exactly (9e7 / 9e8); anything above
    -- scales BOTH textures of the trick (the pose velocity and the EpixVel pin),
    -- which is what makes the fling survive a laggy or fast-moving victim.
    local FLING_VELOCITY_BASE: Vector3 = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e7 * 10, 9e7)
    local FLING_ROT_VELOCITY_BASE: Vector3 = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
    local PIN_VELOCITY_BASE: Vector3 = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
    -- v180: finite force, like YARHM and SkidFling use. `math.huge` makes the
    -- solver fight itself on some servers (the pin "wins" every contact and the
    -- victim never receives the impulse), which is exactly the low success
    -- rate the former card was reporting.
    local PIN_FORCE: Vector3 = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)

    -- v180's default 6 doubles the pose velocity against YARHM's baseline.
    -- The universal card/slider are gone; MM2 retains this fixed default.
    local FLING_POWER: number = 6
    local FLING_DURATION: number = 3
    local FLING_PREDICTION: number = 0.15
    local flingRetries: number = 2
    -- Temporary boost used by the second pass only (never persisted).
    local flingBoost: number = 1

    local function powerScale(): number
        return (FLING_POWER / 3) * flingBoost
    end

    local function scaledVelocity(base: Vector3): Vector3
        local scale: number = powerScale()
        return Vector3.new(base.X * scale, base.Y * scale, base.Z * scale)
    end

    local flingRunning: boolean = false
    local engineActive: boolean = true
    local fullFlingPin: any = nil
    local stepPhase: number = 0
    local stepAngle: number = 0
    local lastOldPos: CFrame? = nil
    local stepPin: any = nil
    local stepPinToken: number = 0

    local function setFlingRunning(running: boolean): ()
        flingRunning = running
        if activity and type(activity.set) == "function" then
            activity.set("fling", running)
        end
    end

    local function targetParts(targetPlayer: Player?): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?, BasePart?, BasePart?)
        local targetCharacter: Model? = targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
        if not targetCharacter then
            return nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
        end
        local targetHumanoid: Humanoid? = targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local targetRoot: BasePart? = targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.RootPart or nil
        local targetHead: BasePart? = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
        return targetCharacter, targetHumanoid, targetRoot, targetHead, nil
    end

    -- FPos: the whole trick. Position on the victim part, then hand the assembly
    -- 9e7 and 9e8 so the contact solver launches the victim.
    local function fpos(
        character: Model,
        root: BasePart,
        basePart: BasePart,
        offset: CFrame,
        angles: CFrame,
        lead: Vector3?
    ): ()
        local origin: Vector3 = basePart.Position
        if lead then
            origin = origin + lead
        end
        local targetCFrame: CFrame = CFrame.new(origin) * offset * angles
        root.CFrame = targetCFrame
        -- The pose goes through the classic body movers only. Writing
        -- AssemblyLinearVelocity / AssemblyAngularVelocity every frame is the
        -- regression this engine already fixed twice: the modern solver reacts to
        -- the assembly write on the *local* body and the character reads as
        -- fading from the owner's camera. RootPart.CFrame plus
        -- Velocity/RotVelocity is the pair YARHM ships and the pair the suite
        -- asserts on (tools/test_fling_skid.py: assemblyWrites must stay 0).
        pcall(function(): ()
            character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(targetCFrame)
        end)
        local vel: Vector3 = scaledVelocity(FLING_VELOCITY_BASE)
        local rot: Vector3 = scaledVelocity(FLING_ROT_VELOCITY_BASE)
        -- Humanoid Physics like WalkFling helps replication
        local hum: Humanoid? = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.ChangeState then
            pcall(function(): ()
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
            end)
        end
        root.Velocity = vel
        root.RotVelocity = rot
        -- Extra noclip for the fling contact (like WalkFling)
        pcall(function(): ()
            for _, part: Instance in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    (part :: BasePart).CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Round trip / 2: how stale the server's copy of the victim is by the time it
    -- applies the pose we just wrote. With 300 ms of ping that is 150 ms of
    -- movement we have to lead with our own.
    local function transportSeconds(): number
        local ping: any = 0
        pcall(function(): ()
            local player: any = LocalPlayer
            if player and type(player.GetNetworkPing) == "function" then
                ping = player:GetNetworkPing()
            end
        end)
        if type(ping) ~= "number" or ping ~= ping or ping < 0 then
            ping = 0
        end
        -- GetNetworkPing returns seconds in current builds; older ones returned
        -- milliseconds. Anything above 2 is milliseconds.
        if ping > 2 then
            ping = ping / 1000
        end
        return math.clamp(ping * 0.5, 0, 0.5)
    end

    -- Where the victim will be when the server applies this pose: planar lead
    -- from its own velocity. Vertical lead is left out on purpose, it is the
    -- floor contact that carries the fling.
    local function leadFor(targetPart: BasePart?): Vector3?
        if not targetPart then
            return nil
        end
        local velocity: any = Vector3.zero
        pcall(function(): ()
            velocity = targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        end)
        if type(velocity) ~= "userdata" and type(velocity) ~= "table" then
            return nil
        end
        local seconds: number = math.clamp(
            transportSeconds() + FLING_PREDICTION,
            0,
            0.6
        )
        if seconds <= 0.001 then
            return nil
        end
        local lead: any = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z) * seconds
        return lead :: Vector3
    end

    -- The victim's own parts can be replaced (respawn, ragdoll, tool swap) while
    -- the fling runs; re-read them every pose instead of caching the first pair.
    local function liveTargetParts(
        targetPlayer: Player,
        targetCharacter: Model
    ): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?, BasePart?)
        local character: Model? = targetPlayer.Character or targetCharacter
        if not character or not character.Parent then
            return nil, nil, nil, nil
        end
        local humanoid: Humanoid? = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root: BasePart? = humanoid and humanoid.RootPart or nil
        local head: BasePart? = character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
        return character, humanoid, root, head
    end

    local function partSpeed(part: BasePart?): number
        return if part then part.Velocity.Magnitude else 0
    end

    -- cloneReference() gives the host a DIFFERENT reference for the same
    -- service, so "targetPlayer.Parent ~= Players" can stop the fling early.
    -- Resolve the player through the service instead.
    local function playerStillHere(player: Player): boolean
        return Players:FindFirstChild(player.Name) ~= nil
    end

    -- SFBasePart: YARHM's choreography (six poses while the victim is slow, ten
    -- while it is already moving), with the menu's adaptations:
    --
    --   * MIN_POSES before the "it is flying, stop" check, so one stale
    --     replication frame does not end the fling early;
    --   * the victim's parts are re-read on every pose (respawn, ragdoll);
    --   * each pose is led by the victim's own velocity times half the ping, so a
    --     300 ms connection still lands the contact.
    local MIN_POSES: number = 12

    local function sfBasePart(
        character: Model,
        humanoid: Humanoid,
        root: BasePart,
        basePart: BasePart,
        targetCharacter: Model,
        targetPlayer: Player,
        targetHumanoid: Humanoid?,
        targetRoot: BasePart?,
        timeToWait: number,
        shouldStop: (() -> boolean)?,
        stats: any
    ): ()
        local startedAt: number = os.clock()
        local angle: number = 0
        local liveBase: BasePart = basePart

        local function currentBasePart(): BasePart?
            local characterNow: Model?, humanoidNow: Humanoid?, rootNow: BasePart?, headNow: BasePart? =
                liveTargetParts(targetPlayer, targetCharacter)
            if not characterNow then
                return nil
            end
            targetCharacter = characterNow
            targetHumanoid = humanoidNow or targetHumanoid
            targetRoot = rootNow or targetRoot
            local candidate: BasePart? = rootNow
            if rootNow and headNow then
                if (rootNow.Position - headNow.Position).Magnitude > 5 then
                    candidate = headNow
                end
            elseif headNow then
                candidate = headNow
            end
            if candidate and candidate.Parent then
                liveBase = candidate
            end
            return liveBase
        end

        local function pose(offset: CFrame, angles: CFrame): boolean
            -- Stop between individual yielded poses, not only once per group.
            if shouldStop and shouldStop() then return false end
            local part: BasePart? = currentBasePart()
            if not part then
                return false
            end
            fpos(character, root, part, offset, angles, leadFor(part))
            stats.poses += 1
            task.wait()
            return true
        end

        repeat
            if not root or not targetHumanoid then
                break
            end
            if shouldStop and shouldStop() then
                break
            end
            local part: BasePart? = currentBasePart()
            if not part then
                break
            end
            local speed: number = partSpeed(part)
            local moveDirection: Vector3 = Vector3.zero
            local walkSpeed: number = 16
            pcall(function(): ()
                moveDirection = targetHumanoid.MoveDirection
                walkSpeed = targetHumanoid.WalkSpeed
            end)
            if speed < 50 then
                angle = angle + 100
                local lead: Vector3 = moveDirection * (speed / 1.25)
                local spin: CFrame = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(angle), 0, 0)
                pose(CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + lead, spin)
                pose(CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + lead, spin)
                pose(CFrame.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25) + lead, spin)
                pose(CFrame.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25) + lead, spin)
                pose(CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + moveDirection, spin)
                pose(CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + moveDirection, spin)
            else
                local downLead: number = partSpeed(targetRoot) / 1.25
                pose(CFrame.new(0, 1.5, walkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                pose(CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -walkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                pose(CFrame.new(0, 1.5, walkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                pose(CFrame.new(0, 1.5, downLead), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                pose(CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -downLead), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                pose(CFrame.new(0, 1.5, downLead), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                pose(CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                pose(CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                pose(CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))
                pose(CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
            end
        until (stats.poses >= MIN_POSES and partSpeed(liveBase) > 500)
            or not liveBase.Parent
            or targetPlayer.Character ~= targetCharacter
            or not playerStillHere(targetPlayer)
            or (targetHumanoid ~= nil and targetHumanoid.Sit)
            or humanoid.Health <= 0
            or os.clock() > startedAt + timeToWait
            or stats.poses >= 600
    end

    local function createPin(root: BasePart): any
        local pin: any = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        pin.Name = "EpixVel"
        pin.Velocity = scaledVelocity(PIN_VELOCITY_BASE)
        pin.MaxForce = PIN_FORCE
        pin.Parent = root
        return pin
    end

    local function destroyPin(pin: any): ()
        if pin then pin:Destroy() end
    end

    -- Per-frame caller (Auto Win's Fling Sheriff). Same FPos pose, with a pin
    -- that is cleaned up 0.5 s after the last call so the local body is never
    -- left with an infinite-force catapult attached.
    local function flingSingleStep(
        character: Model,
        humanoid: Humanoid,
        root: BasePart,
        targetPlayer: Player,
        _savedCollide: any,
        _savedProps: any
    ): boolean
        local targetCharacter: Model?, targetHumanoid: Humanoid?, targetRoot: BasePart?, targetHead: BasePart? =
            targetParts(targetPlayer)
        if not targetCharacter or not targetHead and not targetRoot then
            return false
        end
        if targetHumanoid and (targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 or targetHumanoid.Sit) then
            return false
        end
        if not targetHumanoid then
            return false
        end
        local basePart: BasePart = targetRoot or targetHead :: BasePart
        if targetRoot and targetHead then
            if (targetRoot.Position - targetHead.Position).Magnitude > 5 then
                basePart = targetHead
            end
        end
        if activity and type(activity.set) == "function" then
            activity.set("fling", true)
        end
        if not stepPin then
            stepPin = createPin(root)
        end
        stepPinToken += 1
        local myToken: number = stepPinToken
        task.delay(0.5, function(): ()
            if myToken == stepPinToken then
                destroyPin(stepPin)
                stepPin = nil
                if not flingRunning and activity and type(activity.set) == "function" then
                    activity.set("fling", false)
                end
            end
        end)
        stepAngle = (stepAngle + 100) % 360
        local speed: number = 0
        pcall(function(): ()
            speed = basePart.Velocity.Magnitude
        end)
        if speed < 50 then
            stepPhase = (stepPhase + 1) % 6
            local offsets: {CFrame} = {
                CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0),
                CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0),
                CFrame.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25),
                CFrame.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25),
                CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0),
                CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0),
            }
            fpos(character, root, basePart, offsets[stepPhase + 1], CFrame.Angles(math.rad(stepAngle), 0, 0))
        else
            fpos(character, root, basePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
        end
        return true
    end

    local function performFling(targetPlayer: Player?, options: {[string]: any}?): boolean
        if not Module.Initialized or not targetPlayer then
            return false
        end
        if protectedCheck(targetPlayer) then
            notify("player protected")
            return false
        end
        local silent: boolean = type(options) == "table" and options.silent == true
        local maxDuration: number = (type(options) == "table" and tonumber(options.duration))
            or FLING_DURATION
        local requestedStop: (() -> boolean)? = type(options) == "table"
            and type(options.shouldStop) == "function"
            and options.shouldStop
            or nil
        local function shouldStop(): boolean
            return not engineActive or (requestedStop ~= nil and requestedStop())
        end
        -- Auto Farm opts out of returning to an old round after cancellation.
        -- Other callers (including Auto Win) retain their existing return policy.
        local skipReturnOnStop: boolean = type(options) == "table" and options.skipReturnOnStop == true
        local returnCFrame: CFrame? = type(options) == "table"
            and typeof(options.returnCFrame) == "CFrame"
            and options.returnCFrame
            or nil
        -- v190: the MM2 Fling card passes its Power/Retries rows through
        -- options instead of the engine keeping global state. Callers that send
        -- nothing (Auto Farm, Auto Win) keep the documented defaults.
        local requestedPower: number? = nil
        local requestedRetries: number? = nil
        if type(options) == "table" then
            local power: number? = tonumber(options.power)
            if power then requestedPower = math.clamp(power, 1, 12) end
            local retries: number? = tonumber(options.retries)
            if retries then requestedRetries = math.clamp(math.floor(retries), 0, 3) end
        end

        if flingRunning then
            if not silent then
                notify("fling already running")
            end
            return false
        end

        setFlingRunning(true)

        local stats: any = {poses = 0, speed = 0, pinned = false, retries = 0}

        local function runFling(): boolean
            local character: Model?, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = getCharacterParts()
            if not character or not humanoid or not root then
                setFlingRunning(false)
                if not silent then
                    notify("character not ready")
                end
                return false
            end

            local targetCharacter: Model?, targetHumanoid: Humanoid?, targetRoot: BasePart?, targetHead: BasePart? =
                targetParts(targetPlayer)
            if not targetCharacter or not targetCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
                setFlingRunning(false)
                if not silent then
                    notify("No valid character of said target player. May have died.")
                end
                return false
            end
            if not targetHumanoid then
                setFlingRunning(false)
                if not silent then
                    notify("the target has no humanoid")
                end
                return false
            end

            if partSpeed(root) < 50 then
                lastOldPos = root.CFrame
            end
            local oldPos: CFrame = returnCFrame or lastOldPos or root.CFrame

            local savedDestroyHeight: any = nil
            pcall(function(): ()
                savedDestroyHeight = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
            end)
            local camera: Camera? = workspace.CurrentCamera

            local pin: any = nil
            local success: boolean, errorMessage: any = pcall(function(): ()
                if camera then
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        local accessory: any = targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
                        camera.CameraSubject = targetHead
                            or (accessory and accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle"))
                            or targetHumanoid
                    end)
                end

                -- FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0 while the local body crosses the
                -- map at 9e8 studs/s; always restored below.
                pcall(function(): ()
                    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0 / 0
                end)

                pin = createPin(root)
                fullFlingPin = pin
                stats.pinned = true
                pcall(function(): ()
                    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
                end)

                local basePart: BasePart? = nil
                if targetRoot and targetHead then
                    if (targetRoot.Position - targetHead.Position).Magnitude > 5 then
                        basePart = targetHead
                    else
                        basePart = targetRoot
                    end
                elseif targetRoot then
                    basePart = targetRoot
                elseif targetHead then
                    basePart = targetHead
                end

                -- Retries can switch parts and temporarily boost force.
                local maxPasses: number = math.clamp(
                    math.floor(tonumber(flingRetries) or 0),
                    0,
                    3
                ) + 1
                local used: BasePart? = nil
                local pass: number = 0
                while pass < maxPasses do
                    if shouldStop and shouldStop() then break end
                    pass += 1
                    local partNow: BasePart? = nil
                    if pass == 1 then
                        partNow = basePart
                    else
                        local _c: Model?, _h: Humanoid?, rootNow: BasePart?, headNow: BasePart? =
                            liveTargetParts(targetPlayer, targetCharacter)
                        targetHumanoid = _h or targetHumanoid
                        targetRoot = rootNow or targetRoot
                        local primary: BasePart? = rootNow
                        if rootNow and headNow then
                            if (rootNow.Position - headNow.Position).Magnitude > 5 then
                                primary = headNow
                            end
                        elseif headNow then
                            primary = headNow
                        end
                        if primary == used then
                            partNow = if primary == rootNow then headNow else rootNow
                        else
                            partNow = primary
                        end
                        if partNow then
                            flingBoost = 1.5
                            stats.retries = (stats.retries or 0) + 1
                        end
                    end
                    if not partNow or not partNow.Parent then
                        flingBoost = 1
                        break
                    end
                    used = partNow
                    sfBasePart(
                        character,
                        humanoid,
                        root,
                        partNow,
                        targetCharacter,
                        targetPlayer,
                        targetHumanoid,
                        targetRoot,
                        -- Retries are half as long: they exist to catch a late
                        -- server contact, not to double the time spent posing.
                        if pass > 1 then maxDuration * 0.5 else maxDuration,
                        shouldStop,
                        stats
                    )
                    flingBoost = 1
                    stats.speed = math.max(
                        stats.speed or 0,
                        partSpeed(targetRoot),
                        partSpeed(targetHead)
                    )
                    if stats.speed > 100 then
                        break
                    end
                end
                stats.speed = math.max(
                    stats.speed or 0,
                    partSpeed(targetRoot),
                    partSpeed(targetHead)
                )
            end)

            -- The pin and temporary world state must be restored even if a pose
            -- failed. No secondary impulse is applied to the target.
            flingBoost = 1
            destroyPin(pin)
            if fullFlingPin == pin then fullFlingPin = nil end
            pcall(function(): ()
                humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
            end)
            pcall(function(): ()
                workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = savedDestroyHeight
            end)
            local finalCharacter: Model?, finalHumanoid: Humanoid?, finalRoot: BasePart? =
                getCharacterParts()
            local cancelled: boolean = not engineActive or (skipReturnOnStop and shouldStop())
            if camera then
                pcall(function(): ()
                    camera.CameraSubject = if cancelled then (finalHumanoid or humanoid) else humanoid
                end)
            end

            local function stopBodyMotion(body: Model): ()
                for _, descendant: Instance in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local bodyPart: BasePart = descendant :: BasePart
                        bodyPart.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                        bodyPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end
                end
            end
            if cancelled then
                -- A server teleport/new round may already have moved the body.
                -- Release the old fling velocity, but never move a new body or
                -- return the lobby body to the previous map's saved CFrame.
                pcall(stopBodyMotion, character)
            elseif finalCharacter and finalRoot and finalRoot.Parent then
                local attempts: number = 0
                repeat
                    if not engineActive or (skipReturnOnStop and shouldStop()) then
                        pcall(stopBodyMotion, character)
                        break
                    end
                    attempts += 1
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        finalRoot.CFrame = oldPos * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
                        finalCharacter:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(oldPos * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0))
                        if finalHumanoid then
                            pcall(function(): ()
                                finalHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                            end)
                        end
                        stopBodyMotion(finalCharacter)
                    end)
                    task.wait()
                until (finalRoot.Position - oldPos.Position).Magnitude < 25 or attempts >= 60
            end

            setFlingRunning(false)
            local touchedTarget: boolean = stats.speed > 100
            pcall(function(): ()
                state.mm2LastFling = {
                    target = tostring(targetPlayer.Name),
                    poses = stats.poses,
                    speed = stats.speed,
                    pinned = stats.pinned,
                    retries = stats.retries,
                    power = powerScale(),
                    ok = success,
                }
            end)
            if not Module.Initialized then
                return touchedTarget
            end
            if not silent then
                local speedText: string = tostring(math.floor(stats.speed))
                if not success then
                    notify("fling failed: " .. tostring(errorMessage))
                elseif touchedTarget then
                    notify(string.format(
                        "fling: %s sent flying (%s studs/s, %d poses%s)",
                        tostring(targetPlayer.Name),
                        speedText,
                        stats.poses,
                        (stats.retries or 0) > 0
                            and string.format(", %d retries", stats.retries)
                            or ""
                    ))
                else
                    notify(string.format(
                        "fling: %s did not move (%d poses, %s studs/s)",
                        tostring(targetPlayer.Name),
                        stats.poses,
                        speedText
                    ))
                end
            end
            return touchedTarget
        end

        -- Any error must reset flingRunning, otherwise every later fling answers
        -- "fling already running" for the rest of the session.
        local function guardedRun(): boolean
            local savedPower: number = FLING_POWER
            local savedRetries: number = flingRetries
            if requestedPower then FLING_POWER = requestedPower end
            if requestedRetries then flingRetries = requestedRetries end
            local ok: boolean, result: any = pcall(runFling)
            -- Restore before anything else: the engine is a single-fling
            -- machine and a later caller must not inherit this card's rows.
            FLING_POWER, flingRetries = savedPower, savedRetries
            if not ok then
                setFlingRunning(false)
                if not silent then
                    notify("fling error: " .. tostring(result))
                end
                return false
            end
            return result == true
        end

        if type(options) == "table" and options.blocking == true then
            return guardedRun()
        end
        task.spawn(guardedRun)
        return true
    end

    state.mm2PerformFling = performFling
    state.mm2FlingStep = flingSingleStep
    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        engineActive = false
        destroyPin(fullFlingPin)
        fullFlingPin = nil
        flingRunning = false
        stepPinToken += 1
        destroyPin(stepPin)
        stepPin = nil
        setFlingRunning(false)
        state.mm2PerformFling = nil
        state.mm2FlingStep = nil
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return Module
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then pcall(activeCleanup) end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

local Module = {
    Name = "MM2 Get All Emotes",
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
    Runtime = nil :: any,
}

local activeCleanup: () -> () = function(): () end

function Module.init(runtime: any): any
    if Module.Initialized then
        return Module
    end
    local core: any = state.mm2Core
    assert(type(core) == "table", "MM2 Get All Emotes requires the MM2 core module")
    Module.Runtime = runtime

    type EmoteDef = {
        id: string,
        label: string,
        command: string,
        animationId: string,
        looped: boolean?,
    }

    -- The five shop animations plus the two event animations the player asked
    -- to keep. These are a fallback from the captured MM2 Database.Sync.Emotes;
    -- the live catalog can contribute other playable non-default emotes too.
    local EMOTES: {EmoteDef} = {
        { id = "sit", label = "Sit", command = "sit2", animationId = "rbxassetid://2431845940", looped = true },
        { id = "ninja", label = "Ninja Rest", command = "ninja", animationId = "rbxassetid://2431864798", looped = true },
        { id = "zen", label = "Zen", command = "zen", animationId = "rbxassetid://2431812646", looped = true },
        { id = "dab", label = "Dab", command = "dab", animationId = "rbxassetid://2445521505" },
        { id = "floss", label = "Floss", command = "floss", animationId = "rbxassetid://2452938820", looped = true },
        { id = "zombie", label = "Zombie", command = "zombie", animationId = "rbxassetid://2513692312", looped = true },
        { id = "headless", label = "Headless", command = "headless", animationId = "rbxassetid://2513664073" },
    }
    local LABELS: {string} = {}
    local ID_BY_LABEL: {[string]: string} = {}
    local KNOWN_IDS: {[string]: boolean} = {}
    local DEFAULT_IDS: {[string]: boolean} = {
        back = true, wave = true, cheer = true, laugh = true, point = true,
        dance = true, dance1 = true, dance2 = true, dance3 = true,
    }
    for _, def: EmoteDef in ipairs(EMOTES) do
        table.insert(LABELS, def.label)
        ID_BY_LABEL[def.label] = def.id
        KNOWN_IDS[def.id] = true
    end

    local selectedLabel: string = "Floss"
    local selectionTouched: boolean = false
    local activeTrack: any = nil
    local feature: any = nil
    local generation: number = 0
    local grantInFlight: boolean = false
    local catalogInFlight: boolean = false
    local activated: boolean = false

    local function stopActiveTrack(): ()
        if activeTrack then
            pcall(function(): () activeTrack:Stop(0.1) end)
            activeTrack = nil
        end
    end

    local function animationUri(value: any): string?
        if type(value) == "number" and value > 0 and value < math.huge then
            return "rbxassetid://" .. string.format("%.0f", value)
        end
        if type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
            return string.match(value, "^%d+$") and ("rbxassetid://" .. value) or value
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- New MM2 animations should not be silently excluded just because the
    -- captured catalog is older. Admit only playable catalog entries, never
    -- the known Roblox defaults or the non-emote Back row. This runs in the
    -- asynchronous grant path, since require may wait for game data.
    local function discoverLiveEmotes(ticket: number): ()
        local rs: Instance = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local db: Instance? = rs:FindFirstChild("Database")
        local sync: Instance? = db and db:FindFirstChild("Sync")
        local emotesModule: Instance? = sync and sync:FindFirstChild("Emotes")
        if not emotesModule then return end
        local ok: boolean, catalog: any = pcall(require, emotesModule)
        if ticket ~= generation or not Module.Initialized
            or not ok or type(catalog) ~= "table" then
            return
        end
        local extra: {string} = {}
        for id: any, live: any in pairs(catalog) do
            if type(id) == "string" and not KNOWN_IDS[id]
                and not DEFAULT_IDS[string.lower(id)] and type(live) == "table"
                and type(live.Command) == "string" and live.Command ~= ""
                and not DEFAULT_IDS[string.lower(live.Command)]
                and animationUri(live.AnimationID) then
                table.insert(extra, id)
            end
        end
        table.sort(extra)
        for _, id: string in ipairs(extra) do
            local live: any = catalog[id]
            local label: string = type(live.Name) == "string" and live.Name ~= "" and live.Name or id
            if ID_BY_LABEL[label] then label ..= " (" .. id .. ")" end
            local def: EmoteDef = {
                id = id,
                label = label,
                command = live.Command,
                animationId = animationUri(live.AnimationID) :: string,
                looped = live.Loop == true,
            }
            table.insert(EMOTES, def)
            table.insert(LABELS, label)
            ID_BY_LABEL[label] = id
            KNOWN_IDS[id] = true
        end
        -- A saved selection for a newly discovered emote was not available
        -- when the cycle was built. Restore it silently unless the user has
        -- already chosen another value during this session.
        local values: any = type(configData) == "table" and configData.values or nil
        local saved: any = type(values) == "table" and values["MM2.GetAllEmotes.SelectEmote"] or nil
        local index: number? = type(saved) == "string" and table.find(LABELS, saved) or nil
        if not selectionTouched and index and ID_BY_LABEL[saved] then
            selectedLabel = saved
            local control: any = state.valueControls and state.valueControls["MM2.GetAllEmotes.SelectEmote"]
            if control and type(control.setIndex) == "function" then
                control.setIndex(index)
            end
        end
    end

    local function emoteDefinition(id: string): EmoteDef?
        local result: EmoteDef? = nil
        for _, def: EmoteDef in ipairs(EMOTES) do
            if def.id == id then
                result = table.clone(def)
                break
            end
        end
        if not result then
            return nil
        end
        pcall(function(): ()
            local rs: Instance = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local db: Instance? = rs:FindFirstChild("Database")
            local sync: Instance? = db and db:FindFirstChild("Sync")
            local emotesModule: Instance? = sync and sync:FindFirstChild("Emotes")
            if not emotesModule then return end
            local ok: boolean, catalog: any = pcall(require, emotesModule)
            local live: any = ok and type(catalog) == "table" and catalog[id] or nil
            if type(live) ~= "table" then return end
            local def: EmoteDef = result :: EmoteDef
            if type(live.Command) == "string" and live.Command ~= "" then
                def.command = live.Command
            end
            local asset: string? = animationUri(live.AnimationID)
            if asset then def.animationId = asset end
            def.looped = live.Loop == true
        end)
        return result
    end

    -- The old menu has a separate GenerateEmotes method. The current
    -- CrossPlatform GUI does not: it listens to InventoryDataChanged instead.
    -- Never require the old EmoteModule without its controller/GUI: that module
    -- waits indefinitely for _G.EmoteController in the newer interface.
    local function refreshLegacyGui(rs: Instance, owned: {string}): boolean
        local globals: any = _G :: any
        local gui: any = globals and globals.EmoteFrame
        if not gui or type(globals.EmoteController) ~= "table" then return false end
        local valid: boolean, pages: any = pcall(function(): any
            return gui:FindFirstChild("EmotePages")
        end)
        if not valid or not pages then return false end
        local modules: Instance? = rs:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local scriptModule: Instance? = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("EmoteModule")
        if not scriptModule then return false end
        local ok: boolean, emoteModule: any = pcall(require, scriptModule)
        if not ok or type(emoteModule) ~= "table"
            or type(emoteModule.GenerateEmotes) ~= "function" then
            return false
        end
        emoteModule.EmoteGUI = gui
        return pcall(emoteModule.GenerateEmotes, owned, gui)
    end

    -- Modifying ProfileData is client-side only. The native BindableEvent must
    -- be fired on the instance itself: .Event is an RBXScriptSignal and has no
    -- Fire method. Both old and CrossPlatform controllers listen to .Event.
    local function grantShopEmotes(ticket: number): (boolean, number, boolean)
        if ticket ~= generation or not Module.Initialized then return false, 0, false end
        local ok: boolean, ready: any, added: any, refreshed: any = pcall(function(): (boolean, number, boolean)
            local rs: Instance = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local modules: Instance? = rs:FindFirstChild("Modules")
            local profileModule: Instance? = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("ProfileData")
            if not profileModule then return false, 0, false end
            local profileOk: boolean, profile: any = pcall(require, profileModule)
            if ticket ~= generation or not Module.Initialized then return false, 0, false end
            if not profileOk or type(profile) ~= "table"
                or type(profile.Emotes) ~= "table"
                or type(profile.Emotes.Owned) ~= "table" then
                return false, 0, false
            end
            local owned: {string} = profile.Emotes.Owned
            local known: {[string]: boolean} = {}
            for _, existing: any in ipairs(owned) do
                if type(existing) == "string" then known[existing] = true end
            end
            local newIds: {string} = {}
            for _, def: EmoteDef in ipairs(EMOTES) do
                if not known[def.id] then
                    table.insert(owned, def.id)
                    known[def.id] = true
                    table.insert(newIds, def.id)
                end
            end

            local remotes: Instance? = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local inventory: Instance? = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
            local changed: any = inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("InventoryDataChanged")
            local signalled: boolean = false
            if changed then
                -- Incremental inventory listeners need each new ID. An
                -- idempotent repeat still wakes the emote window once.
                local wakeIds: {string} = #newIds > 0 and newIds or { EMOTES[1].id }
                for _, id: string in ipairs(wakeIds) do
                    local fired: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
                        changed:Fire("Emotes", id, 1)
                    end)
                    signalled = signalled or fired
                end
            end
            if not signalled then
                signalled = refreshLegacyGui(rs, owned)
            end
            return true, #newIds, signalled
        end)
        if not ok then return false, 0, false end
        return ready == true, tonumber(added) or 0, refreshed == true
    end

    local function requestGrant(showNotification: boolean): ()
        if grantInFlight then
            if showNotification and type(notify) == "function" then
                pcall(notify, "Get All Emotes: waiting for the MM2 profile.")
            end
            return
        end
        grantInFlight = true
        local ticket: number = generation
        -- ProfileData's require can yield while the game loads; keep the menu
        -- responsive and ignore the result if this instance was destroyed.
        task.spawn(function(): ()
            local ready: boolean, added: number, refreshed: boolean = grantShopEmotes(ticket)
            if ticket ~= generation or not Module.Initialized then return end
            grantInFlight = false
            if not ready then
                if feature then feature:SetStatus("profile not ready") end
                if showNotification and type(notify) == "function" then
                    pcall(notify, "Get All Emotes: MM2 profile unavailable or not ready; try again after the game loads.")
                end
                return
            end
            local count: number = #EMOTES
            if feature then
                feature:SetStatus(refreshed and (tostring(count) .. " local emotes")
                    or (tostring(count) .. " local · UI not refreshed"))
            end
            if showNotification and type(notify) == "function" then
                local suffix: string = refreshed
                    and "The emote UI was notified."
                    or "The MM2 emote UI could not be notified; try again after it loads."
                pcall(notify, string.format(
                    "Get All Emotes: %d local entries (%d new). %s Server ownership is not verified.",
                    count, added, suffix
                ))
            end
            -- Do not let a slow/hung catalog require block the seven known
            -- entries. If it finds extras later, add and signal them in a
            -- second pass; at most one discovery may be waiting at a time.
            if not catalogInFlight then
                catalogInFlight = true
                task.spawn(function(): ()
                    if ticket ~= generation or not Module.Initialized then
                        catalogInFlight = false
                        return
                    end
                    local previous: number = #EMOTES
                    pcall(discoverLiveEmotes, ticket)
                    catalogInFlight = false
                    if ticket == generation and Module.Initialized and #EMOTES > previous then
                        requestGrant(false)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function activate(): ()
        activated = true
        if featureConnections.MM2GetAllEmotesRespawn or not (LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded) then
            return
        end
        featureConnections.MM2GetAllEmotesRespawn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(): ()
            local ticket: number = generation
            task.delay(0.5, function(): ()
                if ticket == generation and Module.Initialized and activated then
                    requestGrant(false)
                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- A successful :Fire is just a request, not confirmation of playback or
    -- replication. Fall back to the local Animator only when no native event
    -- could be fired; doing both would play two tracks at once.
    local function requestEmotePlayback(id: string): boolean
        stopActiveTrack()
        local def: EmoteDef? = emoteDefinition(id)
        if not def then return false end
        local fired: boolean = false
        pcall(function(): ()
            local rs: Instance = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local remotes: Instance? = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local misc: Instance? = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Misc")
            local event: any = misc and misc:FindFirstChild("PlayEmote")
            if event then
                fired = pcall(function(): () event:Fire(id) end)
            end
        end)
        if fired then return true end
        if def.animationId == "" then return false end

        local played: boolean = false
        pcall(function(): ()
            local character: Model? = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
            local humanoid: Humanoid? = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
            local anim: Animation = Instance.new("Animation")
            anim.Name = def.command
            anim.AnimationId = def.animationId
            local animator: Animator? = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            local loaded: boolean, track: any = pcall(function(): any
                return if animator then animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
                    else (humanoid :: any):LoadAnimation(anim)
            end)
            if loaded and track then
                activeTrack = track
                played = pcall(function(): ()
                    track.Looped = def.looped == true
                    track:Play(0.1)
                end)
            end
            anim:Destroy()
        end)
        return played
    end

    local function playSelected(): ()
        activate()
        requestGrant(false)
        local id: string = ID_BY_LABEL[selectedLabel] or "floss"
        if not requestEmotePlayback(id) and type(notify) == "function" then
            pcall(notify, "Could not request that emote; check the character and animation permissions.")
        end
    end

    feature = createUniversalFeature(
        "Get All Emotes",
        "Adds MM2's playable non-default emotes locally, including Sit, Ninja Rest, Zen, Dab, Floss, Zombie and Headless. "
            .. "It does not grant server ownership; playback and replication depend on the game.",
        11,
        function(): ()
            activate()
            requestGrant(true)
        end,
        {
            categoryName = "Utilities",
            parent = MM2Scroll,
            registry = mm2Features,
            action = true,
            noOptions = false,
            configKey = "MM2.GetAllEmotes",
        }
    )
    state.mm2GetAllEmotesFeature = feature

    -- Restoring the saved selection at boot must not play/grant anything.
    local cycleRestored: boolean = false
    addCycleOption(feature, "Select Emote", LABELS, 5, function(value: string): ()
        selectedLabel = value
        if not cycleRestored then
            cycleRestored = true
            return
        end
        selectionTouched = true
        playSelected()
    end, "Select and request an MM2 emote; server ownership is not changed.")
    addActionOption(feature, "Play Emote", playSelected, "Request the selected emote again.")
    addInformationOption(feature,
        "MM2's playable emotes are added locally. Existing inventory is preserved; avatar defaults "
            .. "are not added, and the server controls ownership and replication.")

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        generation += 1
        activated = false
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2GetAllEmotesRespawn")
        stopActiveTrack()
        if state.mm2GetAllEmotesFeature == feature then
            state.mm2GetAllEmotesFeature = nil
        end
    end
    Module.Events = featureConnections
    Module.Initialized = true
    return Module
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if not Module.Initialized then return end
    Module.Initialized = false
    pcall(activeCleanup)
    activeCleanup = function(): () end
    Module.Events = {}
    Module.Runtime = nil
end

return Module

local Module = {
    Name = "MM2 Gun Aura",
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
    Runtime = nil :: any,
}

local activeCleanup: () -> () = function(): () end

function Module.init(runtime: any): any
    if Module.Initialized then
        return Module
    end
    local core: any = state.mm2Core
    assert(type(core) == "table", "MM2 Gun Aura requires the MM2 core module")
    Module.Runtime = runtime

    local settings = {
        studs = 25,
        showHitbox = true,
    }

    local TICK_INTERVAL: number = 0.08
    local SCAN_INTERVAL: number = 0.4
    local ESP_INTERVAL: number = 0.5

    local gunAuraActive = false
    local gunHitboxes: {[Instance]: BasePart} = {}
    local espParts: {[Player]: BasePart} = {}
    local savedGunStates: {[BasePart]: {cframe: CFrame, canCollide: boolean}} = {}
    local trackedDrops: {[Instance]: boolean} = {}
    local lastScanAt: number = -math.huge
    local lastTickAt: number = -math.huge
    local lastEspAt: number = -math.huge

    local function resolveGunTouchPart(gun: Instance?): BasePart?
        if not gun then
            return nil
        end
        if gun:IsA("BasePart") then
            return gun :: BasePart
        end
        local handle: Instance? = gun:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            or gun:FindFirstChild("GunDrop")
            or gun:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
            return handle :: BasePart
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function rememberGunPartState(part: BasePart): {cframe: CFrame, canCollide: boolean}
        local existing = savedGunStates[part]
        if existing then
            return existing
        end
        local snap = {cframe = part.CFrame, canCollide = part.CanCollide}
        savedGunStates[part] = snap
        return snap
    end

    local function restoreGunPartState(part: BasePart): ()
        local snap = savedGunStates[part]
        if not snap then
            return
        end
        if part and part.Parent then
            pcall(function(): ()
                part.CFrame = snap.cframe
                part.CanCollide = snap.canCollide
            end)
        end
        savedGunStates[part] = nil
    end

    local function restoreAllGunPartStates(): ()
        for part in pairs(savedGunStates) do
            restoreGunPartState(part)
        end
        table.clear(savedGunStates)
    end

    local function trueGunPartPosition(part: BasePart): Vector3
        local snap = savedGunStates[part]
        return if snap then snap.cframe.Position else part.Position
    end

    local function canGrabGun(): boolean
        local character = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then
            return false
        end

        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        if type(core.getPlayerRole) == "function" then
            local role = core.getPlayerRole(LocalPlayer)
            if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" then
                return false
            end
        end

        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if (backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") or backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife")))
            or character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
            return false
        end

        return true
    end

    local function isValidGunDrop(obj: Instance?): boolean
        if not obj or not obj.Parent then
            return false
        end
        if obj.Name == "GunDrop" and (obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Model")) then
            return resolveGunTouchPart(obj) ~= nil
        end
        return false
    end

    local function createGunHitbox(gun: Instance): BasePart?
        local handle = resolveGunTouchPart(gun)
        if not handle then
            return nil
        end
        rememberGunPartState(handle)
        local pos = trueGunPartPosition(handle)
        if not pos then
            return nil
        end

        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = "WurstGunAuraHitbox"
        part.Size = Vector3.new(settings.studs, settings.studs, settings.studs)
        part.Transparency = 0.65
        part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
        part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.CanQuery = false
        part.CanTouch = false
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
        part.Parent = workspace

        return part
    end

    -- Lightweight GunDrop discovery: uses DescendantAdded events + top-level
    -- workspace children every 0.4s (never recursive GetDescendants).
    local function refreshTrackedDrops(now: number): ()
        if now - lastScanAt < SCAN_INTERVAL then
            return
        end
        lastScanAt = now

        local wsDrop: Instance? = workspace:FindFirstChild("GunDrop")
        if wsDrop and isValidGunDrop(wsDrop) then
            trackedDrops[wsDrop] = true
        end

        local okChildren: boolean, children: any = pcall(function(): any
            return workspace:GetChildren()
        end)
        if okChildren and type(children) == "table" then
            for _, child: Instance in ipairs(children) do
                if child.Name == "GunDrop" and isValidGunDrop(child) then
                    trackedDrops[child] = true
                elseif child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder") then
                    local gd: Instance? = child:FindFirstChild("GunDrop")
                    if gd and isValidGunDrop(gd) then
                        trackedDrops[gd] = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if type(core.findDroppedGun) == "function" then
            local okCore: boolean, drop: any = pcall(core.findDroppedGun)
            if okCore and drop and isValidGunDrop(drop) then
                trackedDrops[drop] = true
            end
        end
    end

    local function isWithinAura(truePos: Vector3, rootPos: Vector3): boolean
        local diff = rootPos - truePos
        local radius = settings.studs
        if diff.X * diff.X + diff.Y * diff.Y + diff.Z * diff.Z <= radius * radius then
            return true
        end
        local half = radius * 0.5
        return math.abs(diff.X) <= half
            and math.abs(diff.Y) <= math.max(half, 8)
            and math.abs(diff.Z) <= half
    end

    local function tryGrabGun(root: BasePart, handle: BasePart): ()
        rememberGunPartState(handle)
        handle.CanCollide = false
        local rootCF: CFrame? = root.CFrame
        if rootCF then
            handle.CFrame = rootCF
        end
        local fireTouch: any = state.fireTouchInterest
        if type(fireTouch) == "function" then
            pcall(fireTouch, root, handle, 0)
            pcall(fireTouch, root, handle, 1)
        end
    end

    local function clearAllHitboxes(): ()
        for gun, hitbox in pairs(gunHitboxes) do
            if hitbox and hitbox.Parent then
                pcall(function(): ()
                    hitbox:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            gunHitboxes[gun] = nil
        end
    end

    local function clearAllEsp(): ()
        for player, esp in pairs(espParts) do
            if esp and esp.Parent then
                pcall(function(): ()
                    esp:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            espParts[player] = nil
        end
    end

    local function updateSheriffESP(player: Player): ()
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not character or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart")
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local existing = espParts[player]
            if existing then
                if existing.Parent then
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        existing:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                espParts[player] = nil
            end
            return
        end

        local esp = espParts[player]
        if not esp or not esp.Parent then
            esp = Instance.new("Part")
            esp.Name = "WurstDeadSheriffESP_" .. player.Name
            esp.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
            esp.Transparency = 0.3
            esp.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
            esp.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            esp.CanCollide = false
            esp.CanQuery = false
            esp.CanTouch = false
            esp.Anchored = true
            esp.Parent = workspace
            espParts[player] = esp
        end
        esp.CFrame = (root :: BasePart).CFrame
    end

    local GunAuraFeature: any = nil
    local lastStatus: string? = nil

    local function setStatus(text: string?): ()
        if text == lastStatus then
            return
        end
        lastStatus = text
        if GunAuraFeature then
            GunAuraFeature:SetStatus(text)
        end
    end

    local function gunAuraTick(): ()
        if not gunAuraActive then
            return
        end
        local now: number = os.clock()
        if now - lastTickAt < TICK_INTERVAL then
            return
        end
        lastTickAt = now

        refreshTrackedDrops(now)

        local character = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
        local root: BasePart? = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
        local canGrab = canGrabGun()
        local activeGuns: {[Instance]: boolean} = {}
        local touchedParts: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}
        local gunCount: number = 0

        for gun in pairs(trackedDrops) do
            if isValidGunDrop(gun) then
                local handle: BasePart? = resolveGunTouchPart(gun)
                if handle then
                    gunCount += 1
                    activeGuns[gun] = true
                    rememberGunPartState(handle)
                    local truePos: Vector3? = trueGunPartPosition(handle)

                    if settings.showHitbox then
                        local hitbox = gunHitboxes[gun]
                        if not hitbox or not hitbox.Parent then
                            hitbox = createGunHitbox(gun)
                            if hitbox then
                                gunHitboxes[gun] = hitbox
                            end
                        elseif truePos then
                            local targetSize = Vector3.new(settings.studs, settings.studs, settings.studs)
                            if hitbox.Size ~= targetSize then
                                hitbox.Size = targetSize
                            end
                            hitbox.CFrame = CFrame.new(truePos)
                        end
                    end

                    if canGrab and root and truePos and isWithinAura(truePos, root.Position) then
                        touchedParts[handle] = true
                        pcall(tryGrabGun, root, handle)
                    end
                end
            else
                trackedDrops[gun] = nil
            end
        end

        for part in pairs(savedGunStates) do
            if not touchedParts[part] then
                restoreGunPartState(part)
            end
        end

        for gun, hitbox in pairs(gunHitboxes) do
            if not activeGuns[gun] then
                if hitbox and hitbox.Parent then
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        hitbox:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                gunHitboxes[gun] = nil
            end
        end

        if gunCount > 0 then
            setStatus("Gun detected · " .. tostring(math.round(settings.studs)) .. " studs")
        else
            setStatus(tostring(math.round(settings.studs)) .. " studs")
        end

        if now - lastEspAt >= ESP_INTERVAL and type(core.getPlayerRole) == "function" then
            lastEspAt = now
            local seenSheriffs: {[Player]: boolean} = {}
            for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                    local role = core.getPlayerRole(player)
                    if role == "Sheriff" then
                        seenSheriffs[player] = true
                        updateSheriffESP(player)
                    end
                end
            end
            for player, esp in pairs(espParts) do
                if not seenSheriffs[player] then
                    if esp and esp.Parent then
                        pcall(function(): ()
                            esp:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    espParts[player] = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function toggleGunAura(enabled: boolean): ()
        gunAuraActive = enabled
        state.mm2GunAuraEnabled = enabled == true
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2GunAura")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("MM2GunAuraDescendant")

        if not enabled then
            clearAllHitboxes()
            clearAllEsp()
            restoreAllGunPartStates()
            table.clear(trackedDrops)
            setStatus(nil)
            return
        end

        lastScanAt = -math.huge
        lastTickAt = -math.huge
        lastEspAt = -math.huge

        if workspace.DescendantAdded then
            featureConnections.MM2GunAuraDescendant = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj: Instance): ()
                if obj.Name == "GunDrop" then
                    trackedDrops[obj] = true
                end
            end)
        end

        setStatus(tostring(math.round(settings.studs)) .. " studs")
        featureConnections.MM2GunAura =
            TaskManager:Connect(gunAuraTick, nil, "MM2 Gun Aura")
        gunAuraTick()
    end

    GunAuraFeature = createUniversalFeature(
        "Gun Aura",
        "Detects dropped guns in the map with event-driven tracking, draws a white aura box around them, and automatically grabs the gun within Studs range.",
        7,
        toggleGunAura,
        {
            categoryName = "Utilities",
            parent = MM2Scroll,
            registry = mm2Features,
        }
    )
    state.mm2GunAuraFeature = GunAuraFeature

    addNumberOption(GunAuraFeature, "Studs", 25, 5, 250,
        function(value: number): ()
            settings.studs = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 25, 5, 250)
            if GunAuraFeature.enabled then
                setStatus(tostring(math.round(settings.studs)) .. " studs")
            end
        end,
        "Distance in studs around each dropped gun to automatically grab it.", 1)
    addToggleOption(GunAuraFeature, "Show Hitbox", true,
        function(value: boolean): ()
            settings.showHitbox = value == true
            if not settings.showHitbox then
                clearAllHitboxes()
            end
        end,
        "Shows or hides the white aura hitbox square around dropped guns.")

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        toggleGunAura(false)
    end
    Module.Events = featureConnections
    Module.Initialized = true
    return Module
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if not Module.Initialized then
        return
    end
    Module.Initialized = false
    pcall(activeCleanup)
    activeCleanup = function(): () end
    Module.Events = {}
    Module.Runtime = nil
end

return Module
