SHA-256: a01eaa2b2464a8dc9207db12feb6b428c40d97c2c4788eec49099dd5e0cb863b
INICIO DEL ARCHIVO
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "WalkFling",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local LocalPlayer: any = host.LocalPlayer
    local RunService: any = host.RunService or game:GetService("RunService")
    local createUniversalFeature: any = host.createUniversalFeature
    local addFeatureTooltip: any = host.addFeatureTooltip
    local addInformationOption: any = host.addInformationOption
    local configData: any = host.configData
    local services: any = (context :: any).services
    local activity: any = services and services.activity

    -- A persisted ON state must not start a fling on injection: the pulse only
    -- answers to an explicit toggle during the session.
    if type(configData) == "table" and type(configData.states) == "table" then
        configData.states["Universal.WalkFling"] = false
    end

    local enabled: boolean = false
    local session: number = 0
    -- Fixed at a higher effective power than the old 30000 (now more reliable
    -- for modern physics and heavier rigs). No Power option by design: only ON
    -- produces the pulse, and the test asserts >=30000.
    local POWER: number = 50000
    local SPIN: number = 50000
    local savedCollision: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local walkFlingFeature: any = nil

    local function getCharacterRoot(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
        local character: Model? = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character or not character.Parent then
            return nil, nil, nil
        end
        local humanoid: Humanoid? = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root: BasePart? = (humanoid and humanoid.RootPart)
            or (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?)
            or (character:FindFirstChild("Torso") :: BasePart?)
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then
            return character, humanoid, nil
        end
        return character, humanoid, root
    end

    local function rememberCollision(character: Model): ()
        for _, part: Instance in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and savedCollision[part] == nil then
                savedCollision[part] = (part :: BasePart).CanCollide
            end
        end
    end

    local function restoreCollision(): ()
        for part: any, canCollide: any in pairs(savedCollision) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                pcall(function(): ()
                    part.CanCollide = canCollide
                end)
            end
        end
        savedCollision = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    end

    local function stopWalkFling(): ()
        local wasEnabled: boolean = enabled
        enabled = false
        session += 1
        restoreCollision()
        local _character: Model?, _humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = getCharacterRoot()
        if wasEnabled and root and root.Parent then
            pcall(function(): ()
                root.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
        end
        if activity and type(activity.set) == "function" then
            activity.set("walkfling", false)
        end
        if walkFlingFeature then
            walkFlingFeature:SetStatus(nil)
        end
    end

    -- Infinite Yield's walkfling, which the user approved: spike the root
    -- velocity inside the RenderStepped window, put it back before the physics
    -- step and micro-oscillate so replication stays awake. The only additions
    -- are the session token (so an old loop cannot outlive a new toggle) and the
    -- collision restore on the way out.
    local function startWalkFling(): ()
        if enabled then
            return
        end
        enabled = true
        session += 1
        local mySession: number = session
        local movel: number = 0.1
        if activity and type(activity.set) == "function" then
            activity.set("walkfling", true)
        end
        if walkFlingFeature then
            walkFlingFeature:SetStatus("ON")
        end

        task.spawn(function(): ()
            while enabled and session == mySession and Module.Initialized do
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                if not enabled or session ~= mySession then
                    break
                end
                local character: Model?, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = getCharacterRoot()
                if character and root and root.Parent then
                    local savedVelocity: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    local savedAngular: Vector3 = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity or Vector3.zero
                    -- Modern technique: also use angular velocity and ensure Humanoid is in Physics for replication
                    if humanoid and humanoid.ChangeState then
                        pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)
                    end
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        rememberCollision(character)
                        for _, part: Instance in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                                (part :: BasePart).CanCollide = false
                            end
                        end
                        local spike: Vector3 = savedVelocity * POWER + Vector3.new(0, POWER, 0)
                        local spin: Vector3 = Vector3.new(SPIN, SPIN, SPIN)
                        root.Velocity = spike
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = spike
                        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = spin
                        -- Also set RotVelocity for older physics
                        pcall(function() (root :: any).RotVelocity = spin end)
                    end)
                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    -- A toggle-off that lands in the middle of an iteration must
                    -- not re-apply the spike after stop() already parked the body.
                    local stillRunning: boolean = enabled and session == mySession
                    if stillRunning and character.Parent and root.Parent then
                        pcall(function(): ()
                            root.Velocity = savedVelocity
                            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = savedVelocity
                            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = savedAngular
                            pcall(function() (root :: any).RotVelocity = savedAngular end)
                        end)
                    end
                    RunService.Stepped:Wait()
                    if stillRunning and enabled and session == mySession
                        and character.Parent and root.Parent then
                        pcall(function(): ()
                            local oscillated: Vector3 = savedVelocity + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
                            root.Velocity = oscillated
                            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = oscillated
                            local spinOsc: Vector3 = Vector3.new(0, SPIN * 0.1, 0)
                            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = spinOsc
                            movel = -movel
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            if session == mySession then
                restoreCollision()
            end
        end)
    end

    -- v190: MM2-only notice. Anti Fling shields every colliding part against a
    -- body moving at fling speeds -- which is exactly the contact Walk Fling
    -- needs -- so enabling both at once made the fling look broken. The player
    -- asked for the warning instead of silent failure: refusing here makes the
    -- card revert itself and report "Could not toggle Walk Fling: ...".
    local function mm2Game(): boolean
        local shared: any = host.state
        if shared and shared.activeGameName == "MM2" then
            return true
        end
        local ok: boolean, placeId: any = pcall(function(): any return game.PlaceId end)
        return ok and placeId == 142823291
    end

    local function antiFlingOn(): boolean
        local shared: any = host.state
        return shared ~= nil and shared.antiFlingActive == true
    end

    local function toggleWalkFling(state: boolean): ()
        if state == true then
            if mm2Game() and antiFlingOn() then
                error("Anti Fling is ON. Turn it off first to use Walk Fling.", 0)
            end
            startWalkFling()
            return
        end
        stopWalkFling()
    end

    walkFlingFeature = createUniversalFeature(
        "Walk Fling",
        "Fling on contact while walking (Infinite Yield walkfling)",
        8,
        toggleWalkFling,
        {categoryName = "Exploits"}
    )
    if type(addInformationOption) == "function" then
        addInformationOption(
            walkFlingFeature,
            "Collisions are restored and the body parked when the card is turned off."
        )
    end
    addFeatureTooltip(
        walkFlingFeature,
        "While ON, every physics frame the local character is noclipped and given a "
            .. "huge velocity for one frame, which launches whoever you walk into. "
            .. "Collisions are restored when it stops. It never starts on injection. "
            .. "In MM2 it refuses to start while Anti Fling is ON."
    )

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        stopWalkFling()
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return walkFlingFeature
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        pcall(activeCleanup)
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FIN DEL ARCHIVO: src/games/universal/Blatant/WalkFling.lua
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ARCHIVO: src/games/universal/Combat/AimAssist.lua
BYTES: 24909
SHA-256: c6e9ba510d871498967d09b12a80ca873c9c7f9e51ea8602876fba7eb677051f
INICIO DEL ARCHIVO
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
    libraries: {[string]: any},
    services: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "AimAssist",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCard: any = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local framework: any = context.framework
    local host: any = context.host
    local services: any = context.services
    local targeting: any = context.libraries and context.libraries.targeting
    local entity: any = context.entity
    local userInput: UserInputService = host.UserInputService
    local currentWorkspace: Workspace = host.workspace or workspace
    local localPlayer: Player? = host.LocalPlayer
    local runtime: any = {
        target = nil,
        lockedTarget = nil,
        lastFire = -math.huge,
        fireMode = "Hold",
        clickPressed = false,
    }
    local card: any

    local function camera(): Camera?
        return currentWorkspace.CurrentCamera
    end

    local function getHeldTool(): Tool?
        local player: Player? = localPlayer or host.LocalPlayer
        if not player then return nil end
        local character: Model? = player.Character
        if not character then return nil end
        for _, child: Instance in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Tool") then
                return child :: Tool
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- Screen position of the real cursor (includes the top-bar inset), used
    -- both to aim the virtual mouse and to place virtual clicks.
    local function getMouseScreenPosition(cameraObject: Camera?): Vector2
        local mouseOk: boolean, mousePos: any = pcall(function(): any
            return userInput:GetMouseLocation()
        end)
        if mouseOk and typeof(mousePos) == "Vector2" then
            return mousePos
        end
        local vp: Vector2 = cameraObject and cameraObject.ViewportSize
            or Vector2.new(800, 600)
        local insetY: number = 36
        pcall(function(): ()
            local guiService: any = game:GetService("GuiService")
            local inset: Vector2 = guiService:GetGuiInset()
            if typeof(inset) == "Vector2" then insetY = inset.Y end
        end)
        return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2 + insetY)
    end

    local function tryFireOnce(fireMode: string?, clickPressed: boolean?): boolean
        -- Only a tool that is ALREADY held gets Activate(). Equipping from the
        -- backpack mid-fight was removed on purpose: EquipTool can trigger the
        -- game's equip/ADS logic, which switches or locks the camera exactly at
        -- the point where the player clicked.
        local tool: Tool? = getHeldTool()
        if tool then
            if tool.Enabled == false then return false end
            -- Hold mode: the player's real click already activates the held tool
            -- (Roblox fires Tool.Activated on click); an extra Activate()
            -- double-fires semi-auto guns.
            if fireMode == "Hold" and clickPressed == true then return true end
            local ok: boolean = pcall(function(): () (tool :: Tool):Activate() end)
            if ok then return true end
        end
        -- Rivals / FPS without Tool (ViewModel + RemoteEvent): fallback to a
        -- virtual click. It MUST be sent at the real cursor position: sending
        -- (0, 0) shoots at the top-left screen corner and, with a free cursor,
        -- yanks the mouse (and any camera driven by absolute mouse position)
        -- to that corner.
        local mouse: Vector2 = getMouseScreenPosition(camera())
        local vimOk: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
            local vim: any = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            if vim and type(vim.SendMouseButtonEvent) == "function" then
                -- Press and release quickly; the CPS loop controls rate
                vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(mouse.X, mouse.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
                vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(mouse.X, mouse.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
            else
                error("no vim")
            end
        end)
        if vimOk then return true end
        local env: any = getfenv()
        local click: any = env.mouse1click or env.mouse1press
        if type(click) == "function" then
            local ok2: boolean = pcall(function(): () click() end)
            if ok2 then return true end
            -- mouse1press needs release
            local rel: any = env.mouse1release
            if type(rel) == "function" then
                pcall(function(): () click(); task.wait(0.02); rel() end)
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function getCPS(): number
        local opt: any = nil
        if card and card.Options then
            opt = card.Options["Clicks Per Second"] or card.Options["Fire rate"] or card.Options["CPS"]
        end
        if opt and opt.Value ~= nil then
            return math.max(1, tonumber(opt.Value) or 12)
        end
        return 12
    end

    local function shouldAutoFire(): boolean
        if not card or not card.Options or not card.Options["Auto Fire"] then return false end
        if not card.Options["Auto Fire"].Value then return false end
        local rate: number = getCPS()
        local now: number = os.clock()
        if now - runtime.lastFire < 1 / rate then return false end
        local fireMode: string = "Hold"
        if card.Options["Auto Fire mode"] then
            fireMode = tostring(card.Options["Auto Fire mode"].Value)
        end
        local okHeld: boolean, isPressed: any = pcall(function(): any
            return userInput:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
        end)
        local clickPressed: boolean = okHeld and isPressed == true
        -- Remembered for tryFireOnce: in Hold mode a real click already fired
        -- the held tool, so the module must not Activate() it a second time.
        runtime.fireMode = fireMode
        runtime.clickPressed = clickPressed
        if fireMode == "Always" then
            runtime.lastFire = now
            return true
        end
        if clickPressed then
            runtime.lastFire = now
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    local function moveCamera(target: any, deltaTime: number): boolean
        local cameraObject: Camera? = camera()
        if not cameraObject or not target then
            return false
        end
        local mode: string = card.Options["Mode"].Value
        local cameraModeRaw: string = "Auto"
        if card.Options["Camera"] then
            cameraModeRaw = tostring(card.Options["Camera"].Value)
        end
        local cameraMode: string = cameraModeRaw
        if cameraModeRaw == "CFrame" then
            cameraMode = "Camera"
        end
        local current: CFrame = cameraObject.CFrame
        local offset: Vector3 = target.position - current.Position
        if offset.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
            return false
        end

        local alpha: number = 1
        if mode ~= "Aimbot" then
            local dt = math.max(deltaTime, 0)
            local speed = math.max(0, card.Options.Speed.Value)
            local strength = math.max(0, card.Options.Strength.Value) / 100
            if speed == 0 or strength == 0 or dt == 0 then return false end
            local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(current.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit), -1, 1))
            if angle < math.rad(0.5) then return false end
            alpha = math.min(1 - math.exp(-strength * 10 * dt),
                angle > 1e-6 and math.rad(speed) * dt / angle or 1)
        end

        local function isMouseLocked(): boolean
            local okBeh: boolean, beh: any = pcall(function(): any
                return (userInput :: any).MouseBehavior
            end)
            if okBeh and beh then
                local okEnum: boolean, lockCenter: any = pcall(function(): any
                    return (Enum :: any).MouseBehavior.LockCenter
                end)
                local okCurr: boolean, lockCurr: any = pcall(function(): any
                    return (Enum :: any).MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
                end)
                if (okEnum and beh == lockCenter) or (okCurr and beh == lockCurr) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            local lp: Player? = localPlayer or host.LocalPlayer
            local char: Model? = lp and lp.Character
            local head: BasePart? = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
            if head then
                local dist: number = (cameraObject.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < 2.5 then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function tryMouse(): boolean
            if cameraMode == "Camera" then return false end
            local env: any = getfenv()
            local moverel: any = env.mousemoverel or env.mousemove or (host and (host.mousemoverel or host.mousemove))
            if type(moverel) ~= "function" then return false end
            -- Use ScreenPoint to match GetMouseLocation (both include top-bar inset 36px)
            local ok: boolean, screenPos: any, onScreen: any = pcall(function(): any
                return cameraObject:WorldToScreenPoint(target.position)
            end)
            if not ok or type(screenPos) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
            if onScreen == false and mode ~= "Aimbot" then return false end
            -- Always use GetMouseLocation (with inset) for delta; fallback to Viewport/2+inset
            local m: Vector2 = getMouseScreenPosition(cameraObject)
            local delta: Vector2 = Vector2.new(screenPos.X - m.X, screenPos.Y - m.Y)
            if mode ~= "Aimbot" then
                delta = delta * alpha
            end
            if delta.Magnitude < 0.3 then return false end
            local maxDelta: number = 500
            if math.abs(delta.X) > maxDelta or math.abs(delta.Y) > maxDelta then
                delta = delta.Unit * maxDelta
            end
            local moved: boolean = false
            local okMove: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
                moverel(delta.X, delta.Y)
                moved = true
            end)
            return okMove and moved
        end

        local function tryCamera(): boolean
            if cameraMode == "Mouse" then return false end
            local currentLook: Vector3 = current.LookVector
            local blended: Vector3 = offset.Unit
            if alpha < 1 then
                local dot = math.clamp(currentLook:Dot(offset.Unit), -1, 1)
                local tangent = offset.Unit - currentLook * dot
                if tangent.Magnitude < 1e-6 then tangent = current.RightVector end
                local turn = math.acos(dot) * alpha
                blended = currentLook * math.cos(turn) + tangent.Unit * math.sin(turn)
            end
            if blended.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
                return false
            end
            local newCFrame: CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(current.Position, current.Position + blended.Unit)
            -- Write directly from this frame callback. Card Render tasks run
            -- on RenderStepped, i.e. AFTER the game's own camera update
            -- (RenderPriority.Camera), so this write wins for the frame.
            -- Deliberately NO BindToRenderStep here: the old one-shot binding
            -- captured a stale newCFrame and tried to unbind itself from inside
            -- the render step; when that unbind failed (the pcall swallowed it),
            -- the binding re-wrote the same stale CFrame every frame and the
            -- camera froze on the last aim point — the spot where the player
            -- clicked. Writing only from the per-frame callback means that as
            -- soon as there is no target, nothing writes the camera anymore and
            -- the game owns the view again.
            local ok: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
                cameraObject.CFrame = newCFrame
            end)
            return ok
        end

        -- Hybrid fix for Rivals: with Tool/weapon, the gun's ray often uses mouse Hit, not just camera.
        -- Pure Camera leaves Mouse Hit at old side; pure Mouse has 1-frame camera lag.
        -- For natural + accurate, do BOTH when locked (FPS). For 3rd person, Mouse is enough.
        if cameraMode == "Auto" then
            local locked: boolean = isMouseLocked()
            if locked then
                -- FPS shift-lock / 1st person: try both to keep camera and Mouse Hit synced.
                -- Mouse first (game's native delta), then immediate Camera to remove 1-frame lag for hitscan.
                local didMouse: boolean = tryMouse()
                local didCamera: boolean = tryCamera()
                -- If we did Camera, we synced immediately; if only Mouse, camera will catch next frame via game's handler.
                return didMouse or didCamera
            else
                -- 3rd person: Mouse is natural and weapon (if any) follows camera via game's orbit, no need for double.
                if tryMouse() then return true end
                if tryCamera() then return true end
                return false
            end
        elseif cameraMode == "Camera" then
            return tryCamera()
        elseif cameraMode == "Mouse" then
            return tryMouse()
        end
        return tryCamera()
    end

    local function anotherAimAdapterIsActive(): boolean
        local activity: any = services and services.activity
        local free = services and services.freeCam
        local spectate = services and services.spectate
        if free and free.IsActive() or spectate and spectate.IsActive() then return true end
        return activity ~= nil
            and type(activity.isActive) == "function"
            and activity.isActive("mvsdSilentAim") == true
    end

    local function selectTarget(): any
        if anotherAimAdapterIsActive()
            or not targeting
            or type(targeting.List) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        local options: any = card.Options
        local mode: string = options["Mode"].Value
        local candidates: {any} = targeting:List(entity, {
            FOV = mode == "Aim Assist" and options["FOV"].Value or nil,
            MaxDistance = options["Max distance"].Value,
            TargetPart = options["Target part"].Value,
            Prediction = options["Prediction"].Value,
            TeamCheck = options["Team check"].Value,
            VisibilityCheck = options["Visibility check"].Value,
            Priority = options["Priority"].Value,
            IncludeNPCs = options["Target NPCs"].Value,
            AllowOffscreen = mode == "Aimbot",
        })
        if mode ~= "Aimbot" then
            runtime.lockedTarget = nil
            return candidates[1]
        end
        if options["Sticky target"].Value and runtime.lockedTarget then
            for _, candidate: any in ipairs(candidates) do
                if candidate.entity == runtime.lockedTarget.entity then
                    runtime.lockedTarget = candidate
                    return candidate
                end
            end
        end
        runtime.lockedTarget = candidates[1]
        return runtime.lockedTarget
    end

    pcall(function(): ()
        local cfg: any = host.configData
        if cfg and type(cfg.values) == "table" then
            local key: string = "Universal.AimAssist.Camera"
            if cfg.values[key] == "CFrame" then
                cfg.values[key] = "Camera"
            end
            local oldKey: string = "Universal.AimAssist.Fire rate"
            local newKey: string = "Universal.AimAssist.Clicks Per Second"
            if cfg.values[oldKey] ~= nil and cfg.values[newKey] == nil then
                cfg.values[newKey] = cfg.values[oldKey]
            end
        end
    end)

    card = framework.Categories.Exploits:CreateModule({
        Name = "Aimbot",
        Category = "Exploits",
        ConfigKey = "Universal.AimAssist",
        Order = 4,
        Tooltip = "Eases the local camera toward a valid target; no raycast or "
            .. "remote hooks.",
        Function = function(enabled: boolean): ()
            runtime.target = nil
            runtime.lockedTarget = nil
            runtime.lastFire = -math.huge
            if not enabled then
                card:SetStatus(nil)
                local rs: any = (host :: any).RunService
                if rs and type(rs.UnbindFromRenderStep) == "function" then
                    pcall(function(): () rs:UnbindFromRenderStep("WurstAimAssistCam") end)
                end
                return
            end
            card:SetStatus("searching")
            card:Render(function(deltaTime: number): ()
                if anotherAimAdapterIsActive()
                    or services.menu.isVisible()
                    or services.menu.isCapturingInput() then
                    runtime.target = nil
                    runtime.lockedTarget = nil
                    card:SetStatus("paused")
                    return
                end
                if userInput:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                    runtime.target = nil
                    runtime.lockedTarget = nil
                    card:SetStatus("paused")
                    return
                end
                local selected: any = selectTarget()
                runtime.target = selected
                if not selected then
                    card:SetStatus("searching")
                    return
                end
                local moved: boolean = moveCamera(selected, deltaTime)
                if shouldAutoFire() then
                    pcall(function(): () tryFireOnce(runtime.fireMode, runtime.clickPressed) end)
                end
                local targetPlayer: Player? = selected.player
                local displayName: string = targetPlayer
                    and tostring(targetPlayer.DisplayName or targetPlayer.Name)
                    or tostring(selected.entity.Name or selected.character.Name)
                local distance: number = math.round(selected.distance)
                card:SetStatus(
                    displayName .. " · " .. tostring(distance) .. " studs"
                        .. (moved and " · locked" or " · ready")
                )
            end)
            card:Clean(function(): ()
                runtime.target = nil
                card:SetStatus(nil)
                local rs: any = (host :: any).RunService
                if rs and type(rs.UnbindFromRenderStep) == "function" then
                    pcall(function(): () rs:UnbindFromRenderStep("WurstAimAssistCam") end)
                end
            end)
        end,
    })

    card:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Aim Assist", "Aimbot"},
        Index = 1,
        Function = function(): ()
            runtime.lockedTarget = nil
        end,
        Tooltip = "Aim Assist = ayuda suave dentro de FOV usando Speed/Strength (natural). Aimbot = snap directo con Sticky opcional.",
    })
    card:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Camera",
        List = {"Auto", "Camera", "Mouse"},
        Index = 1,
        Tooltip = "Auto: 3rd=Mouse (natural) 1st/FPS=Mouse+Camera híbrido para que el arma siga (Mouse Hit + CFrame instant). Camera: solo CFrame (1st person). Mouse: solo mousemoverel.",
    })
    card:CreateSlider({
        Name = "FOV",
        Show = {Option = "Mode", Values = {"Aim Assist"}},
        Min = 15,
        Max = 500,
        Step = 5,
        Default = 180,
        Tooltip = "FOV en píxeles: radio alrededor del cursor. 15 pequeño — 500 pantalla completa. Default 180.",
    })
    card:CreateSlider({Name="Speed",Min=0,Max=360,Default=180,Step=5,
        Show={Option="Mode",Values={"Aim Assist"}},
        Tooltip="Speed °/s: rotación máxima. 0 sin ayuda, 180 default, 360 instantáneo."})
    card:CreateSlider({Name="Strength",Min=0,Max=100,Default=75,Step=5,
        Show={Option="Mode",Values={"Aim Assist"}},
        Tooltip="Strength %: fuerza de arrastre. 0 nada, 50 suave, 75 default, 100 máxima."})
    card:CreateNote("FOV: 15-500 px — 180 default • Speed: 0-360 °/s — 180 default • Strength: 0-100% — 75 default.")
    card:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Target part",
        List = {"Closest", "Head", "Torso"},
        Index = 1,
        Tooltip = "Body part used as the camera target.",
    })
    card:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Priority",
        List = {"Cursor", "Distance"},
        Index = 1,
        Tooltip = "Choose the target nearest the cursor or nearest in the world.",
    })
    card:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Prediction",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 0.5,
        Step = 0.01,
        Default = 0.06,
        Tooltip = "Prediction s: anticipa movimiento. 0 sin predicción, 0.06 default (60 ms).",
    })
    card:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Max distance",
        Min = 25,
        Max = 2000,
        Step = 5,
        Default = 600,
        Tooltip = "Max distance studs: ignora targets más lejos. 600 default.",
    })
    card:CreateNote("Prediction: 0-0.5 s — 0.06 s default. Max distance 600 studs default.")
    card:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Visibility check",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Skip targets hidden by map geometry.",
    })
    card:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Team check",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Skip teammates and Friend List entries.",
    })
    card:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Target NPCs",
        Default = false,
        Tooltip = "Include non-player humanoid models in both modes.",
    })
    card:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Sticky target",
        Show = {Option = "Mode", Values = {"Aimbot"}},
        Default = true,
        Function = function(value: boolean): ()
            if not value then
                runtime.lockedTarget = nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Hold the current Aimbot target. Turn off to release it every frame.",
    })
    card:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Fire",
        Default = false,
        Tooltip = "Autoclick genérico: si no hay Tool hace click virtual. No toca GUI.",
    })
    card:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Auto Fire mode",
        List = {"Hold", "Always"},
        Index = 1,
        Show = {Option = "Auto Fire"},
        Tooltip = "Hold = solo mientras mantienes click izquierdo (para semi-auto). Always = dispara solo al tener target.",
    })
    card:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Clicks Per Second",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 20,
        Step = 1,
        Default = 12,
        Show = {Option = "Auto Fire"},
        Tooltip = "Clicks por segundo manteniendo. 12 default = pistola semi-auto. Sube para automático.",
    })
    card:CreateNote(
        "Natural: Auto 3rd=Mouse, 1st=Mouse+Camera híbrido (sincroniza Mouse Hit + CFrame) para que el arma no se quede atrás."
    )

    pcall(function()
        local feature: any = (card :: any).Feature or (card :: any)._feature or card
        local optionsFrame: any = (feature :: any).options or (card :: any).options
        if not optionsFrame or type(optionsFrame.FindFirstChild) ~= "function" then return end
        local function patchOption(optionName: string, minText: string, maxText: string, suffix: string)
            local row: any = optionsFrame:FindFirstChild("Option_" .. optionName:gsub("%W", ""))
            if not row then return end
            local label: any = row:FindFirstChild("OptionLabel")
            if label and suffix then pcall(function() label.Text = label.Text .. " " .. suffix end) end
            local slider: any = row:FindFirstChild("Slider")
            if slider then
                local minL: any = slider:FindFirstChild("MinLabel")
                local maxL: any = slider:FindFirstChild("MaxLabel")
                if minL then pcall(function() minL.Text = minText end) end
                if maxL then pcall(function() maxL.Text = maxText end) end
            end
        end
        patchOption("FOV", "15 px", "500 px", "(píxeles)")
        patchOption("Speed", "0°/s", "360°/s", "(°/s)")
        patchOption("Strength", "0%", "100%", "(%)")
        patchOption("Prediction", "0 s", "0.5 s", "(s)")
        patchOption("Maxdistance", "25 studs", "2000 studs", "(studs)")
        patchOption("ClicksPerSecond", "1", "20", "(cps)")
    end)

    activeCard = card
    Module.Initialized = true
    return card
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCard and activeCard.Enabled then
        activeCard:Toggle(false)
    end
    activeCard = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "KillAura",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

-- Ignore list: names, display names or user ids, separated by commas. It is
-- parsed outside the per-frame loop and applied to the entity list before any
-- rotation or swing, so an ignored player is never picked.
local function compileIgnoreList(text: string?): {[string]: boolean}
    local ignored: {[string]: boolean} = {}
    for name: string in string.gmatch(text or "", "[^,;%s]+") do
        ignored[string.lower(name)] = true
    end
    return ignored
end

local function isIgnoredEntity(entity: any, ignored: {[string]: boolean}): boolean
    local player: any = entity and entity.Player
    if not player then
        return false
    end
    return ignored[string.lower(player.Name or "")] == true
        or ignored[string.lower(player.DisplayName or "")] == true
        or ignored[tostring(player.UserId)] == true
end

local function collectTools(localPlayer: Player): {Tool}
    local tools: {Tool} = {}
    local character: Model? = localPlayer.Character
    if character then
        for _, child: Instance in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Tool") then
                table.insert(tools, child :: Tool)
            end
        end
    end
    local backpack: Instance? = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if backpack then
        for _, child: Instance in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Tool") then
                table.insert(tools, child :: Tool)
            end
        end
    end
    return tools
end

local function toolHandle(tool: Tool?): BasePart?
    if not tool then
        return nil
    end
    local resolved: Tool = tool :: Tool
    local handle: Instance? = resolved:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
        return handle :: BasePart
    end

    for _, descendant: Instance in ipairs(resolved:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            return descendant :: BasePart
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function activateTool(tool: Tool?): boolean
    if not tool or tool.Enabled == false then return false end
    return pcall(function(): ()
        tool:Activate()
    end)
end

local function fireContact(handle: BasePart?, target: BasePart): ()
    if not handle then
        return
    end
    local environment: any = getfenv()
    local fire: any = environment.firetouchinterest
    if type(fire) ~= "function" then
        return
    end

    pcall(fire, handle, target, 0)
    pcall(fire, handle, target, 1)
end

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local framework: any = context.framework
    local entityLibrary: any = context.entity
    local localPlayer: Player = host.LocalPlayer
    local userInput: UserInputService = host.UserInputService
    local currentWorkspace: Workspace = host.workspace or workspace
    -- Advanced team check (always on): the entity library only knows team
    -- providers, so role-based verdicts (MM2 sides, for example) are applied
    -- as a post filter here.
    local teamCheck: any = host.state and host.state.teamCheck

    local nextSwingAt: number = 0
    local nextStatusAt: number = 0
    local highlights: {[any]: Highlight} = {}

    local function clearHighlights(keep: {[any]: boolean}?): ()
        for key: any, highlight: Highlight in pairs(highlights) do
            if not keep or not keep[key] then
                highlight:Destroy()
                highlights[key] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    local function markTarget(entity: any, options: any): ()
        if not options["Highlight targets"].Value then
            return
        end
        local key: any = entity.Player or entity.Character
        local existing: Highlight? = highlights[key]
        if not existing or not existing.Parent then
            local created: Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            created.Name = "Wurst_KillAuraTarget"
            created.FillTransparency = 0.75
            created.Parent = entity.Character
            highlights[key] = created
            existing = created
        end
        local highlight: Highlight = existing :: Highlight
        highlight.Adornee = entity.Character
        highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        local colour: Color3 = options["Highlight colour"].Value
        highlight.FillColor = colour
        highlight.OutlineColor = colour
    end

    local aura: any = nil
    local weapons: any = context.weapons

    local function updateTargetStatus(count: number): ()
        local now: number = os.clock()
        if now < nextStatusAt then
            return
        end
        nextStatusAt = now + 0.25
        aura:SetStatus(tostring(count) .. " in range")
    end

    local learnedWeapon: string? = nil
    local learnConnections: {RBXScriptConnection} = {}

    local function watchTool(tool: Tool): ()
        table.insert(
            learnConnections,
            tool.Activated:Connect(function(): ()
                learnedWeapon = tool.Name
            end)
        )
    end

    local function clearToolWatches(): ()
        for _, connection: RBXScriptConnection in ipairs(learnConnections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
        table.clear(learnConnections)
    end

    local function watchAllTools(): ()
        clearToolWatches()
        for _, tool: Tool in ipairs(collectTools(localPlayer)) do
            watchTool(tool)
        end
    end

    local function matchesWanted(tool: Tool, wanted: string): boolean
        return string.find(string.lower(tool.Name), string.lower(wanted), 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    local function equippedTool(): (Tool?, BasePart?)
        local character: Model? = localPlayer.Character
        if not character then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local wanted: string = tostring(aura.Options["Weapon name"].Value or "")
        local held: {Tool} = {}
        for _, child: Instance in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Tool") then
                table.insert(held, child :: Tool)
            end
        end

        if wanted ~= "" then
            for _, tool: Tool in ipairs(held) do
                if matchesWanted(tool, wanted) then
                    return tool, toolHandle(tool)
                end
            end
        end
        if learnedWeapon then
            for _, tool: Tool in ipairs(held) do
                if tool.Name == learnedWeapon then
                    return tool, toolHandle(tool)
                end
            end
        end
        local first: Tool? = held[1]
        return first, toolHandle(first)
    end

    local function equipFromBackpack(): ()
        local backpack: Instance? = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        local humanoid: Humanoid? = localPlayer.Character
            and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid?
        if not backpack or not humanoid then
            return
        end
        local wanted: string = tostring(aura.Options["Weapon name"].Value or "")
        local chosen: Tool? = nil
        for _, child: Instance in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if not child:IsA("Tool") then
                continue
            end
            local tool: Tool = child :: Tool
            if wanted ~= "" and matchesWanted(tool, wanted) then
                chosen = tool
                break
            end
            if learnedWeapon and tool.Name == learnedWeapon then
                chosen = tool
                break
            end
            if not chosen then
                chosen = tool
            end
        end
        if chosen then
            pcall(function(): ()
                humanoid:EquipTool(chosen :: Tool)
            end)
        end
    end

    local store: any = host.configData
    if store and store.values then
        local reachKey: string = "Universal.KillAura.Reach"
        local stored: any = store.values["Universal.KillAura.Swingrange"]
        if store.values[reachKey] == nil and type(stored) == "number" then
            store.values[reachKey] = stored
            if type(host.queueConfigSave) == "function" then
                host.queueConfigSave()
            end
        end
    end

    aura = framework.Categories.Exploits:CreateModule({
        Name = "KillAura", -- stable framework identity for game adapters
        DisplayName = host.GAME_CHECK and host.GAME_CHECK.MM2Active and "Knife Stab" or "KillAura",
        Category = "Exploits",
        ConfigKey = "Universal.KillAura",
        Order = 1,
        Tooltip = "Swings your weapon at everyone in reach, with its own "
            .. "range, rate, field of view and rotation.",
        Function = function(enabled: boolean): ()
            if aura.CombatAdapter then
                clearHighlights()
                aura.CombatAdapter(enabled)
                return
            end
            nextSwingAt = 0
            nextStatusAt = 0
            if not enabled then
                aura:SetStatus(nil)
                clearHighlights()
                return
            end
            aura:SetStatus("0 in range")

            aura:Clean(function(): ()
                clearHighlights()
            end)

            watchAllTools()
            aura:Event(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function(): ()
                task.defer(function()
                    if aura.Enabled then watchAllTools() end
                end)
            end)
            local backpack: Instance? = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            if backpack then
                aura:Event(backpack.ChildAdded, function(child: Instance): ()
                    if child:IsA("Tool") then
                        watchTool(child :: Tool)
                    end
                end)
            end
            aura:Clean(clearToolWatches)

            aura:Loop(function(): ()
                local options: any = aura.Options
                -- Fix Hold Mouse showing mobile controls on PC: suppress TouchGui when Hold is active
                local suppress: any = host.suppressTouchControls
                if type(suppress) == "function" and options["Activation"].Value == "Hold key" then
                    local hold: any = options["Hold key"].Value
                    -- If hold is a mouse button, the game may enable TouchGui on desktop; hide it
                    local isMouseHold: boolean = false
                    pcall(function()
                        isMouseHold = (hold == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and false)
                            or (typeof(hold) == "EnumItem" and string.find(tostring(hold), "MouseButton") ~= nil)
                            or (typeof(hold) == "EnumItem" and hold.EnumType == Enum.UserInputType)
                    end)
                    if isMouseHold or userInput:IsKeyDown(hold) then
                        pcall(suppress)
                    end
                end
                if options["Activation"].Value == "Hold key"
                    and not userInput:IsKeyDown(options["Hold key"].Value) then
                    updateTargetStatus(0)
                    clearHighlights()
                    return
                end
                if not entityLibrary:IsAlive() then
                    updateTargetStatus(0)
                    clearHighlights()
                    return
                end

                local tool: Tool?, handle: BasePart? = equippedTool()
                if not tool then
                    if options["Auto equip"].Value then
                        equipFromBackpack()
                    end
                    if options["Require tool"].Value then

                        updateTargetStatus(0)
                        clearHighlights()
                        return
                    end
                end

                entityLibrary:Refresh()
                local targets: {any} = entityLibrary:InRange({
                    Range = options["Reach"].Value,
                    -- Limit after all filters: ignored/protected teammates must
                    -- not consume slots ahead of valid enemies.
                    IgnoreTeam = not options["Team check"].Value,
                    IgnoreWalls = not options["Wall check"].Value,
                    Angle = options["Field of view"].Value,
                    IncludeNPCs = options["Target NPCs"].Value,
                    Sort = options["Priority"].Value,
                })
                if options["Team check"].Value and teamCheck then
                    local kept: {any} = {}
                    for _, entity: any in ipairs(targets) do
                        local teammate: boolean = false
                        if entity.Player
                            and type(teamCheck.isSameTeam) == "function" then
                            teammate = teamCheck.isSameTeam(entity.Player)
                        end
                        if not teammate then
                            table.insert(kept, entity)
                        end
                    end
                    targets = kept
                end
                local ignoreText: string = tostring(
                    options["Ignore players"].Value or ""
                )
                if ignoreText ~= "" then
                    local ignored: {[string]: boolean} = compileIgnoreList(ignoreText)
                    local kept: {any} = {}
                    for _, entity: any in ipairs(targets) do
                        if not isIgnoredEntity(entity, ignored) then
                            table.insert(kept, entity)
                        end
                    end
                    targets = kept
                end
                local targetLimit: number = math.max(1, math.round(options["Max targets"].Value))
                while #targets > targetLimit do table.remove(targets) end
                updateTargetStatus(#targets)
                if #targets == 0 then
                    clearHighlights()
                    return
                end
                local now: number = os.clock()
                local rate: number = math.max(options["Swings per second"].Value, 0.5)

                local jitter: number = 1 / rate * 0.25
                local canSwing: boolean = now >= nextSwingAt
                local keep: {[any]: boolean} = {}

                local root: BasePart? = entityLibrary.LocalEntity
                    and entityLibrary.LocalEntity.RootPart
                local rotation: string = options["Rotation"].Value
                local originalCFrame: CFrame? = root and root.CFrame or nil

                if canSwing then

                    nextSwingAt = now
                        + (1 / rate)
                        + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * jitter
                end

                if rotation ~= "Off" and root then
                    local first: any = targets[1]
                    local flat: Vector3 = first.RootPart.Position
                        * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                    root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                        root.Position,
                        Vector3.new(flat.X, root.Position.Y + 0.01, flat.Z)
                    )
                end

                for _, entity: any in ipairs(targets) do
                    keep[entity.Player or entity.Character] = true
                    markTarget(entity, options)

                    if not canSwing then
                        continue
                    end

                    local swung: boolean = false
                    if weapons then
                        for _, label: string in ipairs(aura.Options["Weapons"].Selected or {}) do
                            local candidate: any = weapons:Find(label)
                            if candidate and weapons:Activate(candidate, entity) then
                                swung = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not swung and tool then
                        swung = activateTool(tool)
                    end
                    if not swung and weapons then

                        local fallback: any = weapons:Best({Melee = true})
                        swung = fallback ~= nil and weapons:Activate(fallback, entity)
                    end

                    local extraHits: number =
                        math.max(math.round(options["Hits per swing"].Value) - 1, 0)
                    for _ = 1, extraHits do
                        if tool then
                            activateTool(tool)
                        elseif weapons then
                            weapons:Swing()
                        end
                    end
                    if not options["Contact damage"].Value then

                        continue
                    end

                    if not options["Hit through walls"].Value
                        and not entityLibrary:VisibleFrom(entity) then
                        continue
                    end

                    local overlap: OverlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
                    overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
                    overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {entity.Character}
                    local parts: {BasePart} = currentWorkspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(
                        entity.RootPart.CFrame,
                        Vector3.new(5, 6, 5),
                        overlap
                    )
                    for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
                        fireContact(handle, part)
                    end
                end

                if rotation == "Silent" and root and originalCFrame then
                    root.CFrame = originalCFrame :: CFrame
                end

                clearHighlights(keep)
            end)
        end,
    })

    aura:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Activation",
        List = {"Always", "Hold key"},
        Index = 1,
    })
    aura:CreateBind({
        Name = "Hold key",
        Show = {Option = "Activation", Values = {"Hold key"}},
        Default = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
    })
    aura:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Reach",
        Min = 5,
        Max = 60,
        Default = 18,
        Tooltip = "Distance at which the weapon swings and its touch events "
            .. "fire. This is the only Kill Aura distance.",
    })
    aura:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Max targets",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 10,
        Default = 3,
        Tooltip = "How many valid players or NPCs one swing may hit. One "
            .. "sticks to the best target.",
    })
    aura:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Priority",
        List = {"Distance", "Health", "Threat"},
        Index = 1,
        Tooltip = "Which target comes first: nearest, weakest, or the one "
            .. "most dangerous to you.",
    })
    aura:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Swings per second",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 20,
        Default = 8,
        Tooltip = "A fast human clicks about 8-12 times a second. Twenty is "

export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
    services: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "Air Walk",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local framework: any = context.framework
    local LocalPlayer: Player = host.LocalPlayer
    local UserInputService: UserInputService = host.UserInputService
    local RunService: RunService = host.RunService
    local world: Workspace = host.workspace
    local create: any = host.create

    local platform: Part? = nil
    local gui: Frame? = nil
    local airY: number? = nil
    local trackedCharacter: Model? = nil
    local connections: {RBXScriptConnection} = {}
    local held: {[string]: {[any]: boolean}} = {
        Up = {},
        Down = {},
    }

    local VERTICAL_SPEED: number = 22

    local function characterParts(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
        local character: Model? = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then
            return nil, nil, nil
        end
        local humanoid: Humanoid? = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid?
        local root: BasePart? = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
        return character, humanoid, root
    end

    local function footOffsetOf(humanoid: Humanoid, root: BasePart): number
        local hip: number = humanoid.HipHeight
        if hip <= 0 then hip = 2 end
        return hip + root.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.5
    end

    local function destroyPlatform(): ()
        if platform then platform:Destroy(); platform = nil end
    end

    local function destroyGui(): ()
        if gui then gui:Destroy(); gui = nil end
    end

    local function clearConnections(): ()
        for _, conn: RBXScriptConnection in ipairs(connections) do
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
        table.clear(connections)
        table.clear(held.Up)
        table.clear(held.Down)
    end

    local function setHold(direction: string, source: any, isDown: boolean): ()
        local bucket: {[any]: boolean}? = held[direction]
        if not bucket then
            return
        end
        bucket[source] = isDown and true or nil
    end

    local function isDirectionHeld(direction: string): boolean
        local bucket: {[any]: boolean}? = held[direction]
        return bucket ~= nil and next(bucket) ~= nil
    end

    local function ensurePlatform(): Part
        if platform and platform.Parent then return platform end
        local p: Part = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = "Wurst_AirWalkPlatform"
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = true
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.CastShadow = false
        p.Size = Vector3.new(16, 1, 16)
        p.Transparency = 1
        p.Parent = world
        platform = p
        return p
    end

    local airWalk: any
    airWalk = framework.Categories.Exploits:CreateModule({
        Name = "Air Walk",
        Category = "Exploits",
        ConfigKey = "Universal.AirWalk",
        Order = 11,
        Tooltip = "Stay in the air with every jump and walk in mid-air. Space to go up, Shift to go down, with mobile Up/Down buttons.",
        Function = function(enabled: boolean): ()
            clearConnections()
            destroyGui()
            destroyPlatform()
            airY = nil
            trackedCharacter = nil

            if not enabled then
                airWalk:SetStatus(nil)
                return
            end

            airWalk:SetStatus("Active")

            local function connect(signal: any, callback: any): ()
                table.insert(connections, signal:Connect(callback))
            end

            connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(event: InputObject, processed: boolean): ()
                if processed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                    return
                end
                if event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                    if event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
                        setHold("Up", "Space", true)
                    elseif event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift
                        or event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
                        setHold("Down", event.KeyCode, true)
                    end
                end
            end)

            connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(event: InputObject): ()
                if event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                    if event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
                        setHold("Up", "Space", false)
                    elseif event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift
                        or event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
                        setHold("Down", event.KeyCode, false)
                    end
                elseif event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    setHold("Up", event, false)
                    setHold("Down", event, false)
                end
            end)

            if UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased then
                connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function(): ()
                    table.clear(held.Up)
                    table.clear(held.Down)
                end)
            end
            if UserInputService.TextBoxFocused then
                connect(UserInputService.TextBoxFocused, function(): ()
                    table.clear(held.Up)
                    table.clear(held.Down)
                end)
            end

            if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and type(create) == "function" and host.ScreenGui then
                gui = create("Frame", {
                    Name = "AirWalkControls",
                    Parent = host.ScreenGui,
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    ZIndex = 30,
                })
                local function makeMobileButton(name: string, text: string, at: UDim2, size: UDim2): any
                    local object: any = create("TextButton", {
                        Name = name,
                        Parent = gui,
                        Position = at,
                        Size = size,
                        Text = text,
                        Font = Enum.Font.Code,
                        TextSize = 18,
                        TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                        BorderSizePixel = 1,
                        BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120),
                        AutoButtonColor = true,
                        ZIndex = 31,
                    })
                    if host.ThemeEngine then
                        host.ThemeEngine.Bind(object, "BackgroundColor3", "background")
                        host.ThemeEngine.Bind(object, "TextColor3", "text")
                    end
                    return object
                end

                for _, name: string in ipairs({"Up", "Down"}) do
                    local btn: any = makeMobileButton(
                        name,
                        if name == "Up" then "+" else "−",
                        UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, if name == "Up" then -152 else -96),
                        UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
                    )
                    connect(btn.InputBegan, function(event: InputObject): ()
                        if event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                            or event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                            setHold(name, event, true)
                        end
                    end)
                    connect(btn.InputEnded, function(event: InputObject): ()
                        if event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                            or event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                            setHold(name, event, false)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt: number): ()
                local character: Model?, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = characterParts()
                if not character or not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                    destroyPlatform()
                    airY = nil
                    trackedCharacter = nil
                    return
                end

                local stepDt: number = if type(dt) == "number" and dt > 0 and dt < 0.5 then dt else (1 / 60)
                local offset: number = footOffsetOf(humanoid, root)
                local currentFootY: number = root.Position.Y - offset

                if trackedCharacter ~= character or airY == nil then
                    trackedCharacter = character
                    airY = currentFootY
                end

                local keyUp: boolean = false
                local keyDown: boolean = false
                if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                    keyUp = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
                    keyDown = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
                        or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
                end

                local goingUp: boolean = keyUp or isDirectionHeld("Up")
                local goingDown: boolean = keyDown or isDirectionHeld("Down")

                local part: Part = ensurePlatform()
                if goingDown and not goingUp then
                    airY = currentFootY - VERTICAL_SPEED * stepDt - 1.4
                    local vel: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    if vel.Y > -VERTICAL_SPEED then
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, -VERTICAL_SPEED, vel.Z)
                    end
                elseif goingUp and not goingDown then
                    airY = math.max(airY :: number, currentFootY) + VERTICAL_SPEED * stepDt
                    local vel: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    if vel.Y < VERTICAL_SPEED then
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, VERTICAL_SPEED, vel.Z)
                    end
                else
                    -- Lock to the highest point reached on any jump.
                    if currentFootY > (airY :: number) then airY = currentFootY end
                end
                if not part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = true end
                part.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, airY :: number, root.Position.Z)
            end)

            airWalk:Clean(function(): ()
                clearConnections()
                destroyGui()
                destroyPlatform()
                airY = nil
                trackedCharacter = nil
            end)
        end,
    })

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        clearConnections()
        destroyGui()
        destroyPlatform()
        if airWalk and airWalk.Enabled then
            airWalk:Toggle(false)
        end
    end

    Module.Initialized = true
    return airWalk
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        activeCleanup()
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module
