export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
    services: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "AntiFling",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local services: any = context.services
    local activity: any = services and services.activity
    local framework: any = context.framework
    local players: any = host.Players
    local localPlayer: any = host.LocalPlayer
    local world: any = host.workspace or workspace
    local featureConnections: any = host.featureConnections
    local disconnect: any = host.disconnectFeatureConnection

    local enabled: boolean = false
    local playerShield: boolean = true
    local impactShield: boolean = true
    local feature: any = nil
    local character: Model? = nil
    local links: {[BasePart]: {[BasePart]: any}} = {}
    local hazardSeen: {[BasePart]: number} = {}
    -- Body model -> clock value until which it stays shielded. Only populated
    -- by a fling-speed body inside RADIUS (v190).
    local dangerousUntil: {[Model]: number} = {}
    local nextScan: number = 0
    local dangerUntil: number = 0
    local suspended: boolean = false
    local warnedOverlap: boolean = false

    -- Limits are deliberately conservative. The shield is local physics, not
    -- server authority; do not change other people's CanCollide or global groups.
    local SCAN_INTERVAL: number = 0.15
    local RADIUS: number = 30
    local HAZARD_HOLD: number = 0.75
    local LINEAR_LIMIT: number = 80
    local SURFACE_LIMIT: number = 70
    local MAX_LINKS: number = 2048
    local MAX_PARTS: number = 200

    local function isBusy(): boolean
        return activity ~= nil and type(activity.isActive) == "function"
            and (activity.isActive("fling") or activity.isActive("walkfling"))
    end

    local function destroyLinks(): ()
        for _, perLocal: {[BasePart]: any} in pairs(links) do
            for _, constraint: any in pairs(perLocal) do
                pcall(function(): () constraint:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(links)
        table.clear(hazardSeen)
        table.clear(dangerousUntil)
        dangerUntil = 0
    end

    local function isToolPart(part: Instance): boolean
        local ok: boolean, result: any = pcall(function(): any
            return part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
        end)
        return ok and result ~= nil
    end

    local function listBodyParts(model: Model?, onlyCollidable: boolean): {BasePart}
        local parts: {BasePart} = {}
        if not model or not model.Parent then return parts end
        local ok: boolean, descendants: any = pcall(function(): any return model:GetDescendants() end)
        if not ok or type(descendants) ~= "table" then return parts end
        for _, object: Instance in ipairs(descendants) do
            if object:IsA("BasePart") and not isToolPart(object) then
                local part: BasePart = object :: BasePart
                if not onlyCollidable or part.CanCollide then table.insert(parts, part) end
            end
        end
        return parts
    end

    local function fastPart(part: BasePart, scale: number?): boolean
        local ok: boolean, fast: any = pcall(function(): boolean
            -- Relative speed alone flags a stationary player when *we* sprint;
            -- arm the fallback only for motion driven by the other assembly.
            local linear: Vector3 = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local angular: Vector3 = part.AssemblyAngularVelocity
            local radius: number = math.min(part.Size.Magnitude * 0.5, 20)
            local multiplier: number = scale or 1
            return linear.Magnitude > LINEAR_LIMIT * multiplier
                or angular.Magnitude * radius > SURFACE_LIMIT * multiplier
        end)
        return ok and fast == true
    end

    local function supportAssembly(root: BasePart, humanoid: Humanoid, owner: Model): BasePart?
        local ok: boolean, result: any = pcall(function(): any
            local params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {owner}
            params.IgnoreWater = true
            params.RespectCanCollide = true
            local distance: number = math.max(4, (tonumber(humanoid.HipHeight) or 2) + root.Size.Y * 0.5 + 2)
            return world:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -distance, 0), params)
        end)
        local ground: any = ok and result and result.Instance
        if ground and ground:IsA("BasePart") then
            return ground.AssemblyRootPart or ground
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function synchronize(owner: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, root: BasePart, now: number): ()
        local ownParts: {BasePart} = listBodyParts(owner, true)
        local desired: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}
        local candidates: {any} = {}
        local characterModels: {[Model]: boolean} = {}
        local roster: any = players:GetPlayers()

        -- v190: the shield is a FLING shield, not a permanent noclip against
        -- every player. Until v189 every visible body got NoCollisionConstraint
        -- against every one of our parts, so simply walking into someone went
        -- through them (the player's report: "Anti Fling me hace noclipear los
        -- cuerpos de las demás personas"). Now a body is shielded only while it
        -- is actually a hazard -- a part of it moving or spinning at fling
        -- speeds inside RADIUS -- and for HAZARD_HOLD seconds after, so an
        -- ongoing fling keeps its protection between scans. Untouched bodies
        -- keep normal collisions.
        for _, player: Player in ipairs(roster) do
            local other: Model? = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character or nil
            if other and other ~= owner and other.Parent then
                characterModels[other] = true
                if playerShield then
                    local otherRoot: BasePart? = other:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
                    local distance: number = otherRoot
                        and (otherRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                        or math.huge
                    if distance <= RADIUS then
                        local parts: {BasePart} = listBodyParts(other, false)
                        local hazard: boolean = false
                        for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
                            if part.CanCollide and fastPart(part, nil) then
                                hazard = true
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if hazard then
                            dangerousUntil[other] = now + HAZARD_HOLD
                            dangerUntil = math.max(dangerUntil, now + HAZARD_HOLD)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Release bodies that are no longer a threat, then rebuild the budget
        -- from the ones that still are.
        if playerShield then
            for model: Model, expiresAt: number in pairs(dangerousUntil) do
                if expiresAt <= now or not model.Parent then
                    dangerousUntil[model] = nil
                end
            end
            for model: Model in pairs(dangerousUntil) do
                local otherRoot: BasePart? = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
                local distance: number = otherRoot
                    and (otherRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    or math.huge
                local parts: {BasePart} = listBodyParts(model, true)
                table.insert(candidates, {model = model, distance = distance, parts = parts})
                for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
                    desired[part] = true
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(candidates, function(a: any, b: any): boolean return a.distance < b.distance end)

        -- The query is local and bounded. Anchored geometry, the supporting
        -- platform/assembly, seats and tools keep their normal interactions.
        -- A fast loose part is suppressed only briefly while it remains risky.
        if impactShield and not humanoid.Sit and not humanoid.SeatPart then
            local overlap: any = nil
            pcall(function(): ()
                overlap = OverlapParams.new()
                overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {owner}
                overlap.MaxParts = MAX_PARTS
                overlap.RespectCanCollide = true
            end)
            local ok: boolean, nearby: any = pcall(function(): any
                return world:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, RADIUS, overlap)
            end)
            if not ok or type(nearby) ~= "table" then
                if not warnedOverlap and type(host.notify) == "function" then
                    warnedOverlap = true
                    host.notify("Anti Fling: moving-object scan unavailable; player protection remains active.")
                end
            else
                local floorAssembly: BasePart? = supportAssembly(root, humanoid, owner)
                for _, instance: Instance in ipairs(nearby) do
                    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local part: BasePart = instance :: BasePart
                        local isCharacterPart: boolean = false
                        local ancestor: Instance? = part.Parent
                        while ancestor and ancestor ~= world do
                            if characterModels[ancestor :: any] then isCharacterPart = true break end
                            ancestor = ancestor.Parent
                        end
                        local inOwner: boolean = part:IsDescendantOf(owner)
                        local isTool: boolean = isToolPart(part)
                        local assembly: BasePart? = part.AssemblyRootPart or part
                        -- Ordinary weapon/tools remain interactive. An extreme
                        -- spinning/flying handle is treated as a hazard, at 3x
                        -- the loose-object threshold, only while it is nearby.
                        if part.Parent and part.CanCollide and not part.Anchored and not inOwner
                            and (not isCharacterPart or isTool)
                            and (not floorAssembly or assembly ~= floorAssembly)
                            and fastPart(part, if isTool then 3 else nil) then
                            hazardSeen[part] = now
                            dangerUntil = math.max(dangerUntil, now + HAZARD_HOLD)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for part: BasePart, seen: number in pairs(hazardSeen) do
                if not part.Parent or now - seen > HAZARD_HOLD then
                    hazardSeen[part] = nil
                else
                    desired[part] = true
                end
            end
        else
            table.clear(hazardSeen)
        end

        -- Allocate the finite budget afresh in priority order: newly dangerous
        -- objects first, then nearest players. Otherwise 2,048 older/farther
        -- links could permanently starve a new incoming threat.
        local ordered: {BasePart} = {}
        local included: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}
        local function include(part: BasePart): ()
            if desired[part] and part.Parent and not included[part] then
                included[part] = true
                table.insert(ordered, part)
            end
        end
        local hazards: {BasePart} = {}
        for part: BasePart in pairs(hazardSeen) do table.insert(hazards, part) end
        table.sort(hazards, function(a: BasePart, b: BasePart): boolean
            return (a.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < (b.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        end)
        for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(hazards) do include(part) end
        if playerShield then
            for _, candidate: any in ipairs(candidates) do
                for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(candidate.parts) do include(part) end
            end
        end
        local accepted: {[BasePart]: {[BasePart]: boolean}} = {}
        local allocated: number = 0
        for _, other: BasePart in ipairs(ordered) do
            if allocated >= MAX_LINKS then break end
            local perLocal: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}
            for _, own: BasePart in ipairs(ownParts) do
                if allocated >= MAX_LINKS then break end
                if own ~= other then
                    perLocal[own] = true
                    allocated += 1
                end
            end
            if next(perLocal) then accepted[other] = perLocal end
        end
        -- Remove old or lower-priority pairs before filling the new budget.
        for other: BasePart, perLocal: {[BasePart]: any} in pairs(links) do
            local wanted: {[BasePart]: boolean}? = accepted[other]
            for own: BasePart, constraint: any in pairs(perLocal) do
                if not wanted or not wanted[own] or not own.Parent or not other.Parent then
                    pcall(function(): () constraint:Destroy() end)
                    perLocal[own] = nil
                end
            end
            if next(perLocal) == nil then links[other] = nil end
        end
        for other: BasePart, wanted: {[BasePart]: boolean} in pairs(accepted) do
            local perLocal: {[BasePart]: any} = links[other] or {}
            links[other] = perLocal
            for own: BasePart in pairs(wanted) do
                if not perLocal[own] then
                    local ok: boolean, constraint: any = pcall(function(): any
                        local link: NoCollisionConstraint = Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")
                        link.Part0, link.Part1 = own, other
                        link.Parent = own
                        return link
                    end)
                    if ok and constraint then perLocal[own] = constraint end
                end
            end
            if next(perLocal) == nil then links[other] = nil end
        end
    end

    local function step(): ()
        if not enabled then return end
        local owner: Model?, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = host.getCharacterParts()
        if owner ~= character then
            destroyLinks()
            character = owner
            nextScan = 0
        end
        if not owner or not humanoid or not root or not owner.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            destroyLinks()
            return
        end
        if isBusy() then
            if not suspended then destroyLinks() end
            suspended = true
            return
        end
        if suspended then suspended = false nextScan = 0 end
        local now: number = os.clock()
        if now >= nextScan then
            nextScan = now + SCAN_INTERVAL
            local ok: boolean, err: any = pcall(synchronize, owner, humanoid, root, now)
            if not ok then
                -- A streaming object may disappear during the scan. Retry on
                -- the next interval, without leaving partial constraints stuck.
                destroyLinks()
                if type(host.warn) == "function" then host.warn("Anti Fling: " .. tostring(err)) end
            end
        end
        if now > dangerUntil or root.Anchored or humanoid.Sit or humanoid.SeatPart then return end
        -- Emergency damping is only armed by a nearby extreme mover. Normal
        -- sprinting, jumps, vehicles and game launch pads are not capped merely
        -- because this feature is on.
        local walkSpeed: number = math.max(16, tonumber(humanoid.WalkSpeed) or 16)
        local speed: any = framework and (framework:GetModule("Speed Settings") or framework:GetModule("Speed Hack"))
        if speed and speed.Enabled and speed.Options.Speed then
            walkSpeed = math.max(walkSpeed, tonumber(speed.Options.Speed.Value) or 0)
        end
        local jumpPower: number = math.max(50, tonumber(humanoid.JumpPower) or 50)
        local velocity: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local planar: Vector3 = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
        local limit: number = math.max(120, walkSpeed * 4)
        local riseLimit: number = math.max(180, jumpPower * 4)
        local nextVelocity: Vector3 = velocity
        local changed: boolean = false
        if planar.Magnitude > limit then
            local move: Vector3 = humanoid.MoveDirection
            local direction: Vector3 = move.Magnitude > 0.05 and move.Unit * walkSpeed or Vector3.zero
            nextVelocity = Vector3.new(direction.X, nextVelocity.Y, direction.Z)
            changed = true
        end
        if nextVelocity.Y > riseLimit then
            nextVelocity = Vector3.new(nextVelocity.X, riseLimit, nextVelocity.Z)
            changed = true
        end
        pcall(function(): ()
            if root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 25 then
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
            if changed then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = nextVelocity end
        end)
    end

    local function toggleAntiFling(value: boolean): ()
        enabled = value == true
        -- v190: MM2's Fling card and Walk Fling read this flag to warn and
        -- refuse while the shield is on (it cancels the contact a fling needs).
        if host.state then host.state.antiFlingActive = enabled end
        disconnect("AntiFling")
        destroyLinks()
        character = nil
        nextScan = 0
        suspended = false
        if enabled then
            featureConnections.AntiFling = host.TaskManager:Connect(step, nil, "Anti Fling")
        end
    end

    feature = host.createUniversalFeature(
        "Anti Fling",
        "Collision Shield: local player and extreme-object protection",
        2,
        toggleAntiFling,
        {categoryName = "Utilities"}
    )
    host.addToggleOption(feature, "Player Shield", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        playerShield = value == true
        nextScan = 0
        if not playerShield and not impactShield then destroyLinks() end
    end, "Shield yourself only from bodies that are moving or spinning at fling speeds nearby, for a moment after each hit. Calm players keep normal collisions, so you no longer walk through their bodies.")
    host.addToggleOption(feature, "Impact Shield", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        impactShield = value == true
        nextScan = 0
        if not playerShield and not impactShield then destroyLinks() end
    end, "Temporarily avoid nearby extreme-speed loose objects; support platforms, seated vehicles and ordinary tools are left alone.")
    host.addFeatureTooltip(feature,
        "Collision Shield only changes local collision pairs. Extremely fast/streamed objects and server-owned physics can still launch you.")

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        toggleAntiFling(false)
        if host.state then host.state.antiFlingActive = false end
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return feature
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then pcall(activeCleanup) end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

function Module.pointUnder(context: Runtime, screenPosition: Vector3): Vector3?
    local host: any = context.host
    local currentWorkspace: Workspace = host.workspace or workspace
    local camera: Camera? = currentWorkspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
        return nil
    end
    local resolvedCamera: Camera = camera :: Camera
    local ray: Ray = resolvedCamera:ScreenPointToRay(
        screenPosition.X,
        screenPosition.Y
    )
    local parameters: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    parameters.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    parameters.IgnoreWater = true
    parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
        host.LocalPlayer.Character :: any,
        resolvedCamera,
    }
    local result: RaycastResult? = currentWorkspace:Raycast(
        ray.Origin,
        ray.Direction.Unit * 4096,
        parameters
    )
    return result and result.Position or nil
end

local function matchesName(candidate: string, query: string): boolean
    return string.find(string.lower(candidate), string.lower(query), 1, true) ~= nil
end

function Module.findItem(
    context: Runtime,
    query: string,
    origin: Vector3,
    range: number
): Vector3?
    local host: any = context.host
    local currentWorkspace: Workspace = host.workspace or workspace
    local best: Vector3? = nil
    local bestDistance: number = range
    local character: Model? = host.LocalPlayer.Character

    for _, descendant: Instance in ipairs(currentWorkspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if character and descendant:IsDescendantOf(character) then
            continue
        end
        if not matchesName(descendant.Name, query) then
            continue
        end
        local position: Vector3? = nil
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            position = (descendant :: BasePart).Position
        elseif descendant:IsA("Model") then
            local pivotOk: boolean, pivot: any = pcall(function(): CFrame
                return (descendant :: Model):GetPivot()
            end)
            if pivotOk then
                position = (pivot :: CFrame).Position
            end
        end
        if not position then
            continue
        end
        local distance: number = ((position :: Vector3) - origin).Magnitude
        if distance < bestDistance then
            best = position
            bestDistance = distance
        end
    end
    return best
end

function Module.run(context: Runtime, teleport: any, runtime: any): ()
    if runtime.cancelTravel then runtime.cancelTravel() end
    if teleport.Options.Destination.Value == "MM2" then
        teleport:Notify("Choose a MM2 teleport button below")
        return
    end
    local host: any = context.host
    local entityLibrary: any = context.entity
    local localPlayer: Player = host.LocalPlayer
    local options: any = teleport.Options
    local destination: string = options["Destination"].Value

    local root: BasePart? = characterRoot(localPlayer)
    if not root then
        teleport:Notify("no character")
        return
    end
    local origin: Vector3 = (root :: BasePart).Position
    local range: number = options["Search range"].Value

    if destination == "Tap point" then
        runtime.armedUntil = os.clock() + options["Arm window"].Value
        teleport:Notify("tap where you want to go")
        return
    end

    if destination == "Waypoint" then
        local points=context.services.points
        local position,surface
        if points and runtime.point then position,surface=points.Get(runtime.point) end
        if not position then teleport:Notify("Choose a saved point from Markers first.");return end
        Module.travel(context,teleport,runtime,position,surface==true)
        return
    end

    if destination == "Last position" then
        if not runtime.lastOrigin then
            teleport:Notify("nowhere to go back to")
            return
        end
        Module.travel(context, teleport, runtime, runtime.lastOrigin, false)
        return
    end

    if destination == "Item" then
        local query: string = tostring(options["Item"].Value or "")
        if query == "" then
            teleport:Notify("type an item name first")
            return
        end
        local found: Vector3? = Module.findItem(context, query, origin, range)
        if not found then
            teleport:Notify("no \"" .. query .. "\" within range")
            return
        end
        Module.travel(context, teleport, runtime, found, true)
        return
    end

    entityLibrary:Refresh()
    local target: any = nil
    if destination == "Nearest player" then
        local bestDistance: number = range
        for _, entity: any in ipairs(entityLibrary.List) do
            if options["Skip friends"].Value
                and entityLibrary:IsProtected(entity.Player) then
                continue
            end
            if entity.Distance < bestDistance then
                target = entity
                bestDistance = entity.Distance
            end
        end
    else
        local query: string = tostring(options["Player"].Value or "")
        if query == "" then
            teleport:Notify("type a player name first")
            return
        end
        for _, entity: any in ipairs(entityLibrary.List) do
            if matchesName(entity.Player.Name, query)
                or matchesName(entity.Player.DisplayName, query) then
                target = entity
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if not target then
        teleport:Notify("no matching player")
        return
    end

    local targetPosition: Vector3 = target.RootPart.Position
    local offset: number = options["Player offset"].Value
    local approach: Vector3 = targetPosition - origin
    if offset > 0 and approach.Magnitude > offset then
        targetPosition = targetPosition - approach.Unit * offset
    end
    Module.travel(context, teleport, runtime, targetPosition, false)
end

function Module.travel(
    context: Runtime,
    teleport: any,
    runtime: any,
    destination: Vector3?,
    liftToSurface: boolean
): ()
    local host: any = context.host
    local localPlayer: Player = host.LocalPlayer
    if runtime.cancelTravel then runtime.cancelTravel() end
    if not destination then
        teleport:Notify("nothing there")
        return
    end

    local root: BasePart?, humanoid: Humanoid? = characterRoot(localPlayer)
    if not root then
        return
    end
    local resolvedRoot: BasePart = root :: BasePart
    local options: any = teleport.Options

    runtime.lastOrigin = resolvedRoot.Position

    local target: Vector3 = destination :: Vector3
    if liftToSurface then

        local hipHeight: number = humanoid and (humanoid :: Humanoid).HipHeight or 2
        target = target
            + Vector3.new(0, hipHeight + options["Height offset"].Value, 0)
    end

    local keepMomentum: boolean = options["Keep momentum"].Value
    if options["Movement"].Value == "Instant" then
        resolvedRoot.CFrame = resolvedRoot.CFrame + (target - resolvedRoot.Position)
        if not keepMomentum then
            resolvedRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            resolvedRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        return
    end

    local speed=math.max(0,options["Glide speed"].Value)
    if speed==0 then teleport:Notify("Glide speed must be greater than zero.");return end
    local character=localPlayer.Character
    local connection
    local function finish()
        if connection then connection:Disconnect();connection=nil end
        runtime.cancelTravel=nil
        if context.services.activity then context.services.activity.set("teleport",false) end
        teleport:SetStatus(nil)
    end
    if runtime.cancelTravel then runtime.cancelTravel() end
    runtime.cancelTravel=finish
    if context.services.activity then context.services.activity.set("teleport",true) end
    teleport:SetStatus("Gliding")
    connection=host.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if localPlayer.Character~=character or not resolvedRoot.Parent
            or characterRoot(localPlayer)~=resolvedRoot or humanoid and humanoid.Health<=0 then finish();return end
        local offset=target-resolvedRoot.Position
        local distance=offset.Magnitude
        local amount=math.min(distance,speed*math.clamp(dt,0,0.1))
        if distance<=amount+0.001 then
            resolvedRoot.CFrame=resolvedRoot.CFrame+(target-resolvedRoot.Position)
            if not keepMomentum then resolvedRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;resolvedRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end
            finish();return
        end
        if distance>0 then resolvedRoot.CFrame+=offset.Unit*amount end
        if not keepMomentum then resolvedRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;resolvedRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end
    end)
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        pcall(activeCleanup)
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "FreezeMovements",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local TaskManager: any = host.TaskManager
    local featureConnections: any = host.featureConnections
    local disconnectFeatureConnection: any = host.disconnectFeatureConnection
    local getCharacterParts: any = host.getCharacterParts
    local createUniversalFeature: any = host.createUniversalFeature
    local addCycleOption: any = host.addCycleOption
    local addToggleOption: any = host.addToggleOption
    local addNumberOption: any = host.addNumberOption
    -- "Position Lock" is what the row used to call "Anchor": it pins the body
    -- where it stands. The new name says what the user sees, and the extra rows
    -- let the lock be tuned instead of being an all-or-nothing anchor.
    local LOCK_MODE: string = "Position Lock"
    local MOTION_MODE: string = "Motion"
    local freezeSettings = {
        mode = LOCK_MODE,
        emotes = true,
        animation = false,
        anyEmote = true,
        lockRotation = true,
        returnDistance = 0,
        keepGravity = false,
    }
    -- An old saved emote mode must not silently become Position Lock on upgrade.
    local config: any = host.configData
    if config and config.values and config.states then
        local key: string = "Movement.FreezeMovements.Freezemode"
        local legacy: any = config.values[key]
        if legacy == "Freeze Emotes" or legacy == "Glitch Animations" then
            config.values[key] = MOTION_MODE
            local prefix: string = "Movement.FreezeMovements."
            if config.states[prefix .. "FreezeEmotes"] == nil then
                config.states[prefix .. "FreezeEmotes"] = legacy == "Freeze Emotes"
            end
            if config.states[prefix .. "FreezeAnimation"] == nil then
                config.states[prefix .. "FreezeAnimation"] = legacy == "Glitch Animations"
            end
        elseif legacy == "Anchor" or legacy == "Freeze Physics" then
            -- Renamed mode, same behaviour.
            config.values[key] = LOCK_MODE
        end
    end
    local FreezeFeature: any = nil
    local originalFreezeState = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    -- Motion never changes movement physics. Managed tracks are local;
    -- cross-client visibility depends on the game's animation replication.
    local stickyEmoteTracks: {any} = {}
    local emoteLastSeen: {[any]: number} = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

    local function getAnimator(humanoid: any): any
        local animator: any = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator and humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
            local character: any = humanoid.Parent
            animator = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
        end
        return animator
    end

    local emoteConnection: any = nil
    local catalogEmoteConnection: any = nil
    local emoteGeneration: number = 0
    local watchedHumanoid: any = nil
    local watchedAnimator: any = nil
    local watchedAnimate: any = nil
    local nextMetadataRefresh: number = 0
    local freezeEnabled: boolean = false
    local resolvedAssets: {[number]: boolean} = {}
    local assetAttempts: {[number]: number} = {}
    local pendingEmoteTracks: {any} = {}
    local lastMetadataRefresh: number = -math.huge
    local emoteNames: {[string]: boolean} = {}
    local emoteIds: {[string]: boolean} = {}
    local managedEmotes: {[any]: any} = {}
    local ownedEmotes: {[any]: boolean} = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local isEmoteTrack: (any) -> boolean

    local function clearStickyEmoteTracks(): ()
        emoteGeneration += 1
        if emoteConnection then emoteConnection:Disconnect() end
        if catalogEmoteConnection then catalogEmoteConnection:Disconnect() end
        emoteConnection = nil
        catalogEmoteConnection = nil
        local previousHumanoid: any = watchedHumanoid
        watchedHumanoid = nil
        watchedAnimator = nil
        watchedAnimate = nil
        resolvedAssets = {}
        assetAttempts = {}
        pendingEmoteTracks = {}
        local stopped: {[any]: boolean} = {}
        local function stopOnce(track: any): ()
            if track and not stopped[track] then
                stopped[track] = true
                pcall(function(): () track:Stop(0.1) end)
            end
        end
        -- The original Animate track can still be playing even if we never
        -- had to hand it off. OFF must release that source as well as ours.
        for _, source: any in ipairs(stickyEmoteTracks) do stopOnce(source) end
        local animator: any = getAnimator(previousHumanoid)
        if animator then
            pcall(function(): ()
                for _, track: any in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                    if track.IsPlaying and not ownedEmotes[track] and isEmoteTrack(track) then stopOnce(track) end
                end
            end)
        end
        for _, track: any in pairs(managedEmotes) do
            stopOnce(track)
            pcall(function(): () track:Destroy() end)
        end
        managedEmotes = {}
        ownedEmotes = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        emoteNames = {}
        emoteIds = {}
        stickyEmoteTracks = {}
        emoteLastSeen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    end

    local CLASSIC_EMOTES = {
        dance = true, dance1 = true, dance2 = true, dance3 = true,
        wave = true, point = true, cheer = true, laugh = true,
    }
    -- Any emote, not only Roblox's own: games ship their own dance/taunt clips
    -- with arbitrary names and asset IDs, so the identifier is a name keyword
    -- (checked on the track and on up to six parents) instead of a fixed list.
    local EMOTE_KEYWORDS = {
        "emote", "dance", "dancing", "taunt", "celebrat", "cheer", "wave",
        "laugh", "salute", "groove", "pose", "victory", "expression",
        "emoji", "flex", "party", "clap", "bow", "ridicule", "point",
    }
    -- ...but a weapon swing is not an emote, and it often sits on the same
    -- Action priority. These win over a keyword so "SwordWave" stays a swing.
    local NON_EMOTE_KEYWORDS = {
        "attack", "shoot", "slash", "stab", "swing", "punch", "kick", "reload",
        "equip", "unequip", "tool", "hit", "block", "parry", "cast", "spell",
        "sword", "gun", "knife", "punch", "throw", "fling",
    }

    local function hasKeyword(name: string, list: {string}): boolean
        local lower: string = string.lower(name)
        for _, keyword: string in ipairs(list) do
            if string.find(lower, keyword, 1, true) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function looksLikeEmoteName(name: string): boolean
        local lower: string = string.lower(name)
        if emoteNames[lower] then return true end
        if hasKeyword(lower, NON_EMOTE_KEYWORDS) then return false end
        lower = lower:gsub("anim$", "")
        if CLASSIC_EMOTES[lower] == true then return true end
        return hasKeyword(lower, EMOTE_KEYWORDS)
    end

    isEmoteTrack = function(track: any): boolean
        -- Action priority is also used by weapon attacks; it is NOT an
        -- emote identifier. Avoid substring matches such as SpinAttack.
        if looksLikeEmoteName(tostring(track.Name or "")) then return true end
        local animation: any = track.Animation
        if typeof(animation) == "Instance" then
            if looksLikeEmoteName(animation.Name) then return true end
            local node: any = animation.Parent
            for _depth: number = 1, 6 do
                if not node then break end
                if looksLikeEmoteName(node.Name) then return true end
                node = node.Parent
            end
            local id: string? = string.match(animation.AnimationId, "%d+")
            if id and emoteIds[id] then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Custom emotes whose name says nothing ("Animation", "Clip", "Pose 3"):
    -- while the body is standing still, a looped Action/Idle clip that nobody
    -- blacklisted is an emote the game started, so Motion holds it too. A
    -- moving body is never scored this way, which keeps walk cycles and weapon
    -- swings out even when their names are meaningless.
    local function looksLikeStandingEmote(humanoid: any, root: any, track: any): boolean
        if not freezeSettings.anyEmote then return false end
        if not track or ownedEmotes[track] or isEmoteTrack(track) then return false end
        local name: string = tostring(track.Name or "")
        if hasKeyword(name, NON_EMOTE_KEYWORDS) then return false end
        local animation: any = track.Animation
        if typeof(animation) ~= "Instance" then return false end
        if track.Looped ~= true then return false end
        local priority: any = track.Priority
        if priority ~= Enum.AnimationPriority.Action and priority ~= Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle then
            return false
        end
        if root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 2 then
            return false
        end
        local ok: boolean, state: any = pcall(function(): any return humanoid:GetState() end)
        if ok and (state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall) then
            return false
        end
        return true
    end

    local function rememberEmote(track: any): ()
        -- A newly selected emote replaces the previous held emote. Never
        -- layer a whole history of dances on the same joints.
        for source: any, managed: any in pairs(managedEmotes) do
            pcall(function(): () managed:Stop(0.1) end)
            pcall(function(): () managed:Destroy() end)
            ownedEmotes[managed] = nil
            managedEmotes[source] = nil
        end
        stickyEmoteTracks = {track}
        emoteLastSeen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        emoteLastSeen[track] = os.clock()
    end

    local function freezeEmotesTick(humanoid: any, root: any): ()
        -- Hold the selected emote while walking with a track Animate does
        -- not own. Keep it through jumps; release on death, replacement,
        -- mode change or disable.
        local animator: any = getAnimator(humanoid)
        if not animator then
            if watchedAnimator then clearStickyEmoteTracks() end
            return
        end
        local animate = humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Parent:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        -- Avatar descriptions/Animate are often installed AFTER respawn.
        -- Retry metadata at a bounded rate, and immediately on replacement.
        if watchedHumanoid ~= humanoid or watchedAnimator ~= animator
            or watchedAnimate ~= animate or os.clock() >= nextMetadataRefresh then
            if watchedHumanoid ~= humanoid or watchedAnimator ~= animator then
                clearStickyEmoteTracks()
            else
                if emoteConnection then emoteConnection:Disconnect(); emoteConnection = nil end
                if catalogEmoteConnection then catalogEmoteConnection:Disconnect(); catalogEmoteConnection = nil end
            end
            watchedHumanoid = humanoid
            watchedAnimator = animator
            watchedAnimate = animate
            lastMetadataRefresh = os.clock()
            nextMetadataRefresh = lastMetadataRefresh + 2
            -- Catalog asset IDs are NOT necessarily the AnimationId played
            -- by Animate. Prefer the actual track reported by the engine.
            -- This event requires executor permissions on some client builds;
            -- a denied connection must not prevent the metadata fallback.
            pcall(function(): ()
                catalogEmoteConnection = humanoid.EmoteTriggered:Connect(function(success: boolean, track: any): ()
                    if success and track and watchedHumanoid == humanoid and not ownedEmotes[track] then
                        local animation: any = track.Animation
                        if animation then
                            local id: string? = string.match(animation.AnimationId, "%d+")
                            if id then emoteIds[id] = true end
                        end
                        rememberEmote(track)
                    end
                end)
            end)
            local catalogAssets: {number} = {}
            pcall(function(): ()
                local description: any = humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
                local ok: boolean, emotes: any = pcall(description.GetEmotes, description)
                description:Destroy()
                if not ok then return end
                local seen: {[number]: boolean} = {}
                for name: string, ids: any in pairs(emotes) do
                    emoteNames[string.lower(name)] = true
                    for _, id: any in ipairs(ids) do
                        emoteIds[tostring(id)] = true
                        local numberId: number? = tonumber(id)
                        if numberId and not seen[numberId] and not resolvedAssets[numberId] and #catalogAssets < 48 then
                            seen[numberId] = true
                            resolvedAssets[numberId] = true
                            assetAttempts[numberId] = (assetAttempts[numberId] or 0) + 1
                            table.insert(catalogAssets, numberId)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            -- Resolve catalog containers without playing an emote to discover
            -- its ID. Never run downloaded scripts; only inspect Animation data.
            local generation: number = emoteGeneration
            if #catalogAssets > 0 and task and game then
                task.spawn(function(): ()
                    for _, assetId: number in ipairs(catalogAssets) do
                        if generation ~= emoteGeneration then return end
                        local ok: boolean, objects: any = pcall(function(): any
                            return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
                        end)
                        if not ok and generation == emoteGeneration and (assetAttempts[assetId] or 0) < 3 then
                            resolvedAssets[assetId] = nil -- bounded retry after transient load failure
                        end
                        if ok and type(objects) == "table" then
                            for _, object: any in ipairs(objects) do
                                pcall(function(): ()
                                    local nodes: {any} = object:GetDescendants()
                                    table.insert(nodes, object)
                                    for _, node: any in ipairs(nodes) do
                                        if generation == emoteGeneration and node:IsA("Animation") then
                                            local id: string? = string.match(node.AnimationId, "%d+")
                                            if id then emoteIds[id] = true end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end)
                                pcall(function(): () object:Destroy() end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            -- R6 /e dance2 commonly plays Animation1/2/3, not a track
            -- named dance2. Read IDs under Animate's named emote folders.
            pcall(function(): ()
                local animate: any = humanoid.Parent:FindFirstChild("Animate")
                if animate then
                    for _, animation: any in ipairs(animate:GetDescendants()) do
                        if animation:IsA("Animation") then
                            local node: any = animation
                            while node and node ~= animate do
                                local name: string = string.lower(node.Name):gsub("anim$", "")
                                if CLASSIC_EMOTES[name] or emoteNames[name] then
                                    local id: string? = string.match(animation.AnimationId, "%d+")
                                    if id then emoteIds[id] = true end
                                    break
                                end
                                node = node.Parent
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            -- Catch tracks at start, before Animate can cancel them on movement.
            emoteConnection = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track: any): ()
                if not ownedEmotes[track] and isEmoteTrack(track) and not emoteLastSeen[track] then
                    rememberEmote(track)
                elseif not ownedEmotes[track] and not emoteLastSeen[track]
                    and looksLikeStandingEmote(humanoid, root, track) then
                    rememberEmote(track)
                elseif not ownedEmotes[track] then
                    if #pendingEmoteTracks >= 8 then table.remove(pendingEmoteTracks, 1) end
                    table.insert(pendingEmoteTracks, {track = track, at = os.clock()})
                    if os.clock() - lastMetadataRefresh >= 0.25 then nextMetadataRefresh = 0 end
                end
            end)
        end
        for index = #pendingEmoteTracks, 1, -1 do
            local candidate = pendingEmoteTracks[index]
            if isEmoteTrack(candidate.track) then
                rememberEmote(candidate.track)
                table.remove(pendingEmoteTracks, index)
            elseif os.clock() - candidate.at > 5 then
                table.remove(pendingEmoteTracks, index)
            end
        end
        local okTracks: boolean, tracks: any = pcall(function(): any
            return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
        end)
        if not okTracks or type(tracks) ~= "table" then
            return
        end
        local playing: {[any]: boolean} = {}
        for _, track: any in ipairs(tracks) do
            if track and track.IsPlaying then
                playing[track] = true
                if not ownedEmotes[track] and not emoteLastSeen[track] and isEmoteTrack(track) then
                    rememberEmote(track)
                end
                if emoteLastSeen[track] then
                    emoteLastSeen[track] = os.clock()
                end
            end
        end
        local moving: boolean = root ~= nil
            and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 1
        local now: number = os.clock()
        for index: number = #stickyEmoteTracks, 1, -1 do
            local track: any = stickyEmoteTracks[index]
            if not track then
                table.remove(stickyEmoteTracks, index)
            elseif playing[track] or (managedEmotes[track] and managedEmotes[track].IsPlaying) then
                emoteLastSeen[track] = now
            else
                local lastSeen: number = emoteLastSeen[track]
                if lastSeen == nil then
                    lastSeen = now
                    emoteLastSeen[track] = now
                end
                -- Only hand off after a recent, recognized source was
                -- cancelled while moving; do not guess from Action priority.
                if moving and now - lastSeen < 1.5 then
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        -- A separate track is essential: Animate owns the
                        -- original and will keep cancelling it when walking.
                        local managed: any = managedEmotes[track]
                        if not managed then
                            managed = animator:LoadAnimation(track.Animation)
                            ownedEmotes[managed] = true
                            managedEmotes[track] = managed
                            managed.Looped = true
                            managed.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                        end
                        if not managed.IsPlaying then managed:Play(0.1) end
                    end)
                elseif now - lastSeen > 0.5 then
                    local managed: any = managedEmotes[track]
                    if managed then
                        pcall(function(): () managed:Stop(0.1) end)
                        pcall(function(): () managed:Destroy() end)
                        managedEmotes[track] = nil
                        ownedEmotes[managed] = nil
                    end
                    table.remove(stickyEmoteTracks, index)
                    emoteLastSeen[track] = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local motionSource: any = nil
    local motionTrack: any = nil
    local motionHumanoid: any = nil
    local motionAnimator: any = nil
    local function clearMotionTrack(): ()
        if motionTrack then
            pcall(function(): () motionTrack:Stop(0.1) end)
            pcall(function(): () motionTrack:Destroy() end)
        end
        motionSource, motionTrack, motionHumanoid, motionAnimator = nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    local LOCOMOTION = {walk=true, run=true, idle=true, jump=true, fall=true,
        climb=true, swim=true, swimidle=true}
    local function isLocomotion(track: any): boolean
        if not track or ownedEmotes[track] or isEmoteTrack(track) then return false end
        if track.Priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement then return true end
        if track.Priority ~= Enum.AnimationPriority.Core and track.Priority ~= Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle then return false end
        local function known(name: any): boolean
            local key: string = string.lower(tostring(name or "")):gsub("anim$", "")
            return LOCOMOTION[key] == true
        end
        if known(track.Name) then return true end
        local node: any = track.Animation
        for _index: number = 1, 5 do
            if not node then break end
            if known(node.Name) then return true end
            node = node.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    local function freezeAnimationTick(humanoid: any): ()
        local animator: any = getAnimator(humanoid)
        if not animator then
            if motionAnimator then clearMotionTrack() end
            return
        end
        if motionHumanoid ~= humanoid or motionAnimator ~= animator then
            clearMotionTrack()
            motionHumanoid = humanoid
            motionAnimator = animator
        end
        if not motionSource then
            local ok: boolean, tracks: any = pcall(function(): any return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() end)
            if not ok or type(tracks) ~= "table" then return end
            local weight: number = -1
            local function consider(track: any): ()
                if not track or not track.IsPlaying or ownedEmotes[track] or isEmoteTrack(track) then
                    return
                end
                local current: number = tonumber(track.WeightCurrent) or 1
                if current > weight then motionSource, weight = track, current end
            end
            -- Roblox's own walk/run/idle clips first: they are the common case
            -- and keep the previous behaviour when a game plays both.
            for _, track: any in ipairs(tracks) do
                if isLocomotion(track) then consider(track) end
            end
            -- Then anything else: a game can drive locomotion with its own clip
            -- (custom rigs, animated vehicles, tool-held run cycles).
            if not motionSource and freezeSettings.anyAnimation then
                for _, track: any in ipairs(tracks) do consider(track) end
            end
        end
        if not motionSource then return end
        -- Lock the selected clip, NOT its TimePosition. Walking continues
        -- looping even while the native controller switches to jump/fall.
        pcall(function(): ()
            if not motionTrack then
                motionTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(motionSource.Animation)
                motionTrack.Looped = true
                motionTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                motionTrack:Play(0.1)
                motionTrack.TimePosition = motionSource.TimePosition
                motionTrack:AdjustSpeed(motionSource.Speed or 1)
            end
            -- Explicit emotes take precedence when both Motion boxes are on.
            local emotePlaying: boolean = false
            if freezeSettings.emotes then
                for _, source: any in ipairs(stickyEmoteTracks) do
                    if source.IsPlaying or (managedEmotes[source] and managedEmotes[source].IsPlaying) then
                        emotePlaying = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if emotePlaying then
                if motionTrack.IsPlaying then motionTrack:Stop(0.1) end
            elseif not motionTrack.IsPlaying then
                motionTrack:Play(0.1)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function restoreFreezeMovements(): ()
        for root: BasePart, original: any in pairs(originalFreezeState) do
            root.Anchored = original.anchored
        end
        originalFreezeState = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    end

    -- Position Lock: keep the body where it stands. Hard by default (anchored),
    -- or with gravity kept so the character can still fall and land; the rows
    -- decide how much of the pose is frozen and how far a push may go before it
    -- is undone.
    local function lockPosition(root: any): ()
        local original: any = originalFreezeState[root]
        if not original then
            local cframe: any = nil
            local look: any = nil
            pcall(function(): ()
                if root.CFrame ~= nil then
                    cframe = root.CFrame
                    look = root.CFrame.LookVector
                end
            end)
            original = {
                anchored = root.Anchored,
                position = root.Position,
                cframe = cframe,
                look = look,
            }
            originalFreezeState[root] = original
        end
        local lockedPosition: any = original.position
        local gravity: boolean = freezeSettings.keepGravity == true
        local lockRotation: boolean = freezeSettings.lockRotation == true
        -- An anchored root cannot physically turn. When rotation is free, pin
        -- the position each frame instead, leaving Roblox's AutoRotate usable.
        root.Anchored = not gravity and lockRotation
        if not gravity and not lockRotation and lockedPosition ~= nil then
            root.Position = lockedPosition
        end
        if root.AssemblyLinearVelocity ~= nil then
            if gravity then
                local vertical: number = tonumber(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) or 0
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(vertical, 0), 0)
            else
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end
        if freezeSettings.lockRotation and root.AssemblyAngularVelocity ~= nil then
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        if freezeSettings.lockRotation and original.look ~= nil then
            pcall(function(): ()
                if CFrame ~= nil and root.CFrame ~= nil then
                    root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + original.look)
                end
            end)
        end
        local limit: number = freezeSettings.returnDistance or 0
        if gravity and limit > 0 and lockedPosition ~= nil and root.Position ~= nil then
            local dx: number = (tonumber(root.Position.X) or 0) - (tonumber(lockedPosition.X) or 0)
            local dz: number = (tonumber(root.Position.Z) or 0) - (tonumber(lockedPosition.Z) or 0)
            if math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) > limit then
                root.Position = Vector3.new(
                    lockedPosition.X or 0,
                    root.Position.Y,
                    lockedPosition.Z or 0
                )
            end
        end
    end

    local toggleFreezeMovements: (boolean) -> ()
    toggleFreezeMovements = function(enabled: boolean): ()
        freezeEnabled = enabled
        disconnectFeatureConnection("FreezeMovements")
        if not enabled then
            disconnectFeatureConnection("FreezeCharacterAdded")
            disconnectFeatureConnection("FreezeCharacterRemoving")
        end
        restoreFreezeMovements()
        clearMotionTrack()
        clearStickyEmoteTracks()
        if not enabled then
            if FreezeFeature then FreezeFeature:SetStatus(nil) end
            return
        end
        local player = host.LocalPlayer
        if player and player.CharacterAdded and not featureConnections.FreezeCharacterAdded then
            featureConnections.FreezeCharacterAdded = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                if freezeEnabled then toggleFreezeMovements(true) end
            end)
        end
        if player and player.CharacterRemoving and not featureConnections.FreezeCharacterRemoving then
            featureConnections.FreezeCharacterRemoving = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
                restoreFreezeMovements()
                clearMotionTrack()
                clearStickyEmoteTracks()
            end)
        end
        FreezeFeature:SetStatus(freezeSettings.mode)
        local previousRoot: any = nil
        featureConnections.FreezeMovements = TaskManager:Connect(function(): ()
            local _, humanoid, root = getCharacterParts()
            if root ~= previousRoot then
                restoreFreezeMovements()
                clearMotionTrack()
                clearStickyEmoteTracks()
                previousRoot = root
            end
            if not humanoid then
                clearMotionTrack()
                clearStickyEmoteTracks()
                return
            end
            if humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
                restoreFreezeMovements()
                clearMotionTrack()
                clearStickyEmoteTracks()
                return
            end
            if freezeSettings.mode == "Motion" then
                if freezeSettings.emotes then freezeEmotesTick(humanoid, root) end
                if freezeSettings.animation then freezeAnimationTick(humanoid) end
            elseif root then
                lockPosition(root)
            end
        end, nil, "Freeze Animations")
    end

    -- v190: renamed Motion Lock -> Freeze Animations at the player's request.
    -- configKey stays "Movement.FreezeMovements", so profiles, keybinds and the
    -- saved mode survive; only the visible title and its task name changed.
    FreezeFeature = createUniversalFeature(
        "Freeze Animations",
        "Pin the body where it stands, or keep any animation playing while moving",
        4,
        toggleFreezeMovements,
        {categoryName = "Utilities", configKey = "Movement.FreezeMovements"}
    )
    local motionRows: {any} = {}
    local lockRows: {any} = {}
    -- addToggleOption returns the button inside the row, addNumberOption
    -- returns the row itself. Resolving once here is what keeps a mode switch
    -- from hiding the whole options container.
    local function rowFor(handle: any): any
        if not handle then
            return nil
        end
        local name: string = typeof(handle) == "Instance" and handle.Name or ""
        if string.sub(name, 1, 7) == "Option_" or string.sub(name, 1, 8) == "Section_" then
            return handle
        end
        return handle.Parent or handle
    end
    local function registerRow(list: {any}, handle: any): ()
        local row: any = rowFor(handle)
        if row == nil or row == FreezeFeature.options then
            return
        end
        table.insert(list, row)
    end
    local function refreshOptionGroups(): ()
        local motion: boolean = freezeSettings.mode == MOTION_MODE
        for _, row: any in ipairs(motionRows) do
            if host.setOptionVisible then
                host.setOptionVisible(FreezeFeature, row, motion)
            else row.Visible = motion end
        end
        for _, row: any in ipairs(lockRows) do
            if host.setOptionVisible then
                host.setOptionVisible(FreezeFeature, row, not motion)
            else row.Visible = not motion end
        end
    end
    local function reapply(): ()
        if FreezeFeature and FreezeFeature.enabled then toggleFreezeMovements(true) end
    end
    addCycleOption(FreezeFeature, "Freeze mode", {LOCK_MODE, MOTION_MODE}, 1, function(value: string): ()
        -- Accept an old saved value without renaming anything on disk twice.
        if value == "Anchor" or value == "Freeze Physics" then
            value = LOCK_MODE
        end
        freezeSettings.mode = value
        refreshOptionGroups()
        reapply()
    end)
    -- ---- Position Lock rows -------------------------------------------------
    local lockHeading: any = host.addSectionOption and host.addSectionOption(FreezeFeature, "Position Lock settings")
    registerRow(lockRows, lockHeading)
    local lockRotation: any = addToggleOption(FreezeFeature, "Lock rotation", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        freezeSettings.lockRotation = value
        reapply()
    end, "Also stop the body from spinning or being spun by the game. OFF keeps the position and lets the character turn.")
    registerRow(lockRows, lockRotation)
    local keepGravity: any = addToggleOption(FreezeFeature, "Keep gravity", false, function(value: boolean): ()
        freezeSettings.keepGravity = value
        reapply()
    end, "Do not anchor the body: it can still fall and land, but pushes and knockback are erased every frame.")
    registerRow(lockRows, keepGravity)
    local returnRow: any = addNumberOption(FreezeFeature, "Return if pushed", 0, 0, 40, function(value: number): ()
        freezeSettings.returnDistance = value
    end, "Studs of drift allowed before the character is snapped back. 0 disables the return.")
    registerRow(lockRows, returnRow)
    -- ---- Motion rows --------------------------------------------------------
    -- The section widget renders its own caption and divider, so the card only
    -- has to keep the row in its visibility group.
    local heading: any = host.addSectionOption and host.addSectionOption(FreezeFeature, "Motion settings")
    registerRow(motionRows, heading)
    local emotes: any = addToggleOption(FreezeFeature, "Freeze Emotes", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        freezeSettings.emotes = value
        if not value then clearStickyEmoteTracks() end
    end, "Keep emotes playing while moving, Roblox's own and the ones a game ships itself. Takes precedence over the locked clip.")
    registerRow(motionRows, emotes)
    local anyEmote: any = addToggleOption(FreezeFeature, "Any emote", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        freezeSettings.anyEmote = value
        if not value then clearStickyEmoteTracks() end
    end, "Hold a custom emote even when its name and asset say nothing: a looped clip started while standing still counts as one.")
    registerRow(motionRows, anyEmote)
    local animation: any = addToggleOption(FreezeFeature, "Freeze Animation", false, function(value: boolean): ()
        freezeSettings.animation = value
        clearMotionTrack()
    end, "Keep the current clip looping through jumps and other movement. Does not freeze a single frame.")
    registerRow(motionRows, animation)
    local anyAnimation: any = addToggleOption(FreezeFeature, "Any animation", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        freezeSettings.anyAnimation = value
        clearMotionTrack()
    end, "Freeze a game's own locomotion clip too, not only Roblox's walk/run/idle set.")
    registerRow(motionRows, anyAnimation)
    refreshOptionGroups()
    activeCleanup = function(): () toggleFreezeMovements(false) end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return FreezeFeature
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        activeCleanup()
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false

export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "Gravity",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local TaskManager: any = host.TaskManager
    local featureConnections: any = host.featureConnections
    local disconnectFeatureConnection: any = host.disconnectFeatureConnection
    local createUniversalFeature: any = host.createUniversalFeature
    local addNumberOption: any = host.addNumberOption
    local workspace: any = host.workspace
    local gravitySettings = {value = 196.2}
    local GravityFeature: any = nil
    local originalGravity: number? = nil

    local function restoreGravity()
        if originalGravity ~= nil then
            workspace.Gravity = originalGravity
            originalGravity = nil
        end
    end

    local function toggleGravity(enabled)
        disconnectFeatureConnection("Gravity")
        if not enabled then
            if GravityFeature then GravityFeature:SetStatus(nil) end
            restoreGravity()
            return
        end

        GravityFeature:SetStatus(tostring(math.round(gravitySettings.value)))
        if originalGravity == nil then originalGravity = workspace.Gravity end
        featureConnections.Gravity = TaskManager:Connect(function()
            if workspace.Gravity ~= gravitySettings.value then
                workspace.Gravity = gravitySettings.value
            end
        end, nil, "Gravity")
    end

    GravityFeature = createUniversalFeature(
        "Gravity",
        "Keep workspace gravity at a custom value",
        5,
        toggleGravity,
        {categoryName = "World"}
    )
    addNumberOption(GravityFeature, "Gravity value", gravitySettings.value, -500, 500, function(value)
        gravitySettings.value = value
        if GravityFeature.enabled then
            GravityFeature:SetStatus(tostring(math.round(value)))
        end
    end)

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        disconnectFeatureConnection("Gravity")
        restoreGravity()
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return GravityFeature
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        activeCleanup()
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module
