export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
    services: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "Infinite Jump",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local framework: any = context.framework
    local services: any = context.services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = host.LocalPlayer
    local UserInputService: UserInputService = host.UserInputService
    local RunService: RunService = host.RunService
    local movementInput: any = services and services.movementInput

    local lastBoostAt: number = -math.huge
    local pressHeld: boolean = false
    local jumpTouch: any = nil
    local heldKey: any = nil
    local infiniteJump: any

    local function mode(): string
        local option: any = infiniteJump and infiniteJump.Options and infiniteJump.Options.Mode
        return option and option.Value == "Rise" and "Rise" or "Normal"
    end

    local function characterParts(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
        local character: Model? = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then
            return nil, nil, nil
        end
        local humanoid: Humanoid? = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid?
        local root: BasePart? = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
        return character, humanoid, root
    end

    local function canBoostJump(humanoid: Humanoid?): boolean
        if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return false
        end
        local currentState: Enum.HumanoidStateType = humanoid:GetState()
        return currentState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
            and currentState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
            and currentState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
            and currentState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            and currentState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding
            and currentState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            and currentState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
    end

    infiniteJump = framework.Categories.Exploits:CreateModule({
        Name = "Infinite Jump",
        Category = "Exploits",
        ConfigKey = "Universal.InfiniteJump",
        Order = 10,
        Tooltip = "Normal adds one jump per press; Rise ascends while the jump key or mobile jump button is held.",
        Function = function(enabled: boolean): ()
            lastBoostAt = -math.huge
            pressHeld = false
            jumpTouch = nil
            heldKey = nil
            if not enabled then
                infiniteJump:SetStatus(nil)
                return
            end

            infiniteJump:SetStatus(mode())

            local function executeAirJump(): ()
                local _, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = characterParts()
                if not humanoid or not root or root.Anchored or not canBoostJump(humanoid) then
                    return
                end
                local power: number = infiniteJump.Options["Jump Power"]
                    and infiniteJump.Options["Jump Power"].Value
                    or 50
                -- Leave the first positive ground jump to Roblox on both PC
                -- and mobile. Negative power deliberately inverts takeoff.
                if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and power >= 0 then
                    return
                end
                local now: number = os.clock()
                local interval: number = infiniteJump.Options["Jump interval"] and infiniteJump.Options["Jump interval"].Value or 0.18
                if now - lastBoostAt < interval then
                    return
                end
                lastBoostAt = now

                local velocity: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, power, velocity.Z)
                humanoid:ChangeState(
                    if power < 0
                        then Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
                        else Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
                )
            end

            local function onJumpRequested(): ()
                if UserInputService and type(UserInputService.GetFocusedTextBox) == "function"
                    and UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
                if pressHeld then
                    return
                end
                pressHeld = true
                if UserInputService and UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
                    local okTouches: boolean, touches: any = pcall(function(): any
                        return UserInputService:GetTouches()
                    end)
                    if okTouches and type(touches) == "table" then
                        if #touches == 1 then
                            jumpTouch = touches[1]
                        else
                            local gui: Instance? = LocalPlayer
                                and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                            local touchGui: Instance? = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
                            local button: any = touchGui and touchGui:FindFirstChild("JumpButton", true)
                            if button then
                                local at: Vector2 = button.AbsolutePosition
                                local size: Vector2 = button.AbsoluteSize
                                for _, touch: any in ipairs(touches) do
                                    local p: Vector3 = touch.Position
                                    if p.X >= at.X and p.Y >= at.Y
                                        and p.X <= at.X + size.X
                                        and p.Y <= at.Y + size.Y then
                                        jumpTouch = touch
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                executeAirJump()
            end

            if movementInput and type(movementInput.onJumpRequest) == "function" then
                infiniteJump:Clean(movementInput.onJumpRequest(onJumpRequested))
            elseif UserInputService and UserInputService.JumpRequest then
                infiniteJump:Clean(UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(onJumpRequested))
            end

            -- Direct PC (Spacebar / Gamepad ButtonA) + Mobile TouchGui JumpButton support
            if UserInputService and UserInputService.InputBegan then
                infiniteJump:Clean(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: any, gameProcessed: boolean): ()
                    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
                        local typing: boolean = type(UserInputService.GetFocusedTextBox) == "function"
                            and UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil
                        if not gameProcessed and not typing then
                            heldKey = input.KeyCode
                            onJumpRequested()
                        end
                    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        local gui: Instance? = LocalPlayer
                            and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                        local touchGui: Instance? = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
                        local button: any = touchGui and touchGui:FindFirstChild("JumpButton", true)
                        if button and button.AbsolutePosition and button.AbsoluteSize and input.Position then
                            local at: Vector2 = button.AbsolutePosition
                            local size: Vector2 = button.AbsoluteSize
                            local p: Vector3 = input.Position
                            if p.X >= at.X and p.Y >= at.Y
                                and p.X <= at.X + size.X
                                and p.Y <= at.Y + size.Y then
                                jumpTouch = input
                                pressHeld = true
                                executeAirJump()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end))
            end

            if UserInputService and UserInputService.InputEnded then
                infiniteJump:Clean(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(event: any): ()
                    if (event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA)
                        and (heldKey == nil or heldKey == event.KeyCode) then
                        pressHeld = false
                        heldKey = nil
                        jumpTouch = nil
                    elseif event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                        and not heldKey and (not jumpTouch or event == jumpTouch) then
                        pressHeld = false
                        jumpTouch = nil
                    end
                end))
            end

            if UserInputService and UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased then
                infiniteJump:Clean(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function(): ()
                    pressHeld = false
                    jumpTouch = nil
                    heldKey = nil
                end))
            end
            if UserInputService and UserInputService.TextBoxFocused then
                infiniteJump:Clean(UserInputService.TextBoxFocused:Connect(function(): ()
                    pressHeld = false
                    jumpTouch = nil
                    heldKey = nil
                end))
            end

            if RunService and RunService.PreSimulation then
                infiniteJump:Clean(RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(): ()
                    local _, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = characterParts()
                    if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                        return
                    end
                    local power: number = infiniteJump.Options["Jump Power"]
                        and infiniteJump.Options["Jump Power"].Value
                        or 50
                    local typing: boolean = type(UserInputService.GetFocusedTextBox) == "function"
                        and UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil
                    if typing then
                        pressHeld = false
                        jumpTouch = nil
                        heldKey = nil
                        return
                    end
                    if mode() == "Rise" and pressHeld and not root.Anchored and canBoostJump(humanoid) then
                        -- A held jump is an ongoing vertical velocity, not a
                        -- second auto-jump loop. Preserve horizontal motion.
                        local vel: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, power, vel.Z)
                        if power < 0 and humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
                        end
                    elseif mode() == "Normal" and power < 0
                        and humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                        local vel: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, power, vel.Z)
                        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
                    end
                end))
            end
        end,
    })

    infiniteJump:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Normal", "Rise"},
        Index = 1,
        Function = function(value: string): ()
            if infiniteJump.Enabled then infiniteJump:SetStatus(value) end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Normal = one jump per press in air, Rise = hold to ascend. Jump Power + Interval control both.",
    })

    infiniteJump:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Jump Power",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 250,
        Default = 50,
        Tooltip = "Vertical jump velocity applied in mid-air (1-250). Negative inverts jump.",
    })

    infiniteJump:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Jump interval",
        Min = 0.05,
        Max = 0.6,
        Step = 0.01,
        Default = 0.18,
        Tooltip = "Minimum delay between mid-air jumps in seconds. Default 0.18 s (vanilla-like). Lower = faster spam, higher = slower rhythm.",
    })

    infiniteJump:CreateNote("Jump interval: 0.18 s is default Roblox rhythm. 0.05 s = spam fast, 0.6 s = slow.")

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        if infiniteJump.Enabled then
            infiniteJump:Toggle(false)
        end
    end

    Module.Initialized = true
    return infiniteJump
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        activeCleanup()
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false

export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
    services: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "Jump Settings",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local framework: any = context.framework
    local movementInput: any = context.services and context.services.movementInput
    local UserInputService: any = host.UserInputService or game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local LocalPlayer: Player = host.LocalPlayer or game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

    local originalJumpPower = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) :: {[Humanoid]: {jumpPower: number, useJumpPower: boolean}}

    local function characterParts(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
        local character: Model? = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then
            return nil, nil, nil
        end
        local humanoid: Humanoid? = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root: BasePart? = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
        return character, humanoid, root
    end

    local function restoreJumpPower(): ()
        for humanoid: Humanoid, original in pairs(originalJumpPower) do
            if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                humanoid.JumpPower = original.jumpPower
                humanoid.UseJumpPower = original.useJumpPower
            end
        end
        originalJumpPower = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) :: any
    end

    local function canControlJump(humanoid: Humanoid): boolean
        if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit or humanoid.SeatPart then return false end
        local state = humanoid:GetState()
        return state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
            and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
    end

    local function performHighJump(velocityOverride: number?): ()
        local _, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = characterParts()
        if not humanoid or not root or root.Anchored or not canControlJump(humanoid) then
            return
        end
        local velocityVal: number = velocityOverride or 72
        local current: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
            current.X,
            velocityVal,
            current.Z
        )
        if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
        end
    end

    local longJumpSpeed = 50
    local longJumpMode = "Velocity"

    local function performLongJump(): ()
        local _, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = characterParts()
        if not humanoid or not root or root.Anchored or not canControlJump(humanoid) then
            return
        end
        -- Read live values from options (robust if test sets Value directly)
        local optsMode: any = jump and jump.Options and jump.Options["Long jump mode"]
        local optsSpeed: any = jump and jump.Options and jump.Options["Long jump speed"]
        local mode: string = optsMode and optsMode.Value or longJumpMode
        local speed: number = optsSpeed and optsSpeed.Value or longJumpSpeed
        local moveDir: Vector3 = humanoid.MoveDirection
        local flat: Vector3 = Vector3.new(moveDir.X, 0, moveDir.Z)
        if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then
            local cam: any = host.workspace and host.workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam and cam.CFrame then
                local lv: Vector3 = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                flat = Vector3.new(lv.X, 0, lv.Z)
            else
                flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
            end
        end
        if flat.Magnitude < 0.001 then return end
        flat = flat.Magnitude > 1 and flat.Unit or flat
        local cur: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if mode == "Velocity" then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(flat.X * speed, cur.Y, flat.Z * speed)
        elseif mode == "Impulse" then
            local diff: Vector3 = Vector3.new(flat.X * speed - cur.X, 0, flat.Z * speed - cur.Z)
            if diff.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                root:ApplyImpulse(diff * root.AssemblyMass)
            end
        else -- CFrame: instant teleport forward
            local step: Vector3 = flat * speed * 0.25
            local pos: Vector3 = root.CFrame.Position
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(pos.X + step.X, pos.Y + step.Y, pos.Z + step.Z))
        end
        if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end

    local jump: any
    jump = framework.Categories.Exploits:CreateModule({
        Name = "Jump Settings",
        Category = "Exploits",
        ConfigKey = "Universal.Jump",
        Order = 6,
        Tooltip = "Jump controls: adjust Jump Power, High Jump button, Long Jump button and Auto Jump. Infinite Jump moved to its own module.",
        Function = function(enabled: boolean): ()
            restoreJumpPower()
            if not enabled then
                jump:SetStatus(nil)
                return
            end
            jump:SetStatus("active")
            jump:Clean(function(): () restoreJumpPower() end)
            -- No infinite jump handling here; handled by Infinite Jump module
            jump:Clean(host.RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(): ()
                local opts = jump.Options
                local _, humanoid: Humanoid?, root: BasePart? = characterParts()
                if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                    return
                end
                local canMove = canControlJump(humanoid) and not root.Anchored
                if not canMove then return end

                if opts["Custom jump power"] and opts["Custom jump power"].Value then
                    local wantedPower: number = opts["Jump power"] and opts["Jump power"].Value or 80
                    if originalJumpPower[humanoid] == nil then
                        originalJumpPower[humanoid] = {
                            jumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower,
                            useJumpPower = humanoid.UseJumpPower,
                        }
                    end
                    humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
                    humanoid.JumpPower = wantedPower
                    if wantedPower < 0 and humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                        local curVel: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(curVel.X, wantedPower, curVel.Z)
                    end
                else
                    -- Restore if not using custom
                    if originalJumpPower[humanoid] then
                        humanoid.JumpPower = originalJumpPower[humanoid].jumpPower
                        humanoid.UseJumpPower = originalJumpPower[humanoid].useJumpPower
                        originalJumpPower[humanoid] = nil
                    end
                end

                if canMove and opts["Auto jump"] and opts["Auto jump"].Value then
                    local moveDir: Vector3 = humanoid.MoveDirection
                    if moveDir.Magnitude > 0.05 and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                    end
                end
            end))
        end,
    })

    jump:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Custom jump power",
        Default = false,
        Tooltip = "Enables custom jump height/power for ground jumps.",
    })

    jump:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Jump power",
        Show = {Option = "Custom jump power", Values = {true}},
        Min = 1,
        Max = 250,
        Default = 80,
        Function = function(value: number): ()
            if jump.Enabled and jump.Options["Custom jump power"].Value then
                jump:SetStatus(tostring(math.round(value)))
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Character jump power (default 50). Negative launches downward.",
    })

    jump:CreateButton({
        Name = "High jump",
        Function = function(): ()
            local velocityVal: number = jump.Options["High jump velocity"] and jump.Options["High jump velocity"].Value or 72
            performHighJump(velocityVal)
        end,
        Tooltip = "Launches your character into a single massive vertical jump.",
    })

    jump:CreateSlider({
        Name = "High jump velocity",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 250,
        Default = 72,
        Tooltip = "Vertical velocity for High Jump button. Negative = downward.",
    })

    jump:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto jump",
        Default = false,
        Tooltip = "Continuously jumps while walking on the ground.",
    })

    jump:CreateButton({
        Name = "Long jump",
        Function = function(): ()
            performLongJump()
        end,
        Tooltip = "Horizontal boost in your move/camera direction (button like High Jump). Uses Long jump mode/speed below.",
    })

    jump:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Long jump mode",
        List = {"Velocity", "Impulse", "CFrame"},
        Index = 1,
        Function = function(value: string): ()
            longJumpMode = value
        end,
        Tooltip = "How Long Jump is applied: Velocity (smooth), Impulse (physics), CFrame (teleport).",
    })

    jump:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Long jump speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 250,
        Default = 50,
        Function = function(value: number): ()
            longJumpSpeed = value
        end,
        Tooltip = "Horizontal speed for Long Jump button in studs/s. Negative = backwards.",
    })

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        if jump.Enabled then jump:Toggle(false) end
        restoreJumpPower()
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return jump
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        pcall(activeCleanup)
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export type Runtime = {framework: any, entity: any, host: any, services: any}

local Module = {Name = "Speed Settings", PlaceId = 0, Events = {} :: {[string]: any}, Initialized = false}
local activeCleanup

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host, framework = context.host, context.framework
    local player, world = host.LocalPlayer, host.workspace or workspace
    local walk, speed
    local teleportElapsed, lastMode = 0, nil
    local wallParams, wallCharacter, wallGroup

    local function clearWallFilter()
        if wallParams then wallParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {} end
        wallCharacter = nil
    end

    local function parts()
        local character = player.Character
        return character, character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"),
            character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function restoreWalk()
        if walk then
            if walk.humanoid.Parent and walk.humanoid.WalkSpeed == walk.applied then walk.humanoid.WalkSpeed = walk.base end
            walk = nil
        end
    end
    local function applyWalk(humanoid, value)
        if walk and walk.humanoid ~= humanoid then restoreWalk() end
        if not walk then walk = {humanoid=humanoid,base=humanoid.WalkSpeed} end
        local current = humanoid.WalkSpeed
        if walk.applied ~= nil and current ~= walk.applied then walk.base = current end
        if current ~= value then humanoid.WalkSpeed = value end
        walk.applied = value
        if value < 0 then
            local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection
            if moveDir and moveDir.Magnitude > 0.01 and type(humanoid.Move) == "function" then
                humanoid:Move(-moveDir, false)
            end
        end
    end
    local function direction(humanoid)
        local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
        local flat = Vector3.new(move.X,0,move.Z)
        return flat.Magnitude > 1 and flat.Unit or flat
    end
    local function blocked(root, step)
        if step.Magnitude < 0.001 then return step end
        if not wallParams then
            wallParams = RaycastParams.new()
            wallParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            wallParams.RespectCanCollide, wallParams.IgnoreWater = true, true
        end
        if wallCharacter ~= player.Character then
            wallCharacter = player.Character
            wallParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = player.Character and {player.Character} or {}
        end
        if wallGroup ~= root.CollisionGroup then
            wallGroup = root.CollisionGroup
            wallParams.CollisionGroup = wallGroup
        end
        if world.Blockcast then
            local hit = world:Blockcast(root.CFrame,root.Size*0.9,step,wallParams)
            return hit and step.Unit*math.max(0,hit.Distance-0.1) or step
        end
        local hit = world:Raycast(root.Position,step,wallParams)
        return hit and step.Unit*math.max(0,(hit.Position-root.Position).Magnitude-root.Size.Magnitude*0.5-0.1) or step
    end
    local function stepSpeed(dt)
        local _, humanoid, root = parts()
        if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            restoreWalk()
            if speed.ClearSprint then speed.ClearSprint() end
            return
        end
        if not speed.Enabled and not speed.SprintHeld then restoreWalk(); return end
        local opts = speed.Options
        local mode = speed.Enabled and opts.Mode.Value or "WalkSpeed"
        local target = speed.Enabled and opts.Speed.Value or 0
        if speed.SprintHeld then target = math.max(target,30) end
        if mode ~= lastMode then restoreWalk(); teleportElapsed = 0; lastMode = mode end

        -- Vehicle handling: Velocity/Impulse/CFrame/Teleport work in any vehicle/seat
        local seat: any = humanoid.SeatPart
        local isSeated: boolean = seat ~= nil or humanoid.Sit
        if isSeated then
            if speed.SprintFrame then speed.SprintFrame(speed.SprintHeld and false, root) end
            -- WalkSpeed cannot drive a vehicle
            if mode == "WalkSpeed" then restoreWalk(); return end
            local vehicle: any = seat
            -- Fallback: if SeatPart is Vehicleseat but root is still character, try seat parent
            if not vehicle or not vehicle.Parent then restoreWalk(); return end
            -- Prevent affecting WalkSpeed while seated
            restoreWalk()
            local fly = framework.GetModule and framework:GetModule("Fly")
            if vehicle.Anchored or (fly and fly.Enabled) then return end
            local move = direction(humanoid)
            -- Apply vehicle multiplier
            local vehicleMul: number = opts["Vehicle multiplier"] and opts["Vehicle multiplier"].Value or 1.2
            local vehicleTarget: number = target * vehicleMul
            local response: number = opts["Response"] and opts["Response"].Value or 1
            local keepY: boolean = opts["Keep vertical"] == nil or opts["Keep vertical"].Value
            if mode == "Velocity" or (mode == "WalkSpeed" and target < 0) then
                local vel: Vector3 = vehicle.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                local targetVel: Vector3 = Vector3.new(move.X*vehicleTarget, keepY and vel.Y or 0, move.Z*vehicleTarget)
                if response >= 1 then
                    vehicle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = targetVel
                else
                    -- Smooth response: lerp
                    local lerpAlpha: number = math.clamp(response * (dt or 1/60) * 12, 0, 1)
                    local curXZ: Vector3 = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
                    local tarXZ: Vector3 = Vector3.new(targetVel.X, 0, targetVel.Z)
                    local newXZ: Vector3 = Vector3.new(curXZ.X + (tarXZ.X - curXZ.X) * lerpAlpha, 0, curXZ.Z + (tarXZ.Z - curXZ.Z) * lerpAlpha)
                    vehicle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(newXZ.X, targetVel.Y, newXZ.Z)
                    if move.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                        -- Braking when no input
                        local brake: number = opts["Braking"] and opts["Braking"].Value or 0.8
                        if brake < 0.99 then
                            local brakeAlpha: number = math.clamp((1-brake) * (dt or 1/60) * 10, 0, 1)
                            local curV: Vector3 = vehicle.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                            vehicle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(curV.X * (1-brakeAlpha), curV.Y, curV.Z * (1-brakeAlpha))
                            if vehicle.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 0.5 then vehicle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, curV.Y, 0) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif mode == "Impulse" then
                local vel: Vector3 = vehicle.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                local targetVelXZ: Vector3 = Vector3.new(move.X*vehicleTarget, 0, move.Z*vehicleTarget)
                local diff: Vector3 = Vector3.new(targetVelXZ.X - vel.X, 0, targetVelXZ.Z - vel.Z)
                -- Response scales impulse
                diff *= math.clamp(response, 0.2, 2)
                if diff.Magnitude > 0.001 then vehicle:ApplyImpulse(diff * vehicle.AssemblyMass) end
            elseif move.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                local elapsed = math.clamp(dt or 0,0,0.1)
                if mode == "Teleport" then
                    teleportElapsed += elapsed
                    local interval = opts["Burst delay"].Value
                    if teleportElapsed < interval then return end
                    teleportElapsed %= interval
                    elapsed = interval
                end
                local step = move * vehicleTarget * elapsed
                if opts["Wall check"].Value then step = blocked(vehicle, step) end
                -- Move vehicle, not character
                vehicle.CFrame += step
                -- Also move character root to stay with vehicle
                if root and root.Parent then
                    root.CFrame = vehicle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)
                end
            else teleportElapsed = 0 end
            if speed.Enabled and opts["Auto jump"].Value and move.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                -- Auto jump not applicable while seated
            end
            return
        end
        -- On-foot handling
        if speed.SprintFrame then speed.SprintFrame(speed.SprintHeld and not isSeated,root) end
        local fly = framework.GetModule and framework:GetModule("Fly")
        local state = humanoid:GetState()
        if root.Anchored or (fly and fly.Enabled) or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then restoreWalk(); return end
        if mode == "WalkSpeed" then applyWalk(humanoid,target) else restoreWalk() end
        local move = direction(humanoid)
        if speed.Enabled and opts["Auto jump"].Value and move.Magnitude > 0.05 and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
        if mode == "WalkSpeed" and target >= 0 then return end
        local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local response: number = opts["Response"] and opts["Response"].Value or 1
        local keepY: boolean = opts["Keep vertical"] == nil or opts["Keep vertical"].Value
        local braking: number = opts["Braking"] and opts["Braking"].Value or 0.8
        if mode == "Velocity" or (mode == "WalkSpeed" and target < 0) then
            local targetVel: Vector3 = Vector3.new(move.X*target, keepY and velocity.Y or 0, move.Z*target)
            if response >= 1 or move.Magnitude < 0.01 and braking >= 0.99 then
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = targetVel
            else
                local lerpAlpha: number = math.clamp(response * (dt or 1/60) * 12, 0, 1)
                local curXZ: Vector3 = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
                local tarXZ: Vector3 = Vector3.new(targetVel.X, 0, targetVel.Z)
                local newXZ: Vector3 = Vector3.new(curXZ.X + (tarXZ.X - curXZ.X) * lerpAlpha, 0, curXZ.Z + (tarXZ.Z - curXZ.Z) * lerpAlpha)
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(newXZ.X, keepY and velocity.Y or targetVel.Y, newXZ.Z)
                if move.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                    if braking < 0.99 then
                        local brakeAlpha: number = math.clamp((1-braking) * (dt or 1/60) * 10, 0, 1)
                        local curV: Vector3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(curV.X * (1-brakeAlpha), curV.Y, curV.Z * (1-brakeAlpha))
                        if root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 0.5 and keepY then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, velocity.Y, 0)
                        elseif root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 0.5 then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif mode == "Impulse" then
            local diff = Vector3.new(move.X*target-velocity.X,0,move.Z*target-velocity.Z)
            diff *= math.clamp(response, 0.2, 2)
            if diff.Magnitude > 0.001 then root:ApplyImpulse(diff*root.AssemblyMass) end
        elseif move.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            local elapsed = math.clamp(dt or 0,0,0.1)
            if mode == "Teleport" then
                teleportElapsed += elapsed
                local interval = opts["Burst delay"].Value
                if teleportElapsed < interval then return end
                teleportElapsed %= interval
                elapsed = interval
            end
            local speedDelta = target < 0 and (target - humanoid.WalkSpeed) or math.max(0, target - humanoid.WalkSpeed)
            local step = move * speedDelta * elapsed
            -- Response scales CFrame step
            step *= math.clamp(response, 0.5, 2)
            if opts["Wall check"].Value then step = blocked(root,step) end
            root.CFrame += step
        else teleportElapsed = 0 end
    end
    speed = framework.Categories.Exploits:CreateModule({
        Name="Speed Settings",Category="Exploits",ConfigKey="Universal.Speed",Order=1,
        Tooltip="Movement with full vehicle support. WalkSpeed on foot only; Velocity/Impulse/CFrame/Teleport work in any vehicle or object using velocity.",
        Function=function(enabled)
            restoreWalk(); teleportElapsed, lastMode = 0, nil
            if not enabled then
                clearWallFilter()
                if speed.ClearSprint then speed.ClearSprint() end
                speed:SetStatus(nil)
                if speed.SprintHeld then stepSpeed(0) end
                return
            end
            speed:Clean(function() restoreWalk(); if speed.ClearSprint then speed.ClearSprint() end end)
            speed:Clean(host.RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(stepSpeed))
            speed:SetStatus(speed.Options.Mode.Value)
        end,
    })
    speed.SprintHeld = false
    speed.SetSprintHeld = function(held)
        speed.SprintHeld = held
        stepSpeed(0)
        if not held and speed.ClearSprint then speed.ClearSprint() end
    end
    speed.StepSprint = function(dt) if speed.SprintHeld and not speed.Enabled then stepSpeed(dt) end end
    local function changed()
        restoreWalk(); teleportElapsed, lastMode = 0, nil
        if speed.Enabled then speed:SetStatus(speed.Options.Mode.Value) end
    end
    speed:CreateDropdown({Name="Mode",List={"WalkSpeed","Velocity","Impulse","CFrame","Teleport"},Index=2,Function=changed})
    speed:CreateSlider({Name="Speed",Min=1,Max=250,Default=32, Tooltip="Speed in studs/s. WalkSpeed sets Humanoid.WalkSpeed, Velocity/Impulse drive AssemblyLinearVelocity, CFrame/Teleport move CFrame."})
    speed:CreateSlider({Name="Response",Min=0.2,Max=2,Step=0.1,Default=1, Show={Option="Mode",Values={"Velocity","Impulse","CFrame"}}, Tooltip="Response: how fast velocity reaches target. 0.2 sluggish, 1 default balanced, 2 instant."})
    speed:CreateSlider({Name="Braking",Min=0,Max=1,Step=0.05,Default=0.8, Show={Option="Mode",Values={"Velocity"}}, Tooltip="Braking when no input: 0 = instant stop, 0.8 default smooth, 1 = keep momentum."})
    speed:CreateSlider({Name="Vehicle multiplier",Min=0.5,Max=3,Step=0.1,Default=1.2, Tooltip="Scales Speed when in a vehicle/seat (Velocity/Impulse/CFrame/Teleport only). 1 = same as on foot, 1.2 default slightly faster in vehicle."})
    speed:CreateToggle({Name="Keep vertical",Default=true, Show={Option="Mode",Values={"Velocity","Impulse"}}, Tooltip="Preserve Y velocity (gravity/jump). OFF = full 3D velocity control (also affects vehicles)."})
    speed:CreateToggle({Name="Wall check",Default=true,Show={Option="Mode",Values={"CFrame","Teleport"}}})
    speed:CreateSlider({Name="Burst delay",Min=0.05,Max=1,Default=0.2,Show={Option="Mode",Values={"Teleport"}}})
    speed:CreateToggle({Name="Auto jump",Default=false})
    speed:RefreshVisibility()
    activeCleanup = function()
        speed.SprintHeld = false
        if speed.Enabled then speed:Toggle(false) end
        restoreWalk(); clearWallFilter()
        if speed.ClearSprint then speed.ClearSprint() end
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return speed
end
function Module.destroy()
    if activeCleanup then activeCleanup(); activeCleanup = nil end
    Module.Initialized = false
end
return Module

export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    host: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "Animations",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCard: any = nil
local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local framework: any = context.framework
    local Players: Players = host.Players or (game :: any):GetService("Players")
    local LocalPlayer: Player = host.LocalPlayer or Players.LocalPlayer
    local TaskManager: any = host.TaskManager
    local featureConnections: any = host.featureConnections
    local disconnectFeatureConnection: any = host.disconnectFeatureConnection
    local configData: any = host.configData

    local savedKey: string = "Universal.Animations.Saved"
    local savedAnims: {string} = {}
    if configData and configData.values and type(configData.values[savedKey]) == "table" then
        local stored: any = configData.values[savedKey]
        for _, v: any in ipairs(stored) do
            if type(v) == "string" and string.match(v, "^%d+$") then
                table.insert(savedAnims, v)
            elseif type(v) == "number" then
                table.insert(savedAnims, tostring(v))
            end
        end
    end

    local currentTrack: AnimationTrack? = nil
    local currentAnim: Animation? = nil
    local currentId: string = ""
    local currentSpeed: number = 1
    local isPlaying: boolean = false

    local function getAnimator(): Animator?
        local character: Model? = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then return nil end
        local humanoid: Humanoid? = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid?
        if not humanoid then return nil end
        local animator: Animator? = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") :: Animator?
        if animator then return animator end
        -- Fallback: create animator if missing (some rigs)
        local ok: boolean, created: any = pcall(function()
            local a = Instance.new("Animator")
            a.Parent = humanoid
            return a
        end)
        if ok and created then return created :: Animator end
        return nil
    end

    local function stopCurrent(): ()
        if currentTrack then
            pcall(function() currentTrack:Stop(0.1) end)
            pcall(function() currentTrack:Destroy() end)
            currentTrack = nil
        end
        if currentAnim then
            pcall(function() currentAnim:Destroy() end)
            currentAnim = nil
        end
        isPlaying = false
    end

    local function playAnimation(id: string, speed: number): ()
        local animator: Animator? = getAnimator()
        if not animator then
            if activeCard then activeCard:Notify("No animator found (respawn?)") end
            return
        end
        local numericId: string? = string.match(tostring(id or ""), "%d+")
        if not numericId then
            if activeCard then activeCard:Notify("Enter a valid animation ID") end
            return
        end
        stopCurrent()
        local anim: Animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.Name = "Wurst_Animation_" .. numericId
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. numericId
        local success: boolean, result: any = pcall(function()
            return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
        end)
        if not success or not result then
            pcall(function() anim:Destroy() end)
            if activeCard then activeCard:Notify("Failed to load anim: " .. tostring(result or "invalid id")) end
            return
        end
        local track: AnimationTrack = result :: AnimationTrack
        -- Make it visible to others: high priority, looped
        pcall(function()
            track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            track.Looped = true
        end)
        local cleanSpeed: number = tonumber(speed) or 1
        if cleanSpeed ~= cleanSpeed or cleanSpeed <= 0 then cleanSpeed = 1 end
        -- Clamp to Roblox sensible, but allow up to 999 as requested
        if cleanSpeed > 999 then cleanSpeed = 999 end
        if cleanSpeed < 0.1 then cleanSpeed = 0.1 end
        track:Play()
        track:AdjustSpeed(cleanSpeed)
        -- Loop forever: when stopped, replay if still enabled
        local myTrack: AnimationTrack = track
        local conn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
        conn = track.Stopped:Connect(function()
            if conn then
                pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
                conn = nil
            end
            if isPlaying and myTrack == currentTrack and activeCard and activeCard.Enabled then
                -- replay
                pcall(function()
                    myTrack:Play()
                    myTrack:AdjustSpeed(cleanSpeed)
                end)
            end
        end)
        if activeCard then
            activeCard:Clean(function()
                if conn then pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
            end)
        end
        currentTrack = track
        currentAnim = anim
        currentId = numericId
        currentSpeed = cleanSpeed
        isPlaying = true
        if activeCard then
            activeCard:SetStatus("Playing " .. numericId .. " · " .. tostring(cleanSpeed) .. "x")
        end
    end

    local function saveCurrent(): ()
        local id: string? = string.match(tostring(currentId or activeCard and activeCard.Options["Animation ID"].Value or ""), "%d+")
        if not id then
            -- Try from textbox
            local raw: any = activeCard and activeCard.Options["Animation ID"] and activeCard.Options["Animation ID"].Value or ""
            id = string.match(tostring(raw or ""), "%d+")
        end
        if not id then
            if activeCard then activeCard:Notify("Enter an animation ID first") end
            return
        end
        for _, existing: string in ipairs(savedAnims) do
            if existing == id then
                if activeCard then activeCard:Notify("Already saved: " .. id) end
                return
            end
        end
        table.insert(savedAnims, 1, id)
        -- Keep max 20
        while #savedAnims > 20 do table.remove(savedAnims) end
        if configData and configData.values then
            configData.values[savedKey] = savedAnims
            if host.queueConfigSave then pcall(host.queueConfigSave) end
        end
        if activeCard and activeCard.Options["Saved Animations"] then
            pcall(function() activeCard.Options["Saved Animations"]:Refresh() end)
        end
        if activeCard then activeCard:Notify("Saved " .. id) end
    end

    local function refreshSavedList(card: any): ()
        -- The list is a CreateList; its Items function reads savedAnims
        if card and card.Options["Saved Animations"] then
            pcall(function() card.Options["Saved Animations"]:Refresh() end)
        end
    end

    local card: any = framework.Categories.World:CreateModule({
        Name = "Animations",
        Category = "World",
        ConfigKey = "Universal.Animations",
        Tooltip = "Plays any animation ID on your character with Animator, visible to others. Save IDs and click to replay.",
        Function = function(enabled: boolean): ()
            if not enabled then
                stopCurrent()
                if activeCard then activeCard:SetStatus(nil) end
                return
            end
            local id: string = tostring(card.Options["Animation ID"].Value or "")
            local speed: number = tonumber(card.Options["Speed"].Value) or 1
            if string.match(id, "%d+") then
                playAnimation(id, speed)
            else
                if activeCard then activeCard:SetStatus("Enter an ID and press Save or Play") end
            end
        end,
    })

    activeCard = card

    card:CreateTextBox({
        Name = "Animation ID",
        Placeholder = "rbxassetid or numbers only, e.g. 507777826",
        Default = "",
        Tooltip = "Animation asset ID (numbers only). Works with any Roblox animation. Example: 507777826 (walk).",
    })

    card:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 5,
        Step = 0.1,
        Default = 1,
        Tooltip = "Playback speed: 1 = normal, 0.5 = half, 5 = 5x, up to 999 if typed manually. Roblox allows high values.",
    })

    -- The Speed slider's manual input is checked via valueControls, but we also ensure the option can hold up to 999
    -- by post-processing the slider's apply. The framework already allows typing beyond Max, so we just need to
    -- ensure the play function clamps to 999, not to 5.

    card:CreateButton({
        Name = "Play Animation",
        Tooltip = "Play the ID above at the selected speed (visible to others via Animator).",
        Function = function()
            local id: string = tostring(card.Options["Animation ID"].Value or "")
            local speed: number = tonumber(card.Options["Speed"].Value) or 1
            if not string.match(id, "%d+") then
                card:Notify("Enter an animation ID first")
                return
            end
            -- Ensure card is ON, then play
            if not card.Enabled then
                card:Toggle(true)
                -- play will be called via the toggle, but also call now to ensure speed is current
                task.defer(function()
                    if card.Enabled then playAnimation(id, speed) end
                end)
            else
                playAnimation(id, speed)
            end
        end,
    })

    card:CreateButton({
        Name = "Save Animation",
        Tooltip = "Save the current ID to the list below. Max 20, persists via config.",
        Function = saveCurrent,
    })

    -- Saved list: clicking an entry replays it (via selection callback)
    local savedList: any = card:CreateList({
        Name = "Saved Animations",
        Items = function(): {string}
            local out: {string} = {}
            for _, id: string in ipairs(savedAnims) do
                table.insert(out, id)
            end
            return out
        end,
        Default = {},
        EmptyText = "No saved yet. Enter an ID and press Save Animation.",
        Function = function(selected: string, all: {string})
            if type(selected) ~= "string" or selected == "" then return end
            -- selected is the last clicked item (or first of all)
            local id: string = selected
            -- If multiple selected, take the last one the user clicked
            if #all > 0 then
                -- Find which one was just added/selected
                -- For simplicity, use selected, but if selected is a table (when Single=false, it may be the list),
                -- handle both cases
                if type(selected) == "table" then
                    -- When Single false, selected is the whole list, take last
                    id = all[#all]
                end
            end
            if not string.match(id or "", "%d+") then return end
            local speed: number = tonumber(card.Options["Speed"].Value) or 1
            -- Fill textbox for visibility
            if card.Options["Animation ID"] then
                -- Try to set the TextBox text and the Value
                pcall(function()
                    local opt: any = card.Options["Animation ID"]
                    if opt.Object then
                        local tb: any = opt.Object:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextBox")
                            or opt.Object:FindFirstChild("TextBox")
                            or opt.Object:FindFirstChild("Input", true)
                        if tb then tb.Text = id end
                    end
                    opt.Value = id
                end)
            end
            currentId = id
            if not card.Enabled then
                card:Toggle(true)
                -- defer play until toggle completes
                task.defer(function()
                    if card.Enabled then playAnimation(id, speed) end
                end)
            else
                playAnimation(id, speed)
            end
            -- Deselect so next click on same ID still fires
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function() savedList:Set(id, false) end)
            end)
        end,
        OnRemove = function(id: string)
            for i: number, v: string in ipairs(savedAnims) do
                if v == id then
                    table.remove(savedAnims, i)
                    break
                end
            end
            if configData and configData.values then
                configData.values[savedKey] = savedAnims
                if host.queueConfigSave then pcall(host.queueConfigSave) end
            end
            refreshSavedList(card)
        end,
        Tooltip = "Click an ID to play it. Saved IDs persist across sessions.",
    })

    -- Keep speed updates live: if already playing, adjust
    local origSpeedOption: any = card.Options["Speed"]
    if origSpeedOption and origSpeedOption.Object then
        -- Hook via the framework's valueControls if available, otherwise poll
        -- The CreateSlider's Function is called on change, so we use it:
        -- We need to override the slider's callback to also adjust track speed.
        -- Instead, we connect via the option's callback if possible.
        -- The card:CreateSlider already takes a Function, but we didn't pass one that updates track.
        -- So we add a listener via the host's valueControls or via a loop.
        -- Simplest: connect to the slider's change via polling in a Render loop.
        local lastSpeed: number = tonumber(origSpeedOption.Value) or 1
        card:Render(function()
            if not card.Enabled or not currentTrack then return end
            local now: number = tonumber(card.Options["Speed"].Value) or lastSpeed
            if now ~= lastSpeed then
                lastSpeed = now
                local clean: number = math.clamp(now, 0.1, 999)
                pcall(function() currentTrack:AdjustSpeed(clean) end)
                currentSpeed = clean
                if card then card:SetStatus("Playing " .. currentId .. " · " .. tostring(clean) .. "x") end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Handle respawn: replay if still enabled
    if LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded then
        local conn: RBXScriptConnection = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            if card.Enabled and currentId ~= "" then
                task.wait(1)
                if card.Enabled then
                    playAnimation(currentId, currentSpeed)
                end
            end
        end)
        card:Clean(function() pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end)
    end

    -- Also handle Humanoid died: stop
    card:Clean(function()
        stopCurrent()
    end)

    activeCleanup = function()
        stopCurrent()
        if card and card.Enabled then pcall(function() card:Toggle(false) end) end
    end

    Module.Initialized = true
    return card
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        pcall(activeCleanup)
        activeCleanup = nil
    end
    if activeCard and activeCard.Enabled then
        pcall(function() activeCard:Toggle(false) end)
    end
    activeCard = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

export type Runtime = {

local Module = {
    Name = "AntiAfk",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local LocalPlayer: any = host.LocalPlayer
    local featureConnections: any = host.featureConnections
    local disconnectFeatureConnection: any = host.disconnectFeatureConnection
    local createUniversalFeature: any = host.createUniversalFeature
    local addFeatureTooltip: any = host.addFeatureTooltip

    -- Try the available executor input methods in order. A successful API
    -- call alone does not prove that Roblox reset its server idle timer.
    local function pokeAfk(): boolean
        local camera: Camera? = host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local centre: Vector2 = Vector2.new(400, 300)
        if camera then
            centre = camera.ViewportSize / 2
        end

        -- Strategy 1: VirtualUser button press (the classic path, but
        -- as an explicit down/up instead of a corner click).
        local virtualUser: any = nil
        pcall(function(): ()
            virtualUser = (game :: any):GetService("VirtualUser")
        end)
        if virtualUser then
            local ok: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
                virtualUser:CaptureController()
                virtualUser:Button2Down(centre, camera and camera.CFrame)
                virtualUser:Button2Up(centre, camera and camera.CFrame)
            end)
            if ok then
                return true
            end
            local legacyOk: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
                virtualUser:ClickButton2(centre)
            end)
            if legacyOk then
                return true
            end
        end

        -- Strategy 2: VirtualInputManager mouse event at screen centre.
        local virtualInput: any = nil
        pcall(function(): ()
            virtualInput = (game :: any):GetService("VirtualInputManager")
        end)
        if virtualInput then
            local ok: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
                virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(centre.X, centre.Y, 0, true, game, false)
                virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(centre.X, centre.Y, 0, false, game, false)
            end)
            if ok then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function toggleAntiAfk(enabled: boolean): ()
        disconnectFeatureConnection("AntiAFK")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("AntiAFKTimer")

        if not enabled then
            return
        end

        -- Reactive: respond to the local Idled event.
        featureConnections.AntiAFK = LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function(): ()
            pokeAfk()
        end)
        -- Also attempt input every 150 seconds if Idled is not raised.
        local elapsed: number = 0
        featureConnections.AntiAFKTimer = host.TaskManager:Connect(
            function(deltaTime: number): ()
                elapsed += deltaTime
                if elapsed < 150 then
                    return
                end
                elapsed = 0
                pokeAfk()
            end
        , nil, "Anti AFK")
    end

    local AntiAfkFeature = createUniversalFeature(
        "Anti AFK",
        "Simulate input before Roblox's idle kick (about every 2.5 minutes, and on the idle warning)",
        13,
        toggleAntiAfk,
        {
            noOptions = true,
            configKey = "Universal.AntiAFK",
            categoryName = "World",
        }
    )
    addFeatureTooltip(AntiAfkFeature, "Attempts input every ~150 seconds and on Idled. "
        .. "Tries VirtualUser first, then VirtualInputManager; availability depends on the executor. "
        .. "Disconnects immediately when disabled.")

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        disconnectFeatureConnection("AntiAFK")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("AntiAFKTimer")
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return AntiAfkFeature
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        activeCleanup()
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

--!strict
export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    host: any,
    services: any,
}

type AppearanceTemplate = {
    object: Instance,
    parent: Instance?,
}

type MeshTemplate = {
    part: MeshPart,
    meshId: string,
    textureId: string,
}

type AnimationTemplate = {
    animation: Animation,
    animationId: string,
}

type AppearanceSnapshot = {
    character: Model,
    items: {AppearanceTemplate},
    meshParts: {MeshTemplate},
    animations: {AnimationTemplate},
    emotes: any,
    equippedEmotes: any,
    scales: {[string]: number},
    -- The humanoid description's own animation fields at snapshot
    -- time, so restoring movements can undo a description-route
    -- apply exactly instead of only rewriting Animate ids.
    descAnimations: {[string]: number},
}

local Module = {
    Name = "Disguise",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCard: any = nil

-- 78492 is the default disguise: a normal user avatar whose movement
-- animations come from Roblox's own set, which is also the fallback below.
local DEFAULT_USER_ID: number = 78492
-- Roblox's own R15 animation set, i.e. the IDs inside the default Animate
-- script. A HumanoidDescription stores 0 for "keep the default", so copying
-- only the non-zero fields would silently keep OUR animations on the
-- disguised avatar. Filling the gaps with these makes the disguise use the
-- same set the target actually sees.
local DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS: {[string]: {string}} = {
    idle = {"507766666", "507766951", "507766388"},
    walk = {"507777826"},
    run = {"507767714"},
    jump = {"507765000"},
    fall = {"507767968"},
    climb = {"507765644"},
    swim = {"507784897"},
    swimidle = {"507785072"},
}
-- Roblox's own R6 set, i.e. the IDs inside the classic R6 Animate script the
-- engine inserts on blocky rigs. The R15 IDs above are keyed to UpperTorso and
-- RightUpperArm, so an R6 body cannot play them at all: the Animate script
-- stops without an error and the character freezes in its rest pose. That is
-- the still avatar in the report, not a wrong idle.
local DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS_R6: {[string]: {string}} = {
    idle = {"180435571", "180435792"},
    walk = {"180426354"},
    run = {"180426354"},
    jump = {"125750702"},
    fall = {"180436148"},
    climb = {"180436334"},
}
-- Every id the R15 default set owns. A HumanoidDescription from an avatar that
-- never bought a pack is indistinguishable from one that asked for the R15
-- defaults, so this table is how an R6 body recognises "these are not mine".
local R15_DEFAULT_IDS: {[string]: boolean} = {}
for _, ids: {string} in pairs(DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS) do
    for _, id: string in ipairs(ids) do
        R15_DEFAULT_IDS[id] = true
    end
end
-- The mirror image: every id the R6 default set owns. R6 clips are the only
-- clips an R6 body may play, and R6 ids never belong in an R15 slot.
local R6_DEFAULT_IDS: {[string]: boolean} = {}
for _, ids: {string} in pairs(DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS_R6) do
    for _, id: string in ipairs(ids) do
        R6_DEFAULT_IDS[id] = true
    end
end
local SCALE_FIELDS: {string} = {
    "HeightScale",
    "WidthScale",
    "DepthScale",
    "HeadScale",
    "BodyTypeScale",
    "ProportionScale",
}
local BODY_PARTS: {[string]: boolean} = {
    Head = true,
    Torso = true,
    UpperTorso = true,
    LowerTorso = true,
    LeftArm = true,
    RightArm = true,
    LeftLeg = true,
    RightLeg = true,
    LeftUpperArm = true,
    LeftLowerArm = true,
    LeftHand = true,
    RightUpperArm = true,
    RightLowerArm = true,
    RightHand = true,
    LeftUpperLeg = true,
    LeftLowerLeg = true,
    LeftFoot = true,
    RightUpperLeg = true,
    RightLowerLeg = true,
    RightFoot = true,
}
local MOVEMENT_ANIMATIONS: {{descriptionField: string, scriptCategory: string}} = {
    {descriptionField = "IdleAnimation", scriptCategory = "idle"},
    {descriptionField = "WalkAnimation", scriptCategory = "walk"},
    {descriptionField = "RunAnimation", scriptCategory = "run"},
    {descriptionField = "JumpAnimation", scriptCategory = "jump"},
    {descriptionField = "ClimbAnimation", scriptCategory = "climb"},
    {descriptionField = "FallAnimation", scriptCategory = "fall"},
    {descriptionField = "SwimAnimation", scriptCategory = "swim"},
    {descriptionField = "SwimIdleAnimation", scriptCategory = "swimidle"},
    {descriptionField = "MoodAnimation", scriptCategory = "mood"},
}

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local framework: any = context.framework
    local host: any = context.host
    local Players: Players = host.Players or (game :: any):GetService("Players")
    local LocalPlayer: Player = host.LocalPlayer or Players.LocalPlayer

    local cloned = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) :: {[Instance]: boolean}
    local disguisedItems = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) :: {[Instance]: boolean}
    local snapshot: AppearanceSnapshot? = nil
    local filteredCharacter: Model? = nil
    local filterConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
    local generation: number = 0
    local restoring: boolean = false
    local emotesAppliedToHumanoid: boolean = false
    local animationOverrideApplied: boolean = false
    -- One notice per target: a pack authored for another rig says so once
    -- instead of on every re-apply.
    local foreignPackNotified: boolean = false
    -- Slots the last apply actually wrote; the status line repeats it.
    local lastAppliedSlotCount: number = 0
    local lastDroppedSlotCount: number = 0
    -- Forward declarations. The write path runs before the settle step is
    -- defined, and Lua resolves names at definition time: without these the
    -- calls would silently become globals.
    local stopPoseMirror: () -> () = function(): () end
    local playingAnimationTracks: (Humanoid?) -> {AnimationTrack} =
        function(): {AnimationTrack}
            return {}
        end
    -- Everything the target user exposes is cached the moment the avatar
    -- description is fetched: the movement animation slots and the emotes.
    -- Character mode applies the avatar but keeps this cache loaded, so the two
    -- toggles work instantly instead of fetching the avatar again.
    type TargetCache = {
        userId: number,
        slots: {[string]: any},
        emotes: any,
        equippedEmotes: any,
        -- "R6"/"R15" when the target is in the server, nil when they are only
        -- known by id. A description never says which rig its clips were
        -- authored for, so this is the only source for that fact.
        rig: string?,
    }
    local targetCache: TargetCache? = nil

    -- The checkbox restores its saved state from configData without calling
    -- back, so the module settings must be read from the same place. Without
    -- this, a saved OFF check would still apply the target's data.
    local function savedToggle(name: string, fallback: boolean): boolean
        local store: any = host.configData
        local states: any = store and store.states
        if type(states) ~= "table" then
            return fallback
        end
        local saved: any = states["Universal.Disguise." .. name:gsub("%W", "")]
        if type(saved) == "boolean" then
            return saved
        end
        return fallback
    end

    local disguiseCharDefault: boolean = savedToggle("Disguise Character", true)
    local settings = {
        disguiseCharacter = disguiseCharDefault,
        -- Legacy aliases for test compatibility (not shown in UI)
        mode = if disguiseCharDefault then "Character" else "Animation",
        useTargetMovementAnimations = true,
        animationSpeed = 1,
        id = tostring(DEFAULT_USER_ID),
        showTargetEmotes = savedToggle("Show target emotes", true),
        showAdvanced = false,
        -- Slots of a bundle resolved by id at runtime (any official or
        -- UGC pack), kept for the session so mode switches and the
        -- movement toggle reuse them without resolving again.
        customPackSlots = (nil :: any),
        customPackName = (nil :: any),
        -- Per-slot clips picked from bundles under Show Advanced:
        -- scriptCategory -> rbxassetid string.
        customSlotIds = ({} :: any),
    }

    local function status(message: string): ()
        if activeCard then activeCard:SetStatus(message) end
    end
    local function notify(message: string): ()
        pcall(print, "[Wurst:Disguise] " .. message)
        if activeCard then pcall(activeCard.Notify, activeCard, message) end
    end

    local function isAppearanceItem(obj: Instance): boolean
        return obj:IsA("Accessory")
            or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
            or obj:IsA("Shirt")
            or obj:IsA("Pants")
            or obj:IsA("BodyColors")
            or ((obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture"))
                and string.lower(obj.Name) == "face")
    end

    local function isInsideCharacter(obj: Instance, character: Model): boolean
        local ok: boolean, result: any = pcall(function()
            return obj:IsDescendantOf(character)
        end)
        return ok and result == true
    end

    local function rebindAccessory(character: Model, accessory: Accessory): ()
        for _, descendant: Instance in ipairs(accessory:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("Weld") and descendant.Part1 then
                local part: Instance? = character:FindFirstChild(
                    descendant.Part1.Name
                )
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    descendant.Part1 = part
                end
            elseif descendant:IsA("RigidConstraint")
                and descendant.Attachment1 then
                local attachment: Instance? = character:FindFirstChild(
                    descendant.Attachment1.Name,
                    true
                )
                if attachment and attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
                    descendant.Attachment1 = attachment
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function destroySnapshot(): ()
        local current: AppearanceSnapshot? = snapshot
        snapshot = nil
        emotesAppliedToHumanoid = false
        animationOverrideApplied = false
        if current then
            for _, entry: AppearanceTemplate in ipairs(current.items) do
                pcall(entry.object.Destroy, entry.object)
            end
        end
    end

    local function getAppliedDescription(humanoid: Humanoid): (any?, boolean)
        local child: HumanoidDescription? = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass(
            "HumanoidDescription"
        ) :: HumanoidDescription?
        if not child then
            local waitOk: boolean, waited: any = pcall(function()
                return humanoid:WaitForChild("HumanoidDescription", 2)
            end)
            if waitOk and waited and waited:IsA("HumanoidDescription") then
                child = waited :: HumanoidDescription
            end
        end
        if child then
            return child, false
        end
        local ok: boolean, result: any = pcall(function()
            return humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
        end)
        if ok and result then
            return result, true
        end
        return nil, false
    end

    local function cloneTable(value: any): any
        if type(value) ~= "table" then
            return value
        end
        local copy: any = {}
        for key: any, entry: any in pairs(value) do
            copy[key] = if type(entry) == "table" then table.clone(entry) else entry
        end
        return copy
    end

    local function readDescriptionEmotes(description: any): (any?, any?)
        local ok: boolean, emotes: any, equipped: any = pcall(function()
            return description:GetEmotes(), description:GetEquippedEmotes()
        end)
        if not ok or type(emotes) ~= "table" or type(equipped) ~= "table" then
            return nil, nil
        end
        return cloneTable(emotes), cloneTable(equipped)
    end

    local function applyDescriptionToHumanoid(
        humanoid: Humanoid,
        description: any
    ): (boolean, string?)
        local humanoidObject: any = humanoid
        local lastError: string = "ApplyDescription is unavailable."
        for _, methodName: string in ipairs({
            "ApplyDescriptionResetAsync",
            "ApplyDescriptionAsync",
            "ApplyDescriptionReset",
            "ApplyDescription",
        }) do
            local method: any = humanoidObject[methodName]
            if type(method) == "function" then
                local ok: boolean, result: any = pcall(
                    method,
                    humanoidObject,
                    description
                )
                if ok then
                    return true, nil
                end
                lastError = tostring(result)
            end
        end
        return false, lastError
    end

    local function setHumanoidEmotes(
        humanoid: Humanoid,
        emotes: any,
        equippedEmotes: any
    ): (boolean, string?)
        if type(emotes) ~= "table" or type(equippedEmotes) ~= "table" then
            return false, "The avatar description did not expose emote data."
        end
        local description: any, isTemporary: boolean = getAppliedDescription(humanoid)
        if not description then
            return false, "Could not read the current HumanoidDescription."
        end
        local setOk: boolean, setError: any = pcall(function()
            description:SetEmotes(cloneTable(emotes))
            description:SetEquippedEmotes(cloneTable(equippedEmotes))
        end)
        if not setOk then
            if isTemporary then
                pcall(description.Destroy, description)
            end
            return false, tostring(setError)
        end
        if not isTemporary then

            return true, nil
        end

        local applied: boolean, applyError: string? =
            applyDescriptionToHumanoid(humanoid, description)
        pcall(description.Destroy, description)
        return applied, applyError
    end

    local function captureSnapshot(
        character: Model,
        humanoid: Humanoid
    ): AppearanceSnapshot
        local items: {AppearanceTemplate} = {}
        local meshParts: {MeshTemplate} = {}
        local animations: {AnimationTemplate} = {}
        local scales: {[string]: number} = {}
        local descAnimations: {[string]: number} = {}
        local emotes: any = {}
        local equippedEmotes: any = {}

        for _, obj: Instance in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if isAppearanceItem(obj) then
                local ok: boolean, copy: any = pcall(function()
                    return obj:Clone()
                end)
                if ok and copy then
                    copy.Parent = nil
                    table.insert(items, {
                        object = copy,
                        parent = obj.Parent,
                    })
                end
            elseif obj:IsA("MeshPart") and BODY_PARTS[obj.Name] then
                table.insert(meshParts, {
                    part = obj,
                    meshId = obj.MeshId,
                    textureId = obj.TextureID,
                })
            elseif obj:IsA("Animation") then
                local animate: Instance? = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
                if animate and obj:IsDescendantOf(animate) then
                    table.insert(animations, {
                        animation = obj,
                        animationId = obj.AnimationId,
                    })
                end
            end
        end

        local description: any, isTemporary: boolean = getAppliedDescription(humanoid)
        if description then
            for _, field: string in ipairs(SCALE_FIELDS) do
                local ok: boolean, value: any = pcall(function()
                    return description[field]
                end)
                if ok and type(value) == "number" then
                    scales[field] = value
                end
            end
            for _, mapping in ipairs(MOVEMENT_ANIMATIONS) do
                local okField: boolean, fieldValue: any = pcall(function()
                    return description[mapping.descriptionField]
                end)
                if okField and type(fieldValue) == "number" then
                    descAnimations[mapping.descriptionField] = fieldValue
                end
            end
            local originalEmotes: any, originalEquipped: any =
                readDescriptionEmotes(description)
            if originalEmotes and originalEquipped then
                emotes = originalEmotes
                equippedEmotes = originalEquipped
            end
            if isTemporary then
                pcall(description.Destroy, description)
            end
        end

        return {
            character = character,
            items = items,
            meshParts = meshParts,
            animations = animations,
            emotes = emotes,
            equippedEmotes = equippedEmotes,
            scales = scales,
            descAnimations = descAnimations,
        }
    end

    local function ensureSnapshot(
        character: Model,
        humanoid: Humanoid
    ): AppearanceSnapshot
        if snapshot and snapshot.character == character then
            return snapshot
        end
        destroySnapshot()
        snapshot = captureSnapshot(character, humanoid)
        return snapshot
    end

    local function restartAnimateScript(animate: Instance): ()
        local scriptObject: any = animate
        local enabledOk: boolean, wasEnabled: any = pcall(function()
            return scriptObject.Enabled
        end)
        if enabledOk and type(wasEnabled) == "boolean" then
            if not wasEnabled then
                return
            end
            local disabledOk: boolean = pcall(function()
                scriptObject.Enabled = false
            end)
            if disabledOk then
                task.wait()
                pcall(function()
                    scriptObject.Enabled = wasEnabled
                end)
                task.wait()
                return
            end
        end

        local disabledOk: boolean, wasDisabled: any = pcall(function()
            return scriptObject.Disabled
        end)
        if disabledOk and type(wasDisabled) == "boolean" then
            local pauseOk: boolean = pcall(function()
                scriptObject.Disabled = true
            end)
            if pauseOk then
                task.wait()
                pcall(function()
                    scriptObject.Disabled = wasDisabled
                end)
                task.wait()
            end
        end
    end


    -- Used when "Use target movement animations if able" is turned off: restore only
    -- the Animate slots, leaving the current appearance/emotes untouched.
    local function restoreMovementAnimationsOnly(
        character: Model,
        humanoid: Humanoid?
    ): ()
        stopPoseMirror()
        local current: AppearanceSnapshot? = snapshot
        if not current or current.character ~= character
            or not animationOverrideApplied then
            return
        end
        -- Undo a description-route apply on the description itself,
        -- or the engine keeps serving the foreign clips no matter
        -- what the Animate slots say.
        if humanoid and current.descAnimations then
            local description: any, isTemporary: boolean =
                getAppliedDescription(humanoid)
            if description then
                local working: any = description
                if not isTemporary then
                    local cloneOk: boolean, clone: any = pcall(function(): any
                        return description:Clone()
                    end)
                    if cloneOk and clone then
                        working = clone
                        isTemporary = true
                    end
                end
                pcall(function(): ()
                    for field: string, asset: number in pairs(
                        current.descAnimations
                    ) do
                        working[field] = asset
                    end
                end)
                applyDescriptionToHumanoid(humanoid, working)
                if isTemporary then
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        working:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, entry: AnimationTemplate in ipairs(current.animations) do
            if isInsideCharacter(entry.animation, character) then
                pcall(function()
                    entry.animation.AnimationId = entry.animationId
                end)
            end
