        Tooltip = "ON (default): full character disguise (appearance + animations/emotes). OFF: only animations/emotes are shown, your character stays as is.",
    })

    -- Legacy hidden Mode dropdown for test compatibility (not shown in UI)
    card:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Character", "Animation"},
        Index = if settings.disguiseCharacter then 1 else 2,
        Show = {Option = "Disguise Character", Values = {"__hidden__"}},
        Function = function(value: string): ()
            settings.mode = value
            settings.disguiseCharacter = (value == "Character")
            card:SetStatus(value)
            if card.Enabled then
                if value == "Animation" then
                    local character: Model? = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local humanoid: Humanoid? = character
                        and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        :: Humanoid?
                    if character then
                        restoreOriginalAppearance(character, humanoid)
                    end
                    stopAppearanceFilter()
                end
                applyDisguise()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Legacy: use Disguise Character instead.",
    })

    card:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Animation Speed",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 2,
        Step = 0.05,
        Default = settings.animationSpeed,
        Function = function(value: number): ()
            settings.animationSpeed = math.clamp(value, 0, 2)
            if card.Enabled then
                applyAnimationSpeed()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Playback speed of your character's animations while Disguise is on: 0 freezes them, 1 is normal, 2 is double speed. Turning Disguise off restores speed 1.",
    })

    -- Show Advanced only reveals the bundle inputs. It never changes the
    -- current animations before the user actually submits a bundle ID.
    card:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show Advanced",
        Default = settings.showAdvanced,
        Function = function(value: boolean): ()
            settings.showAdvanced = value
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows bundle inputs for a complete pack or individual slots. Opening or closing these inputs does not change the animations already applied.",
    })

    card:CreateTextBox({
        Name = "Pack Bundle ID",
        Show = {Option = "Show Advanced", Values = {true}},
        Default = "",
        Function = function(value: string): ()
            local trimmed: string = tostring(value or "")
                :gsub("^%s+", "")
                :gsub("%s+$", "")
            local digits: string? = string.match(trimmed, "%d+")
            local bundleId: number? = digits and tonumber(digits) or nil
            if not bundleId then
                notify("Enter an animation bundle ID first (the number in its catalog link).")
                return
            end
            -- Any pack at all -- official or UGC -- resolved live from
            -- the bundle's own items, so the thousands of creator packs
            -- work without a single hardcoded id.
            local slots: {[string]: any}?, bundleError: string? =
                bundleAnimationSlots(bundleId)
            if not slots then
                notify("Could not load that pack: " .. tostring(bundleError))
                return
            end
            settings.customPackSlots = slots
            settings.customPackName = "Bundle " .. tostring(bundleId)
            table.clear(settings.customSlotIds)
            if not card.Enabled then
                notify("Pack " .. tostring(bundleId) .. " loaded; it applies while Disguise is on.")
                return
            end
            local character: Model? = LocalPlayer.Character
            local humanoid: Humanoid? = character
                and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                :: Humanoid?
            if character and humanoid then
                applyAnimationPack(character, humanoid)
                status((if settings.disguiseCharacter then "Character" else "Emotes only") .. " · pack Bundle " .. tostring(bundleId))
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Any animation pack bundle ID from its catalog link (roblox.com/bundles/<id>/...), official or UGC -- for example 4899847411546. The bundle's items are resolved when you enter it (nothing is downloaded; the engine streams the clips) and the pack is kept for the session. It wins over the target's movement animations. R15-only clips are not forced onto an incompatible R6 body.",
    })

    -- Per-slot bundle inserts: paste any pack's bundle ID into a slot
    -- and that slot takes the pack's clip for it (Idle from one pack,
    -- Run from another, ...). Slots left empty fall back to your rig's
    -- own set when the pack applies.
    local SLOT_INSERTS: {{string}} = {
        {"Idle", "idle"},
        {"Walk", "walk"},
        {"Run", "run"},
        {"Jump", "jump"},
        {"Fall", "fall"},
        {"Climb", "climb"},
        {"Swim", "swim"},
        {"Swim Idle", "swimidle"},
    }
    for _, slotInsert: {string} in ipairs(SLOT_INSERTS) do
        local label: string = slotInsert[1]
        local category: string = slotInsert[2]
        card:CreateTextBox({
            Name = label .. " Bundle ID",
            Show = {Option = "Show Advanced", Values = {true}},
            Default = "",
            Function = function(value: string): ()
                local digits: string? = string.match(
                    tostring(value or ""),
                    "%d+"
                )
                local bundleId: number? = digits and tonumber(digits)
                    or nil
                if not bundleId then
                    notify("Enter a bundle ID for the " .. label .. " slot first.")
                    return
                end
                local slots: {[string]: any}?, bundleError: string? =
                    bundleAnimationSlots(bundleId)
                if not slots then
                    notify("Could not load that pack: " .. tostring(bundleError))
                    return
                end
                local clip: any = slots[category]
                if type(clip) == "table" then
                    clip = clip[1]
                end
                if not clip then
                    notify("That bundle has no " .. label .. " clip to take.")
                    return
                end
                settings.customSlotIds[category] = clip
                local merged: {[string]: any} = {}
                for mergedCategory: string, mergedId: any in pairs(
                    settings.customSlotIds
                ) do
                    merged[mergedCategory] = mergedId
                end
                settings.customPackSlots = merged
                settings.customPackName = "Custom slots"
                if not card.Enabled then
                    notify(label .. " slot set; it applies while Disguise is on.")
                    return
                end
                local character: Model? = LocalPlayer.Character
                local humanoid: Humanoid? = character
                    and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    :: Humanoid?
                if character and humanoid then
                    applyAnimationPack(character, humanoid)
                    status((if settings.disguiseCharacter then "Character" else "Emotes only") .. " · pack Custom slots")
                end
            end,
            Tooltip = "Set the " .. label .. " slot from any animation pack: paste the pack's bundle ID (official or UGC) and this slot takes that pack's " .. label .. " clip. Mix slots from different packs freely; empty slots use your rig's own set.",
        })
    end

    card:CreateTextBox({
        Name = "Target ID",
        Default = settings.id,
        Function = function(value: string): ()
            local trimmed: string = tostring(value or "")
                :gsub("^%s+", "")
                :gsub("%s+$", "")
            if trimmed == "" then
                notify("Enter a user ID or animation bundle ID first.")
                return
            end
            settings.id = trimmed
            if card.Enabled then
                applyDisguise()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "User ID: when Disguise Character is ON copies appearance + animations/emotes onto your preserved body/rig; when OFF only animations/emotes are applied and your character stays as is. Default 78492. Missing slots fall back to your rig's own set.",
    })

    -- Legacy hidden: movement toggle (always on now), kept for tests but not shown
    card:CreateToggle({
        -- v192: the player asked for the exact wording. It is also honest: a
        -- clip the target's rig cannot play falls back to your own set, so the
        -- option is best-effort, never a promise.
        Name = "Use target movement animations if able",
        Show = {Option = "Disguise Character", Values = {"__hidden__"}},
        Default = settings.useTargetMovementAnimations,
        Function = function(value: boolean): ()
            setMovementAnimationsEnabled(value)
        end,
        Tooltip = "Character mode only. Shows the target user's movement animations (idle, walk, run, jump, climb, fall, swim, and Roblox's default set for any slot the avatar leaves empty) on the disguised avatar. They are already loaded, so this is instant; turning it off restores your own animations. Emotes are independent and stay untouched.",
    })

        card:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show target emotes",
        Default = settings.showTargetEmotes,
        Function = function(value: boolean): ()
            setTargetEmotesEnabled(value)
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows the target user's emotes and equipped emote slots on the disguised avatar. Works with or without Disguise Character.",
    })

    activeCard = card
    Module.Initialized = true
    return card
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCard then
        if activeCard.Enabled then
            pcall(activeCard.Toggle, activeCard, false)
        end
        activeCard = nil
    end
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "ImproveFps",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local featureConnections: any = host.featureConnections
    local disconnectFeatureConnection: any = host.disconnectFeatureConnection
    local createUniversalFeature: any = host.createUniversalFeature
    local addToggleOption: any = host.addToggleOption

    local fpsSettings: {[string]: boolean} = {
        textures = true,
        particles = true,
        shadows = true,
        materials = false,
        lighting = false,
        post = false,
        guiEffects = false,
        worldGui = false,
        gameGui = false,
        coreGui = false,
        geometry = false,
        scenery = false,
        quality = false,
        terrain = false,
        lights = false,
    }
    local fpsModeEnabled: boolean = false
    local generation: number = 0
    local ImproveFpsFeature: any = nil
    local function selectedEffectCount(): number
        local count: number = 0
        for _name: string, selected: boolean in pairs(fpsSettings) do
            if selected then count += 1 end
        end
        return count
    end

    local fpsVisualCache: any = {}
    local propertyWatches: {[any]: any} = {}

    local function cacheFpsProperty(object: any, property: string): ()
        local data: any = fpsVisualCache[object]
        if not data then
            data = {}
            fpsVisualCache[object] = data
            -- Keep snapshots strongly until OFF (even detached objects).
            -- Destroyed objects cannot be restored and must not accumulate.
            local ok, connection = pcall(function()
                return object.Destroying:Connect(function()
                    fpsVisualCache[object] = nil
                    local watch = propertyWatches[object]
                    propertyWatches[object] = nil
                    if watch then watch:Disconnect() end
                end)
            end)
            if ok then propertyWatches[object] = connection end
        end
        if data[property] == nil then
            data[property] = object[property]
        end
    end

    local lighting: any = host.Lighting
    local playerGui: any = host.PlayerGui
    local scenery: {[any]: boolean} = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local coreGuiCache: {[any]: boolean} = {}
    local function setProperty(object: any, property: string, value: any): ()
        -- Individual protected writes: an unsupported property must not
        -- prevent the remaining optimizations on that object.
        pcall(function()
            cacheFpsProperty(object, property)
            object[property] = value
        end)
    end
    local function protectedGui(object: any): boolean
        local current = object
        while current do
            if current == host.ScreenGui or current.Name == "TouchGui"
                or current.Name == "Chat" or current.Name == "BubbleChat" then return true end
            current = current.Parent
            if type(current) ~= "table" and typeof(current) ~= "Instance" then break end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function updateScenery(part: any): ()
        local character = host.LocalPlayer and host.LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local cached = fpsVisualCache[part]
        local function restorePart()
            if cached and cached.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= nil then
                pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = cached.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
            end
        end
        if not root or not part.Parent or not part.Anchored or not part.CanCollide then restorePart(); return end
        -- Static map only. Never cull characters, tools, or physics objects.
        local current = part.Parent
        while current and current ~= workspace do
            if current:IsA("Tool") or current:IsA("Accessory")
                or current:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then restorePart(); return end
            current = current.Parent
        end
        local far = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 350
        if far then setProperty(part, "LocalTransparencyModifier", 1)
        elseif cached and cached.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= nil then
            pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = cached.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
        end
    end

    local function applyFpsObject(object: Instance): ()
        -- A deferred DescendantAdded callback can arrive after destruction.
        -- Keep existing detached snapshots for restoration, but never acquire
        -- new ownership of an object already outside the scene.
        if object ~= workspace and object ~= lighting and object ~= playerGui and object.Parent == nil then return end
        local target: any = object
        if lighting and object == lighting and fpsSettings.lighting then
            setProperty(object, "EnvironmentDiffuseScale", 0)
            setProperty(object, "EnvironmentSpecularScale", 0)
        end
        if fpsSettings.shadows and object == lighting then setProperty(object, "GlobalShadows", false) end
        if fpsSettings.lights and object:IsA("Light") then setProperty(object, "Enabled", false) end
        if fpsSettings.terrain and object:IsA("Terrain") then
            setProperty(object, "Decoration", false)
            setProperty(object, "WaterWaveSize", 0)
            setProperty(object, "WaterWaveSpeed", 0)
            setProperty(object, "WaterReflectance", 0)
        end
        if fpsSettings.post and object:IsA("PostEffect") then
            setProperty(object, "Enabled", false)
        end
        if not protectedGui(object) then
            if fpsSettings.guiEffects and (object:IsA("UIStroke") or object:IsA("UIGradient")) then
                setProperty(object, "Enabled", false)
            elseif fpsSettings.guiEffects and object:IsA("ViewportFrame") then
                setProperty(object, "Visible", false)
            end
            if fpsSettings.worldGui and (object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("SurfaceGui")) then
                setProperty(object, "Enabled", false)
            end
            if fpsSettings.gameGui and object:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                setProperty(object, "Enabled", false)
            end
        end
        if fpsSettings.geometry and (object:IsA("MeshPart") or object:IsA("PartOperation")) then
            setProperty(object, "RenderFidelity", Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance)
        end
        if fpsSettings.scenery and object:IsA("BasePart") and object.Anchored and object.CanCollide then
            scenery[object] = true
            updateScenery(object)
        end
        if fpsSettings.textures and (object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture")) then
            cacheFpsProperty(object, "Transparency")
            target.Transparency = 1
        elseif fpsSettings.textures and object:IsA("MeshPart") then
            setProperty(object, "TextureID", "")
        elseif fpsSettings.textures and object:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
            setProperty(object, "TextureId", "")
        end

        if fpsSettings.particles
            and (object:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                or object:IsA("Trail")
                or object:IsA("Beam")
                or object:IsA("Smoke")
                or object:IsA("Fire")
                or object:IsA("Sparkles")) then
            cacheFpsProperty(object, "Enabled")
            target.Enabled = false
        end

        if object:IsA("BasePart") then
            if fpsSettings.shadows then
                cacheFpsProperty(object, "CastShadow")
                object.CastShadow = false
            end
            if fpsSettings.materials then
                cacheFpsProperty(object, "Material")
                cacheFpsProperty(object, "Reflectance")
                object.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                object.Reflectance = 0
            end
        end
    end

    local function restoreFpsObjects(): ()
        for _, connection in pairs(propertyWatches) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        propertyWatches = {}
        for object: any, properties: any in pairs(fpsVisualCache) do
            if object then
                for property: string, value: any in pairs(properties) do
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        object[property] = value
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        fpsVisualCache = {}
        scenery = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        local starterGui = host.StarterGui
        if starterGui then
            for kind, value in pairs(coreGuiCache) do
                pcall(function() starterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(kind, value) end)
            end
        end
        coreGuiCache = {}
    end

    local function toggleImproveFps(enabled: boolean): ()
        generation += 1
        local token: number = generation
        fpsModeEnabled = enabled
        for _, name in ipairs({"ImproveFPS", "ImproveFPSLighting", "ImproveFPSGui", "ImproveFPSDistance"}) do
            disconnectFeatureConnection(name)
        end
        restoreFpsObjects()

        if not enabled then
            if ImproveFpsFeature then ImproveFpsFeature:SetStatus(nil) end
            return
        end
        ImproveFpsFeature:SetStatus(tostring(selectedEffectCount()) .. " options")
        if fpsSettings.quality then
            pcall(function() setProperty(settings().Rendering, "QualityLevel", Enum.QualityLevel.Level01) end)
        end

        local containers = {workspace}
        if lighting then table.insert(containers, lighting) end
        if playerGui then table.insert(containers, playerGui) end
        for index, container in ipairs(containers) do
            local name = ({"ImproveFPS", "ImproveFPSLighting", "ImproveFPSGui"})[index]
            featureConnections[name] = container.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
                if fpsModeEnabled and token == generation then pcall(applyFpsObject, object) end
            end)
        end
        if fpsSettings.coreGui and host.StarterGui then
            -- Do not disable All, Health or the mobile touch controls.
            for _, kind in ipairs({Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack,
                Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, Enum.CoreGuiType.EmotesMenu}) do
                pcall(function()
                    local value = host.StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(kind)
                    if type(value) == "boolean" then
                        coreGuiCache[kind] = value
                        host.StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(kind, false)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        if fpsSettings.scenery and host.TaskManager then
            local elapsed, cursor = 0, 1
            -- v139.1: one long lived array, cleared in place. Rebuilding it
            -- every second threw away the whole list (thousands of parts on a
            -- big map) and left it for the collector: a guaranteed hitch.
            local pending: {BasePart} = {}
            featureConnections.ImproveFPSDistance = host.TaskManager:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed += dt
                if cursor > #pending then
                    if elapsed < 1 then return end
                    elapsed = 0
                    table.clear(pending)
                    for part in pairs(scenery) do
                        if part.Parent then table.insert(pending, part) else scenery[part] = nil end
                    end
                    cursor = 1
                end
                -- Bound work per frame instead of rescanning a huge map in
                -- one callback, which would defeat an FPS optimization.
                local last = math.min(#pending, cursor + 199)
                while cursor <= last do
                    if not fpsModeEnabled or token ~= generation then return end
                    pcall(updateScenery, pending[cursor])
                    cursor += 1
                end
            end, nil, "Improve FPS")
        end
        task.spawn(function(): ()
            local scanned = 0
            for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
                if not fpsModeEnabled or token ~= generation then return end
                pcall(applyFpsObject, container)
                for _, object in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
                    if not fpsModeEnabled or token ~= generation then return end
                    pcall(applyFpsObject, object)
                    scanned += 1
                    if scanned % 250 == 0 then task.wait() end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function refreshFps(): ()
        if fpsModeEnabled then
            toggleImproveFps(true)
        end
    end

    ImproveFpsFeature = createUniversalFeature(
        "Improve FPS",
        "Apply only the selected reversible optimizations",
        26,
        toggleImproveFps,
        {categoryName = "World"}
    )
    addToggleOption(ImproveFpsFeature, "Remove textures", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        fpsSettings.textures = value
        refreshFps()
    end)
    addToggleOption(ImproveFpsFeature, "Disable particles", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        fpsSettings.particles = value
        refreshFps()
    end)
    addToggleOption(ImproveFpsFeature, "Disable shadows", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        fpsSettings.shadows = value
        refreshFps()
    end)
    addToggleOption(ImproveFpsFeature, "Simple materials", false, function(value: boolean): ()
        fpsSettings.materials = value
        refreshFps()
    end)

    for _, definition in ipairs({
        {"Lowest render quality", "quality", "Requests render quality Level01 where the client permits it; restores the original level when OFF."},
        {"Simple lighting", "lighting", "Disables environment diffuse/specular reflections."},
        {"Disable local lights", "lights", "Turns off PointLight, SpotLight and SurfaceLight instances. May darken the map."},
        {"Simplify terrain", "terrain", "Disables terrain decoration, water waves and water reflections where writable. Physics is unchanged."},
        {"Disable post effects", "post", "Disables bloom, blur (including menu blur), depth of field, color correction and sun rays."},
        {"Simplify game UI", "guiEffects", "Disables game UI strokes, gradients and 3D viewport previews. Menu and touch controls are protected."},
        {"Hide world UI", "worldGui", "Hides floating labels and SurfaceGui displays; may hide game information."},
        {"Hide game UI", "gameGui", "Aggressive: hides game ScreenGuis, including HUD/objectives. Keeps this menu, chat and TouchGui."},
        {"Hide Roblox panels", "coreGui", "Hides player list, backpack, chat and emotes panel. Health and mobile movement remain available."},
        {"Low detail meshes", "geometry", "Requests Performance render fidelity for meshes/unions; does not change collisions."},
        {"Hide distant scenery", "scenery", "Aggressive: locally hides static map parts beyond 350 studs, updating periodically. May hide distant objectives; collisions remain."},
    }) do
        local key: string = definition[2]
        addToggleOption(ImproveFpsFeature, definition[1], false, function(value: boolean)
            fpsSettings[key] = value
            refreshFps()
        end, definition[3])
    end

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        toggleImproveFps(false)
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return ImproveFpsFeature
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        pcall(activeCleanup)
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "ProximityPrompts",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local TaskManager: any = host.TaskManager
    local featureConnections: any = host.featureConnections
    local disconnectFeatureConnection: any = host.disconnectFeatureConnection
    local createUniversalFeature: any = host.createUniversalFeature
    local addToggleOption: any = host.addToggleOption
    local addNumberOption: any = host.addNumberOption
    type InteractionSettings = {
        distance: number,
        instantPrompts: boolean,
        proximityPrompts: boolean,
        clickDetectors: boolean,
    }
    type PromptState = {distance: number, holdDuration: number}
    -- Rows default OFF: the card is the master switch and turns every channel
    -- on by itself. A row switched on with the card OFF is a deliberate opt-in
    -- and works on its own, so nobody has to enable the whole card just for the
    -- fast prompt.
    local interactionSettings: InteractionSettings = {
        distance = 32,
        instantPrompts = false,
        proximityPrompts = false,
        clickDetectors = false,
    }
    local originalPrompts: {[ProximityPrompt]: PromptState} =
        setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) :: any
    local originalClickDetectors: {[ClickDetector]: number} =
        setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) :: any
    local interactionExtenderEnabled: boolean = false
    local InteractFeature: any = nil
    local interactionRefreshClock: number = 0

    -- Every channel follows its own row, so a row switched on with the card OFF
    -- works alone and a row switched off with the card ON really stops. The card
    -- is still a master switch: turning it on switches the rows on (visibly, not
    -- behind the scenes) and turning it off switches them off.
    local function promptsChannel(): boolean
        return interactionSettings.proximityPrompts or interactionSettings.instantPrompts
    end

    local function detectorsChannel(): boolean
        return interactionSettings.clickDetectors
    end

    local function anyChannel(): boolean
        return promptsChannel() or detectorsChannel()
    end

    local function updatePrompt(prompt: ProximityPrompt, original: PromptState): ()
        local distance: number = promptsChannel()
                and interactionSettings.distance or original.distance
        local hold: number = promptsChannel() and interactionSettings.instantPrompts
                and 0 or original.holdDuration
        if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
        if prompt.HoldDuration ~= hold then prompt.HoldDuration = hold end
    end

    local function updateDetector(detector: ClickDetector, original: number): ()
        local distance: number = detectorsChannel()
                and interactionSettings.distance or original
        if detector.MaxActivationDistance ~= distance then detector.MaxActivationDistance = distance end
    end

    local function refreshInteractionExtender(): ()
        for prompt: ProximityPrompt, original: PromptState in pairs(originalPrompts) do
            if prompt.Parent then updatePrompt(prompt, original) end
        end
        for detector: ClickDetector, original: number in pairs(originalClickDetectors) do
            if detector.Parent then updateDetector(detector, original) end
        end
    end

    local function applyInteractionExtension(instance: Instance): ()
        if not anyChannel() then
            return
        end
        if instance:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
            if originalPrompts[instance] == nil then
                originalPrompts[instance] = {
                    distance = instance.MaxActivationDistance,
                    holdDuration = instance.HoldDuration,
                }
            end
            updatePrompt(instance :: ProximityPrompt, originalPrompts[instance])
        elseif instance:IsA("ClickDetector") then
            if originalClickDetectors[instance] == nil then
                originalClickDetectors[instance] = instance.MaxActivationDistance
            end
            updateDetector(instance :: ClickDetector, originalClickDetectors[instance])
        end
    end

    -- Put every touched prompt/detector back to the values it had before we
    -- saw it, then forget it. Called when no channel is live any more.
    local function restoreInteractionExtender(): ()
        for prompt: ProximityPrompt, original: PromptState in pairs(originalPrompts) do
            if prompt.Parent then
                if prompt.MaxActivationDistance ~= original.distance then
                    prompt.MaxActivationDistance = original.distance
                end
                if prompt.HoldDuration ~= original.holdDuration then
                    prompt.HoldDuration = original.holdDuration
                end
            end
        end
        for detector: ClickDetector, original: number in pairs(originalClickDetectors) do
            if detector.Parent and detector.MaxActivationDistance ~= original then
                detector.MaxActivationDistance = original
            end
        end
        originalPrompts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) :: any
        originalClickDetectors = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) :: any
    end

    local scanning: boolean = false
    local function startScan(): ()
        if scanning then return end
        scanning = true
        local scanConnection: any = featureConnections.InteractExtender
        task.spawn(function(): ()
            for index: number, instance: Instance in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if featureConnections.InteractExtender ~= scanConnection then
                    -- Superseded: a newer generation owns the flag now.
                    scanning = false
                    return
                end
                applyInteractionExtension(instance)
                if index % 240 == 0 then
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
            scanning = false
        end)
    end

    -- Keep exactly the hooks the live channels need. Cheap when nothing changed,
    -- so a single row can call it on every click without a rescan.
    local function syncInteractions(): ()
        if not anyChannel() then
            disconnectFeatureConnection("InteractExtender")
            disconnectFeatureConnection("InteractExtenderRefresh")
            -- A scan suspended by this teardown belongs to the old generation;
            -- releasing the flag lets the next activation start its own.
            scanning = false
            restoreInteractionExtender()
            interactionRefreshClock = 0
            if InteractFeature then
                InteractFeature:SetStatus(nil)
            end
            return
        end
        if not featureConnections.InteractExtender then
            featureConnections.InteractExtender =
                workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(applyInteractionExtension)
        end
        if not featureConnections.InteractExtenderRefresh then
            featureConnections.InteractExtenderRefresh = TaskManager:Connect(
                function(deltaTime: number): ()
                    interactionRefreshClock += deltaTime
                    if interactionRefreshClock >= 0.5 then
                        interactionRefreshClock = 0
                        refreshInteractionExtender()
                    end
                end
            , nil, "Proximity Prompts")
            -- First activation (card or row): pick up what already exists.
            startScan()
        else
            refreshInteractionExtender()
        end
        if InteractFeature and interactionExtenderEnabled then
            InteractFeature:SetStatus(
                tostring(math.round(interactionSettings.distance)) .. " studs"
            )
        end
    end

    -- Keep the checkbox, the saved value and the callback in step when the card
    -- itself switches a row.
    local function setRow(name: string, value: boolean): ()
        local controls: any = nil
        pcall(function(): ()
            if state and type(state.toggleControls) == "table" then
                controls = state.toggleControls
            end
        end)
        local control: any = controls and controls[InteractFeature.configKey .. "." .. name]
        if control and type(control.setChecked) == "function" then
            pcall(control.setChecked, value)
        end
    end

    local function toggleInteractionExtender(enabled: boolean): ()
        interactionExtenderEnabled = enabled
        if enabled then
            interactionSettings.proximityPrompts = true
            interactionSettings.clickDetectors = true
            setRow("Proximityprompts", true)
            setRow("Clickdetectors", true)
            -- The card was switched on: rescan once so nothing that exists right
            -- now is missed, even if the rows were already live.
            syncInteractions()
            startScan()
            return
        else
            interactionSettings.instantPrompts = false
            interactionSettings.proximityPrompts = false
            interactionSettings.clickDetectors = false
            setRow("Instantprompts", false)
            setRow("Proximityprompts", false)
            setRow("Clickdetectors", false)
        end
        syncInteractions()
    end

    InteractFeature = createUniversalFeature(
        "Proximity Prompts",
        "Extend prompt and click interaction range without auto-firing",
        24,
        toggleInteractionExtender,
        {categoryName = "Exploits", configKey = "Universal.InteractExtender"}
    )
    addNumberOption(
        InteractFeature,
        "Interaction distance",
        interactionSettings.distance,
        8,
        250,
        function(value: number): ()
            interactionSettings.distance = value
            if InteractFeature.enabled then
                InteractFeature:SetStatus(tostring(math.round(value)) .. " studs")
            end
            syncInteractions()
        end
    )
    addToggleOption(
        InteractFeature,
        "Instant prompts",
        interactionSettings.instantPrompts,
        function(value: boolean): ()
            interactionSettings.instantPrompts = value
            syncInteractions()
        end
    )
    addToggleOption(
        InteractFeature,
        "Proximity prompts",
        interactionSettings.proximityPrompts,
        function(value: boolean): ()
            interactionSettings.proximityPrompts = value
            syncInteractions()
        end
    )
    addToggleOption(
        InteractFeature,
        "Click detectors",
        interactionSettings.clickDetectors,
        function(value: boolean): ()
            interactionSettings.clickDetectors = value
            syncInteractions()
        end
    )

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        interactionExtenderEnabled = false
        disconnectFeatureConnection("InteractExtender")
        disconnectFeatureConnection("InteractExtenderRefresh")
        restoreInteractionExtender()
        interactionRefreshClock = 0
        if InteractFeature then
            InteractFeature:SetStatus(nil)
        end
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return InteractFeature
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        activeCleanup()
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
    services: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "RejoinServer",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCleanup: (() -> ())? = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local LocalPlayer: any = host.LocalPlayer
    local createUniversalFeature: any = host.createUniversalFeature
    local cloneReference: any = host.cloneReference
    local notify: (string) -> () = host.notify
    local function rejoinCurrentServer(): ()
        local teleportService: TeleportService = cloneReference(
            game:GetService("TeleportService")
        )
        local placeId: number = game.PlaceId
        local jobId: string = tostring(game.JobId or "")

        local rejoined: boolean = false
        if jobId ~= "" then
            rejoined = pcall(function(): ()
                teleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, jobId, LocalPlayer)
            end)
        end
        if not rejoined then
            local ok: boolean, teleportError: any = pcall(function(): ()
                teleportService:Teleport(placeId, LocalPlayer)
            end)
            if not ok then
                notify("Rejoin failed: " .. tostring(teleportError))
            end
        end
    end
    local actionId: string = "RejoinServer"
    local registries: any = context.services.registries
    local wurstOptions: any = registries.wurstOptions()
    if wurstOptions and type(wurstOptions.RegisterAction) == "function" then
        local registered: boolean, registration: any = pcall(
            wurstOptions.RegisterAction,
            actionId,
            "Rejoin Server",
            rejoinCurrentServer,
            {
                description = "Reconnect to the current server instance",
                configKey = "Universal.RejoinServer",
            }
        )
        if not registered then
            error("Wurst Options refused Rejoin Server: " .. tostring(registration))
        end
        local search: any = registries.moduleSearch()
        local searchFeature: any = {
            name = "Rejoin Server",
            configKey = "Universal.RejoinServer",
            kind = "action",
            searchable = false,
            enabled = false,
            activate = rejoinCurrentServer,
        }
        if search and type(search.Register) == "function" then
            search.Register(searchFeature)
        end
        activeCleanup = function(): ()
            if search and type(search.Unregister) == "function" then
                search.Unregister(searchFeature)
            end
            if type(registration) == "table"
                and type(registration.Unregister) == "function" then
                registration.Unregister()
            elseif type(wurstOptions.UnregisterAction) == "function" then
                pcall(wurstOptions.UnregisterAction, actionId)
            end
        end
        Module.Initialized = true
        return registration
    end

    local feature: any = createUniversalFeature(
        "Rejoin Server",
        "Reconnect to the current server instance",
        22,
        rejoinCurrentServer,
        {
            action = true,
            noOptions = true,
            categoryName = "Other",
            searchable = false,
        }
    )

    activeCleanup = function(): () end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return feature
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        pcall(activeCleanup)
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

-- v193: "Server Settings" (Utilities).
--
-- What it does, and what it deliberately does NOT do:
--   * It reads the server the player is actually in (Job ID, player count,
--     player limit, uptime, server clock, place name) and keeps that readout on
--     the card, live, the way AutoFarm's "Overlay Info" rows work: a section of
--     stat rows that a 1 Hz task keeps writing for as long as the module lives.
--     There is no window, no timer that expires and no "refresh every" ceiling.
--   * It copies the Job ID and hops to another public server of the same place.
--   * It sets no server-side property. A Roblox client cannot change another
--     server's settings; a card that claimed to would be lying.
--
-- History, so the next edit does not undo it:
--   v191 shipped the card with "Rejoin Server", a readout that only refreshed
--   while the card was ON, and hops that could land on a full instance.
--   v192 removed the rejoin, required a free slot for a hop and drew a floating
--   overlay Frame -- which landed on top of the menu's own options and stopped
--   whenever the card was switched off.
--   v193 (the player's report) removes that window: the info is a live section
--   inside the card, it never stops, it carries server data only (no Build, no
--   Round, no You), the place row shows the place NAME and marks a subplace.
--   The hops no longer depend on any endpoint flag: every listed server is read,
--   only the ones with a free slot are candidates, and when none is joinable the
--   card falls back to joining a random server instead of failing silently.
export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    host: any,
    services: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "ServerSettings",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCard: any = nil
-- Kept so destroy() can drop the 1 Hz readout without holding the whole host.
local disconnectTicker: ((string) -> ())? = nil

-- One hop per couple of seconds at most: the public endpoint rate-limits hard
-- and a hop already interrupts the session, so stacked calls are worthless.
local HOP_COOLDOWN: number = 3

-- The live readout ticks at 1 Hz. It is not tied to the card's toggle: the
-- player asked for information that never stops, and a stat row costs one label
-- write when (and only when) the string changes.
local STAT_INTERVAL: number = 1

-- How many pages of the public server list a hop reads. Each page is 100
-- servers; two pages per sort order is ~200 candidates, which is plenty and
-- keeps the request count (and the rate limit) sane.
local MAX_PAGES: number = 2

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local host: any = context.host
    local LocalPlayer: any = host.LocalPlayer
    local createUniversalFeature: any = host.createUniversalFeature
    local addActionOption: any = host.addActionOption
    local addInformationOption: any = host.addInformationOption
    local notify: any = host.notify
    local cloneReference: any = host.cloneReference
    local services: any = context.services or {}

    local players: any = host.Players or game:GetService("Players")
    local httpService: any = cloneReference
        and cloneReference(game:GetService("HttpService"))
        or game:GetService("HttpService")
    local teleportService: any = cloneReference
        and cloneReference(game:GetService("TeleportService"))
        or game:GetService("TeleportService")

    local tick: any = if host.TaskManager and host.TaskManager.Connect
        then host.TaskManager
        else nil
    local featureConnections: any = host.featureConnections
    local disconnectFeatureConnection: any = host.disconnectFeatureConnection
    if type(disconnectFeatureConnection) == "function" then
        disconnectTicker = disconnectFeatureConnection
    end

    local settings = {
        showInfo = true,
    }
    local lastHopAt: number = -math.huge
    local elapsed: number = 0
    local hopping: boolean = false
    -- Declared before every closure that touches it.
    local card: any = nil
    local statRows: {[string]: any} = {}

    local function say(message: string, kind: string?): ()
        if type(notify) == "function" then
            pcall(notify, message, kind)
        end
    end

    local function jobId(): string
        local ok: boolean, value: any = pcall(function(): any
            return game.JobId
        end)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then
            return ""
        end
        return value
    end

    local function playerList(): {any}
        local ok: boolean, list: any = pcall(function(): any
            return players:GetPlayers()
        end)
        if not ok or type(list) ~= "table" then
            return {}
        end
        return list
    end

    local function maxPlayers(): number
        local ok: boolean, value: any = pcall(function(): any
            return players.MaxPlayers
        end)
        if ok and type(value) == "number" then
            return value
        end
        return 0
    end

    -- Seconds since this server was started. `DistributedGameTime` is the
    -- server's own clock: it does not reset when you respawn or rejoin, which is
    -- exactly what "how long has this server been up" means.
    local function uptimeSeconds(): number
        local ok: boolean, value: any = pcall(function(): any
            return workspace.DistributedGameTime
        end)
        if ok and type(value) == "number" and value >= 0 then
            return value
        end
        return 0
    end

    local function clockText(): string
        local ok: boolean, value: any = pcall(function(): any
            return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        end)
        local stamp: number = if ok and type(value) == "number"
            then math.floor(value)
            else os.time()
        local date: any = os.date("!*t", stamp)
        if type(date) ~= "table" then
            return "--:--:--"
        end
        return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", date.hour, date.min, date.sec)
    end

    local function durationText(seconds: number): string
        local total: number = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
        local hours: number = math.floor(total / 3600)
        local minutes: number = math.floor((total % 3600) / 60)
        local secs: number = total % 60
        return string.format("%d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, secs)
    end

    -- Place should show the real place name (via MarketplaceService) and
    -- whether it's a subplace (PlaceId != GameId). Falls back to game.Name.
    local function placeText(): string
        local placeOk: boolean, placeId: any = pcall(function(): any
            return game.PlaceId
        end)
        local gameOk: boolean, gameId: any = pcall(function(): any
            return game.GameId
        end)
        local label: string = "Unknown place"
        -- Try MarketplaceService for the actual place name (most accurate)
        local marketOk: boolean, marketName: any = pcall(function(): any
            local ms: any = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
            local info: any = ms:GetProductInfo(placeId)
            return info and info.Name
        end)
        if marketOk and type(marketName) == "string" and marketName ~= "" then
            label = marketName
        else
            local nameOk: boolean, name: any = pcall(function(): any
                return game.Name
            end)
            if nameOk and type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then
                label = name
            elseif placeOk and type(placeId) == "number" then
                label = "Place " .. tostring(placeId)
            end
        end
        if placeOk and gameOk
            and type(placeId) == "number" and type(gameId) == "number"
            and placeId ~= gameId then
            return label .. " · subplace"
        end
        return label
    end

    local function namesText(limit: number): string
        local list: {any} = playerList()
        local names: {string} = {}
        for _, player: any in ipairs(list) do
            local ok: boolean, name: any = pcall(function(): any
                return player.Name
            end)
            if ok and type(name) == "string" then
                table.insert(names, name)
            end
        end
        if #names == 0 then
            return "—"
        end
        local joined: string = table.concat(names, ", ")
        if #joined > limit then
            joined = string.sub(joined, 1, math.max(1, limit - 1)) .. "…"
        end
        return joined
    end

    local function shortJobId(): string
        local id: string = jobId()
        if id == "" then
            return "private server"
        end
        if #id > 8 then
            return string.sub(id, 1, 8)
        end
        return id
    end

    local function infoText(): string
        local limit: number = maxPlayers()
        return string.format(
            "%s · %d/%d · up %s",
            shortJobId(),
            #playerList(),
            if limit > 0 then limit else #playerList(),
            durationText(uptimeSeconds())
        )
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Live readout (AutoFarm-style stat rows)
    ---------------------------------------------------------------

    -- The rows the card keeps writing. Server data only: the player asked for
    -- Build, Round and You to be removed, and for the place row to name the
    -- place (and say when it is a subplace).
    local statRowsDefinition: {{key: string, label: string, read: () -> string}} = {
        {key = "server", label = "Server", read = shortJobId},
        {key = "players", label = "Players", read = function(): string
            local limit: number = maxPlayers()
            return string.format(
                "%d / %d",
                #playerList(),
                if limit > 0 then limit else #playerList()
            )
        end},
        {key = "inServer", label = "In server", read = function(): string
            return namesText(34)
        end},
        {key = "uptime", label = "Uptime", read = function(): string
            return durationText(uptimeSeconds())
        end},
        {key = "serverTime", label = "Server time", read = function(): string
            return clockText()
        end},
        {key = "place", label = "Place", read = placeText},
    }

    local function ensureStatRows(): ()
        if not card or next(statRows) ~= nil then
            return
        end
        if type(state.addSectionOption) == "function" then
            pcall(state.addSectionOption, card, "Overlay Info")
        end
        if type(state.addStatOption) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        for _, definition: any in ipairs(statRowsDefinition) do
            local ok: boolean, row: any = pcall(
                state.addStatOption,
                card,
                definition.label,
                "—"
            )
            if ok and row then
                statRows[definition.key] = row
            end
        end
    end

    local function refreshStats(): ()
        ensureStatRows()
        for _, definition: any in ipairs(statRowsDefinition) do
            local row: any = statRows[definition.key]
            if row and type(row.set) == "function" then
                local ok: boolean, value: any = pcall(definition.read)
                local text: string = if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= ""
                    then value
                    else "—"
                pcall(row.set, text)
            end
        end
        if card and type(card.SetStatus) == "function" then
            if settings.showInfo then
                pcall(function(): ()
                    card:SetStatus(infoText())
                end)
            else
                pcall(function(): ()
                    card:SetStatus(nil)
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    -- One connection for the lifetime of the module: it is created at init and
    -- only dropped by destroy(), so the readout cannot stop when the card is
    -- toggled or when an option is changed. 1 Hz, and every write is guarded by
    -- a string comparison inside the stat row.
    local function startTicker(): ()
        if not (tick and featureConnections) then
            return
        end
        if featureConnections.ServerSettingsTick then
            return
        end
        featureConnections.ServerSettingsTick = tick:Connect(
            function(deltaTime: number): ()
                elapsed += math.max(0, deltaTime or 0)
                if elapsed < STAT_INTERVAL then
                    return
                end
                elapsed = 0
                refreshStats()
            end,
            nil,
            "Server Settings"
        )
    end

    local function copyJobId(): ()
        local id: string = jobId()
        if id == "" then
            say("This server has no Job ID to copy.")
            return
        end
        -- Executors expose `setclipboard` as a global; a plain Roblox client
        -- does not, so the message still carries the id when copying fails.
        local clipboard: any = host.setclipboard or setclipboard
        local copied: boolean = false
        if type(clipboard) == "function" then
            copied = pcall(clipboard, id)
        end
        if copied then
            say("Job ID copied: " .. id, "good")
        else
            say("Job ID: " .. id)
        end
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Server list
    ---------------------------------------------------------------

    -- One page of the public server list, as the Roblox web app reads it.
    -- `sortOrder` is what makes the difference between the quiet end and the
    -- busy end of the place; `cursor` walks further into the list.
    --
    -- v193: the request sends only `sortOrder`, `limit` and (for deeper pages)
    -- `cursor`. The client filters full instances itself, so it can also explain
    -- what it saw, and an unsupported query flag can no longer turn every hop
    -- into "the request failed".
    local function fetchPage(
        sortOrder: string,
        cursor: string?
    ): ({any}?, string?, string?)
        local endpoint: string = string.format(
            "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=%s&limit=100",
            game.PlaceId,
            sortOrder
        )
        if type(cursor) == "string" and cursor ~= "" then
            endpoint = endpoint .. "&cursor=" .. cursor
        end
        local ok: boolean, body: any = pcall(function(): any
            return (game :: any):HttpGet(endpoint)
        end)
        if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
            return nil, nil, "the server list request failed (executor HTTP is blocked?)"
        end
        local decodeOk: boolean, decoded: any = pcall(function(): any
            return httpService:JSONDecode(body)
        end)
        if not decodeOk or type(decoded) ~= "table" or type(decoded.data) ~= "table" then
            return nil, nil, "the server list answer could not be read"
        end
        local nextCursor: any = decoded.nextPageCursor
        return decoded.data, if type(nextCursor) == "string" then nextCursor else nil, nil
    end

    -- Every candidate the place publishes, up to MAX_PAGES per sort order.
    local function collectPool(orders: {string}): ({any}, number, string?)
        local here: string = jobId()
        local pool: {any} = {}
        local seen: {[string]: boolean} = {}
        local total: number = 0
        local lastError: string? = nil
        for _, order: string in ipairs(orders) do
            local cursor: string? = nil
            for _ = 1, MAX_PAGES do
                local page: {any}?, nextCursor: string?, errorText: string? =
                    fetchPage(order, cursor)
                if not page then
                    lastError = errorText
                    break
                end
                for _, entry: any in ipairs(page) do
                    total += 1
                    if type(entry) == "table"
                        and type(entry.id) == "string"
                        and entry.id ~= ""
                        and entry.id ~= here
                        and not seen[entry.id] then
                        seen[entry.id] = true
                        table.insert(pool, entry)
                    end
                end
                if not nextCursor then
                    break
                end
                cursor = nextCursor
            end
        end
        return pool, total, lastError
    end

    -- A server is a candidate only when it has a slot this client can take.
    -- `playing == maxPlayers` is a full instance: TeleportToPlaceInstance
    -- rejects it, which is why v191 hops often died silently.
    local function slotFree(entry: any): boolean
        local playing: number? = tonumber(entry and entry.playing)
        if not playing or playing < 0 then
            return false
        end
        local limit: number? = tonumber(entry and entry.maxPlayers)
        if limit and limit > 0 then
            return playing < limit
        end
        -- No limit published: treat anything under 100 as joinable.
        return playing < 100
    end

    local function playersIn(entry: any): number
        return tonumber(entry and entry.playing) or 0
    end

    local function joinablePool(entries: {any}): {any}
        local pool: {any} = {}
        for _, entry: any in ipairs(entries) do
            if slotFree(entry) then
                table.insert(pool, entry)
            end
        end
        return pool
    end

    local function pick(pool: {any}, mode: string): any
        if #pool == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        -- Empty instances are never "smallest": a 0/12 server answers no
        -- question the player asked and empties out again in seconds.
        local populated: {any} = {}
        for _, entry: any in ipairs(pool) do
            if playersIn(entry) >= 1 then
                table.insert(populated, entry)
            end
        end
        local candidates: {any} = if #populated > 0 then populated else pool
        if mode == "random" then
            return candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
        end
        local chosen: any = candidates[1]
        for index: number = 2, #candidates do
            local entry: any = candidates[index]
            if mode == "largest" then
                if playersIn(entry) > playersIn(chosen) then
                    chosen = entry
                end
            elseif playersIn(entry) < playersIn(chosen) then
                chosen = entry
            end
        end
        return chosen
    end

    local function hop(mode: string): ()
        if hopping then
            return
        end
        if os.clock() - lastHopAt < HOP_COOLDOWN then
            say("Slow down: wait a moment before hopping again.")
            return
        end
        hopping = true
        task.spawn(function(): ()
            local ok: boolean, failure: any = pcall(function(): ()
                -- Smallest prefers quiet end, largest prefers busy end; random checks both.
                local orders: {string}
                if mode == "largest" then
                    orders = {"Desc"}
                elseif mode == "random" then
                    orders = {"Asc", "Desc"}
                else -- smallest
                    orders = {"Asc"}
                end
                local entries: {any}, total: number, errorText: string? =
                    collectPool(orders)
                local pool: {any} = joinablePool(entries)
                local chosen: any = pick(pool, mode)
                lastHopAt = os.clock()
                if not chosen then
                    -- Nothing joinable in the list, but the player asked to hop:
                    -- Teleport(place) lets Roblox pick a server with room. That
                    -- always beats a notice that says "no server found" and
                    -- leaves the player where they were.
                    local reason: string = if total == 0
                        then tostring(errorText or "the server list is empty")
                        else string.format(
                            "all %d listed servers are full",
                            total
                        )
                    say("Server hop: " .. reason .. " · joining any server instead…", "danger")
                    local teleported: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
                        teleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
                    end)
                    if not teleported then
                        say("Server hop was refused by TeleportService.", "danger")
                    end
                    return
                end
                local playing: number = playersIn(chosen)
                local limit: number = tonumber(chosen.maxPlayers) or 0
                say(string.format(
                    "Hopping to the %s server: %d/%d players…",
                    mode,
                    playing,
                    if limit > 0 then limit else playing + 1
                ))
                local teleported: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
                    teleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(
                        game.PlaceId,
                        chosen.id,
                        LocalPlayer
                    )
                end)
                if not teleported then
                    say("Server hop was refused by TeleportService.", "danger")
                end
            end)
            hopping = false
            if not ok then
                say("Server hop failed: " .. tostring(failure), "danger")
            end
        end)
    end

    card = createUniversalFeature(
        "Server Settings",
        "Live server readout (Job ID, players, uptime, place) plus hops that only land on a server with a free slot.",
        8,
        function(enabled: boolean): ()
            -- The readout never stops: switching the card only refreshes it at
            -- once so the rows are current when the card is looked at.
            if enabled then
                elapsed = STAT_INTERVAL
                refreshStats()
            end
        end,
        {categoryName = "Utilities"}
    )
    activeCard = card

    addActionOption(card, "Copy Job ID", copyJobId)
    addActionOption(card, "Hop: smallest server", function(): ()
        hop("smallest")
    end)
    addActionOption(card, "Hop: largest server", function(): ()
        hop("largest")
    end)
    addActionOption(card, "Hop: random server", function(): ()
        hop("random")
    end)
    addInformationOption(
        card,
        "A Roblox client cannot change another server's settings. This card "
            .. "shows YOUR server, live, and moves you between public ones. "
            .. "A hop only lands where a slot is free; \"smallest\" skips empty "
            .. "instances and \"largest\" is the fullest server you can still "
            .. "join (e.g. 11/12). If every listed server is full, the hop joins "
            .. "a random one instead of failing."
    )

    ensureStatRows()
    refreshStats()
    startTicker()

    state.serverSettingsCard = card
    state.serverSettings = settings
    state.serverSettingsStats = statRows
    -- Readable by the offline suites: the hop decision is pure, and a test can
    -- check it without a live Roblox client.
    state.serverSettingsPick = function(entries: {any}, mode: string): string?
        local here: string = jobId()
        local filtered: {any} = {}
        for _, entry: any in ipairs(entries or {}) do
            if type(entry) == "table"
                and type(entry.id) == "string"
                and entry.id ~= here
                and slotFree(entry) then
                table.insert(filtered, entry)
            end
        end
        local chosen: any = pick(filtered, mode)
        return if chosen then tostring(chosen.id) else nil
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return card
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if not Module.Initialized then
        return
    end
    Module.Initialized = false
    if type(disconnectTicker) == "function" then
        pcall(disconnectTicker, "ServerSettingsTick")
    end
    state.serverSettingsCard = nil
    state.serverSettings = nil
    state.serverSettingsStats = nil
    state.serverSettingsPick = nil
    activeCard = nil
end

return Module

export type Runtime = {
    framework: any,
    entity: any,
    render: any,
    host: any,
    services: any,
}

-- v191: renamed from "Arrows" (the player asked for another name). Only the
-- visible label changed: the ConfigKey, the keybind and the saved state stay
-- "Universal.Arrows", so nothing has to be reconfigured. Its palette row in
-- Settings ("Buttons") now paints the window buttons too, the Pin chip
-- included.
local Module = {
    Name = "Player Pointers",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local activeCard: any = nil

function Module.init(context: Runtime): any
    local framework: any = context.framework
    local entity: any = context.entity
    local render: any = context.render
    local protectedTargets: any = context.services.protectedTargets
    local gameBridge: any = context.services.gameBridge
    local teamCheck: any = context.host.state and context.host.state.teamCheck
    local currentWorkspace: Workspace = context.host.workspace or workspace
    local layer: Frame = render:Layer("ArrowsLayer")
    local shown: {[Player]: boolean} = {}

    local function roleColour(player: Player): Color3?
        if gameBridge and type(gameBridge.playerRoleColor) == "function" then
            local ok: boolean, colour: any =
                pcall(gameBridge.playerRoleColor, player)
            if ok and typeof(colour) == "Color3" then
                return colour
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local card: any
    local function clear(): ()
        render:ReleaseAll(layer)
        table.clear(shown)
        layer.Visible = false
    end

    card = framework.Categories.Visuals:CreateModule({
        Name = "Player Pointers",
        Category = "Render",
        ConfigKey = "Universal.Arrows",
        Order = 3,
        Tooltip = "Points toward players outside the camera view.",
        Function = function(enabled: boolean): ()
            layer.Visible = enabled
            if not enabled then
                clear()
                card:SetStatus(nil)
                return
            end
            card:Render(function(): ()
                local camera: Camera? = currentWorkspace.CurrentCamera
                if not camera then
                    render:ReleaseAll(layer)
                    table.clear(shown)
                    return
                end
                local viewport: Vector2 = camera.ViewportSize
                local centre: Vector2 = Vector2.new(viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2)
                local radius: number = math.max(40, math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y) * 0.4)
                local seen: {[Player]: boolean} = {}
                local count: number = 0
                for _, target: any in ipairs(entity:Refresh()) do
                    local player: Player = target.Player
                    local friendly: boolean = target.IsFriendly
                    if not friendly
                        and teamCheck
                        and type(teamCheck.isSameTeam) == "function" then
                        friendly = teamCheck.isSameTeam(player)
                    end
                    if (not card.Options["Teammates"].Value and friendly)
                        or protectedTargets.isProtected(player)
                        or not target.Humanoid
                        or target.Humanoid.Health <= 0
                        or not target.RootPart
                        or target.Distance > card.Options["Max distance"].Value then
                        render:Release(layer, player)
                        continue
                    end
                    local projected: Vector3, onScreen: boolean =
                        camera:WorldToViewportPoint(target.RootPart.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        render:Release(layer, player)
                        continue
                    end
                    local drawing: any = render:Set(layer, player)
                    local delta: Vector2 = Vector2.new(projected.X, projected.Y) - centre
                    if projected.Z < 0 then
                        delta = Vector2.new(-delta.X, -delta.Y)
                    end
                    if delta.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                        delta = Vector2.new(0, -1)
                    end
                    local direction: Vector2 = delta.Unit
                    local perpendicular: Vector2 = Vector2.new(-direction.Y, direction.X)
                    local tip: Vector2 = centre + direction * radius
                    local back: Vector2 = tip - direction * 16
                    -- Colour priority: the game's role colour when roles are
                    -- known (green by default otherwise), then teammates in
                    -- their team colour while the team-colour option is on.
                    local roleColourForTarget: Color3? = roleColour(player)
                    local colour: Color3 = roleColourForTarget
                        or (card.Options["Team colours"].Value
                            and friendly
                            and player.Team
                            and player.Team.TeamColor.Color
                            or card.Options["Colour"].Value)
                    drawing:Line("Arrow", 1, tip, back + perpendicular * 8, 2, colour)
                    drawing:Line("Arrow", 2, tip, back - perpendicular * 8, 2, colour)
                    drawing:HideLines("Arrow", 3, 8)
                    if card.Options["Distance"].Value then
                        drawing:Label(
                            "Distance",
                            "[" .. tostring(math.round(target.Distance)) .. "]",
                            tip - direction * 26,
                            0.5,
                            12,
                            colour,
                            true
                        )
                    else
                        drawing:HideLabel("Distance")
                    end
                    drawing:Show(true)
                    seen[player] = true
                    count += 1
                end
                for player: Player in pairs(shown) do
                    if not seen[player] then
                        render:Release(layer, player)
                    end
                end
                shown = seen
                card:SetStatus(tostring(count))
            end)
            card:Clean(clear)
        end,
    })

    card:CreateColor({Name = "Colour", Default = Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 85), Tooltip = "Base arrow colour. Arrows use role colours instead whenever the game knows roles."})
    card:CreateToggle({Name = "Distance", Default = true})
    card:CreateSlider({Name = "Max distance", Min = 25, Max = 2000, Step = 25, Default = 500})
    card:CreateToggle({Name = "Teammates", Default = false, Tooltip = "Also point at teammates. The advanced team check decides who counts."})
    card:CreateToggle({Name = "Team colours", Default = false, Tooltip = "Teammates point in their Roblox team colour; everyone else keeps the base colour. Role colours always win."})

    activeCard = card
    Module.Initialized = true
    return card
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCard and activeCard.Enabled then
        activeCard:Toggle(false)
    end
    activeCard = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module
