    end

    local function openKeybinds(): ()
        if keybindsRecord then
            raiseOpen(keybindsRecord)
            rebuildKeybinds()
            return
        end
        local screen: Vector2 = viewport()
        local keybindRows: {{any}} = {
            {"Reset keybinds", nil, 26},
            {"Open menu", keyLabel(state.toggleKey.Name), 12},
        }
        for _, binding: any in pairs(state.shortcutBindings) do
            if binding.key and binding.key ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                table.insert(
                    keybindRows,
                    {featureLabel(tostring(binding.id)), binding.key.Name, 12}
                )
            end
        end
        keybindsRecord = configWindow("Keybinds", "Keybinds", {
            position = Vector2.new(screen.X - WINDOW_WIDTH * 2 - 32, 140),
            anchor = uiRecord and uiRecord.window,
            settingsSized = true,
            packRows = keybindRows,
        })
        keybindsList = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = keybindsRecord.window.body,
            Name = "KeybindList",
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            ZIndex = keybindsRecord.window.body.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: Frame
        create("UIListLayout", {
            Parent = keybindsList,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, WINDOW_GAP),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        })
        actionRow(keybindsRecord, 99, "Add", openAddKeybind)
        actionRow(keybindsRecord, 100, "Reset keybinds", function(): ()
            for _, binding: any in pairs(state.shortcutBindings) do
                binding.key = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
                persistBindingKey(binding)
                if binding.refresh then
                    binding.refresh()
                end
            end
            rebuildKeybinds()
            notify("keybinds reset")
        end)
        actionRow(keybindsRecord, 101, "Profiles…", openProfiles)
        rebuildKeybinds()
        raiseOpen(keybindsRecord)
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Mobile controls. Keybinds need a keyboard, so on a touch device the
    -- same slot opens the buttons page instead: every shortcut the menu
    -- exposes can be placed as an on-screen button and restyled (shape,
    -- colour, size, opacity) without editing the config by hand.
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    local buttonsRecord: any = nil
    local buttonsList: Frame? = nil
    local buttonsAddRecord: any = nil
    local buttonsAddList: Frame? = nil

    local function mobileCallbacks(binding: any): (() -> (), any)
        local hold: boolean = binding.hold == true
        local function press(): ()
            if type(binding.onPress) == "function" then
                binding.onPress()
            end
        end
        local function release(): ()
            if type(binding.onRelease) == "function" then
                binding.onRelease()
            end
        end
        local callback: () -> () = function(): ()
            if not hold then press() end
        end
        if not hold then
            return callback, nil
        end
        return callback, {
            isActive = function(): boolean return true end,
            onPress = press,
            onRelease = release,
        }
    end

    local function mobileUiOrNil(): any
        return state.mobileUi
    end

    local function buttonRow(
        parent: Frame,
        order: number,
        labelText: string,
        valueText: string,
        onClick: () -> ()
    ): TextButton
        local row: TextButton = (create("TextButton", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Parent = parent,
            Name = "ButtonRow_" .. labelText:gsub("%W", ""),
            Active = true,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            FontFace = CONTROL_FONT,
            LayoutOrder = order,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
            Text = "",
            ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: TextButton
        create("TextLabel", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Parent = row,
            Name = "Label",
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            FontFace = CONTROL_FONT,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0.6, -6, 1, 0),
            Text = labelText,
            TextColor3 = Theme.text,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1,
        })
        create("TextLabel", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Parent = row,
            Name = "Value",
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            FontFace = CONTROL_FONT,
            Position = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0.4, -8, 1, 0),
            Text = valueText,
            TextColor3 = Theme.textMuted,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1,
        })
        trackUiConnection(row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick))
        return row
    end

    local rebuildButtons: () -> () = function(): () end
    local openAddMobileButton: () -> () = function(): () end

    rebuildButtons = function(): ()
        local container: Frame? = buttonsList
        local ui: any = mobileUiOrNil()
        if not container or not ui then
            return
        end
        container:ClearAllChildren()
        local order: number = 1
        local placed: number = 0
        local ids: {string} = {}
        for id: string in pairs(ui.actions) do
            table.insert(ids, id)
        end
        table.sort(ids)
        for _, id: string in ipairs(ids) do
            local record: any = ui.actions[id]
            if record then
                placed += 1
                local shape: string = tostring(record.shape or "Square")
                buttonRow(
                    container,
                    order,
                    tostring(record.label),
                    tostring(record.shape),
                    function(): ()
                        ui.openEditor(record)
                    end
                )
                order += 1
            end
        end
        if placed == 0 then
            buttonRow(container, order, "No buttons yet", "tap Add button", function(): () end)
            order += 1
        end
        local defaults: any = ui.defaults and ui.defaults()
        if defaults then
            buttonRow(
                container,
                order,
                "Default shape",
                tostring(defaults.shape),
                function(): ()
                    local shapes: {string} = ui.shapes
                    local index: number = table.find(shapes, defaults.shape) or 1
                    defaults.shape = shapes[index % #shapes + 1]
                    queueConfigSave()
                    rebuildButtons()
                    notify("new buttons: " .. defaults.shape)
                end
            )
            order += 1
            buttonRow(
                container,
                order,
                "Default colour",
                tostring(defaults.color),
                function(): ()
                    local palette: {string} = ui.palette
                    local index: number = table.find(palette, string.upper(defaults.color)) or 1
                    defaults.color = palette[index % #palette + 1]
                    queueConfigSave()
                    rebuildButtons()
                    notify("new buttons: " .. defaults.color)
                end
            )
            order += 1
        end
        if buttonsRecord then
            buttonsRecord.resize()
        end
    end

    local function openButtons(): ()
        local ui: any = mobileUiOrNil()
        if not ui then
            notify("touch controls are not ready yet")
            return
        end
        if buttonsRecord then
            raiseOpen(buttonsRecord)
            rebuildButtons()
            return
        end
        local screen: Vector2 = viewport()
        buttonsRecord = configWindow("Buttons", "Buttons", {
            position = Vector2.new(screen.X - WINDOW_WIDTH * 2 - 32, 140),
            anchor = uiRecord and uiRecord.window,
            settingsSized = true,
            packRows = {{"Add button", nil, 26}, {"Reset buttons", nil, 26}},
        })
        buttonsList = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = buttonsRecord.window.body,
            Name = "ButtonList",
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            ZIndex = buttonsRecord.window.body.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: Frame
        create("UIListLayout", {
            Parent = buttonsList,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, WINDOW_GAP),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        })
        actionRow(buttonsRecord, 90, "Add button", openAddMobileButton)
        actionRow(buttonsRecord, 91, "Reset buttons", function(): ()
            ui.resetActions()
            rebuildButtons()
            notify("mobile buttons reset")
        end)
        rebuildButtons()
        raiseOpen(buttonsRecord)
    end

    openAddMobileButton = function(): ()
        local ui: any = mobileUiOrNil()
        if not ui then
            return
        end
        if buttonsAddRecord then
            raiseOpen(buttonsAddRecord)
            return
        end
        local screen: Vector2 = viewport()
        buttonsAddRecord = configWindow("ButtonAdd", "Add button", {
            position = Vector2.new(screen.X - WINDOW_WIDTH * 2 - 32, 200),
            anchor = buttonsRecord and buttonsRecord.window,
            settingsSized = true,
            packRows = {{"Tap an action to place its button", nil, 12}},
        })
        buttonsAddList = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = buttonsAddRecord.window.body,
            Name = "ButtonAddList",
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            ZIndex = buttonsAddRecord.window.body.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: Frame
        create("UIListLayout", {
            Parent = buttonsAddList,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, WINDOW_GAP),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        })
        local order: number = 1
        for id: string, binding: any in pairs(state.shortcutBindings) do
            local actionId: string = ui.actionId(id)
            if not ui.actions[actionId] then
                local label: string = featureLabel(tostring(id))
                buttonRow(buttonsAddList :: Frame, order, label, "place", function(): ()
                    local callback: () -> (), hold: any = mobileCallbacks(binding)
                    ui.place(actionId, label, callback, hold)
                end)
                order += 1
            end
        end
        if order == 1 then
            buttonRow(buttonsAddList :: Frame, order, "Every action already has a button", "", function(): () end)
        end
        buttonsAddRecord.resize()
        raiseOpen(buttonsAddRecord)
    end

    local windowsRecord: any = nil
    local windowsPanel: any = nil
    local windowOptions: {[string]: boolean} = {}

    local function openWindows(): ()
        local clickGui: any = state.clickGui
        if not windowsRecord then
            local screen: Vector2 = viewport()
            windowsRecord = configWindow("Windows", "Windows", {
                position = Vector2.new(screen.X - WINDOW_WIDTH * 3 - 44, 140),
                anchor = uiRecord and uiRecord.window,
                settingsSized = true,
                packRows = {{"Combat", "ON", 20}},
            })
            windowsPanel = panelFor(windowsRecord, "ClickGUI.Windows")
        end
        if clickGui and windowsPanel then
            for _, name: string in ipairs(clickGui.order or {}) do
                if not windowOptions[name] then
                    windowOptions[name] = true
                    local category: any = clickGui.categories[name]
                    addToggleOption(windowsPanel, name, category.window.userVisible ~= false, function(value: boolean): ()
                        category.window.userVisible = value
                        category.window:SetVisible(value and state.visible == true)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        raiseOpen(windowsRecord)
    end

    local function applySavedWindowVisibility(): boolean
        local clickGui: any = state.clickGui
        if not clickGui or type(clickGui.order) ~= "table" then
            return false
        end
        for _, name: string in ipairs(clickGui.order) do
            local category: any = clickGui.categories
                and clickGui.categories[name]
            if category and category.window then
                local optionKey: string = "ClickGUI.Windows."
                    .. tostring(name):gsub("%W", "")
                if configData.states[optionKey] == false then
                    category.window.userVisible = false
                    pcall(function(): ()
                        category.window:SetVisible(false)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    task.spawn(function(): ()

        for _ = 1, 15 do
            applySavedWindowVisibility()
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    local optionsRecord: any = nil

    local actionEntries: {any} = {}
    local actionIndex: {[string]: any} = {}
    local actionSequence: number = 0
    local refreshActionRows: () -> () = function(): () end

    state.wurstOptions = {
        RegisterAction = function(id: any, label: any, callback: any, options: any?): any
            local key: string = tostring(id)
            local configuration: any = options or {}
            local entry: any = actionIndex[key]
            if entry == nil then
                actionSequence += 1
                entry = {id = key, order = actionSequence}
                actionIndex[key] = entry
                table.insert(actionEntries, entry)
            end
            entry.label = tostring(label)
            entry.callback = callback
            entry.enabled = configuration.enabled ~= false
            entry.visible = configuration.visible ~= false
            entry.static = configuration.static == true
            if entry.handle == nil then
                local handle: any = {}
                function handle.SetLabel(text: any): ()
                    entry.label = tostring(text)
                    if entry.rowLabel and entry.rowLabel.Parent then
                        entry.rowLabel.Text = entry.label
                    end
                end
                function handle.SetEnabled(value: boolean): ()
                    entry.enabled = value == true
                    refreshActionRows()
                end
                function handle.SetVisible(value: boolean): ()
                    entry.visible = value == true
                    refreshActionRows()
                end
                function handle.Unregister(): ()
                    state.wurstOptions.UnregisterAction(entry.id)
                end
                entry.handle = handle
            end
            if configuration.shortcut == true
                and entry.shortcutBound ~= true
                and type(bindActionShortcut) == "function" then
                entry.shortcutBound = true
                bindActionShortcut(nil, "Action " .. key, entry.label, function(): ()
                    state.wurstOptions.InvokeAction(key)
                end)
            end
            refreshActionRows()
            return entry.handle
        end,
        UnregisterAction = function(id: any): boolean
            local key: string = tostring(id)
            local entry: any = actionIndex[key]
            if entry == nil then
                return false
            end
            actionIndex[key] = nil
            local at: number? = table.find(actionEntries, entry)
            if at then
                table.remove(actionEntries, at)
            end
            refreshActionRows()
            return true
        end,
        InvokeAction = function(id: any): boolean
            local entry: any = actionIndex[tostring(id)]
            if entry == nil
                or entry.enabled ~= true
                or entry.visible ~= true
                or type(entry.callback) ~= "function" then
                return false
            end
            local ok: boolean, failure: any = pcall(entry.callback)
            if not ok then
                warn("[Wurst] Action " .. tostring(id) .. ": " .. tostring(failure))
            end
            return ok
        end,
        List = function(): {string}
            local ids: {string} = {}
            for _, entry: any in ipairs(actionEntries) do
                table.insert(ids, entry.id)
            end
            return ids
        end,
    }

    refreshActionRows = function(): ()
        if not optionsRecord then
            return
        end
        local body: any = optionsRecord.window.body
        for _, child: Instance in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject")
                and child:GetAttribute("RegisteredAction") == true then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
        local packRows: {{any}} = {}
        for _, entry: any in ipairs(actionEntries) do
            if entry.visible then
                table.insert(packRows, {entry.label, nil, 26})
                if entry.static then

                    local label: TextLabel = (create("TextLabel", {
                        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                        Parent = body,
                        Name = "Static_" .. entry.id:gsub("%W", ""),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        FontFace = CONTROL_FONT,
                        LayoutOrder = entry.order,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
                        Text = "  " .. entry.label,
                        TextColor3 = Theme.textMuted,
                        TextSize = 14,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                        ZIndex = body.ZIndex + 1,
                    }) :: any) :: TextLabel
                    label:SetAttribute("RegisteredAction", true)
                    entry.rowLabel = label
                else
                    local row: TextButton = actionRow(
                        optionsRecord,
                        entry.order,
                        entry.label,
                        function(): ()
                            state.wurstOptions.InvokeAction(entry.id)
                        end
                    )
                    row:SetAttribute("RegisteredAction", true)
                    local rowLabel: any = row:FindFirstChild("Label")
                    entry.rowLabel = rowLabel
                    if not entry.enabled then
                        row.Active = false
                        if rowLabel then
                            rowLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.textMuted
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if optionsRecord.repack then
            optionsRecord.repack(packRows)
        end
        optionsRecord.resize()
    end

    local reinjectBusy: boolean = false
    local reinjectHandle: any = nil
    local function runReinject(): ()
        local function setReinjectLabel(text: string): ()
            if reinjectHandle then
                reinjectHandle.SetLabel(text)
            end
        end
        if reinjectBusy then
            return
        end
        local compiler: any = (getfenv() :: any).loadstring
        if type(compiler) ~= "function" then
            notify("reinject unavailable")
            return
        end
        reinjectBusy = true
        setReinjectLabel("Downloading…")
        local sourceUrls: {string} = {
            REPOSITORY_RAW_BASE .. "src/Wurst.lua",
            RUNTIME_SAFETY_SOURCE_URL,
        }
        local sourceOrError: any = nil
        local downloaded: boolean = false
        local downloadFailures: {string} = {}
        for _, candidateUrl: string in ipairs(sourceUrls) do
            local requestUrl: string = candidateUrl
                .. "?reinject=v3&v="
                .. SOURCE_STAMP
            local requestOk: boolean, bodyOrError: any = pcall(function(): string
                return (game :: any):HttpGet(requestUrl, true)
            end)
            local current: boolean = requestOk
                and type(bodyOrError) == "string"
                and #bodyOrError >= 1024
                and bodyOrError:find(RUNTIME_COMPATIBILITY_MARKER, 1, true) ~= nil
            if current then
                downloaded = true
                sourceOrError = bodyOrError
                break
            end
            table.insert(downloadFailures, tostring(bodyOrError))
        end
        if not downloaded then
            reinjectBusy = false
            setReinjectLabel("Reinject latest")
            notify("download failed")
            warn("[Wurst] Reinject download: "
                .. table.concat(downloadFailures, " | "))
            return
        end
        local compiled: any = nil
        local compileError: any = nil
        local compiledOk: boolean, compileResult: any, returnedError: any = pcall(
            compiler,
            sourceOrError,
            "@src/Wurst.lua"
        )
        if compiledOk then
            compiled = compileResult
            compileError = returnedError
        else
            compileError = compileResult
        end
        if type(compiled) ~= "function" then
            reinjectBusy = false
            setReinjectLabel("Reinject latest")
            notify("compile failed")
            warn("[Wurst] Reinject compile: " .. tostring(compileError))
            return
        end
        setReinjectLabel("Restarting…")
        task.defer(function(): ()
            local executed: boolean, executionError: any = xpcall(
                compiled,
                debug.traceback
            )
            if not executed then
                reinjectBusy = false
                setReinjectLabel("Reinject latest")
                warn("[Wurst] Reinject runtime: " .. tostring(executionError))
            end
        end)
    end

    local destructHandle: any = nil
    local function runDestruct(): ()
        if destructHandle then
            destructHandle.SetLabel("Removing…")
        end
        task.defer(function(): ()
            local destruct: any = state.destruct
            if type(destruct) ~= "function" then

                pcall(function(): ()
                    ScreenGui:Destroy()
                end)
                return
            end
            local ok: boolean, failure: any = pcall(destruct)
            if not ok then
                warn("[Wurst] Destruct: " .. tostring(failure))
                pcall(function(): ()
                    ScreenGui:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function runResetLayout(): ()

        configData.ui.windows = {}
        queueConfigSave()
        for _, window: any in ipairs(windows.list or {}) do
            window.userMoved = nil
        end
        if state.clickGui and state.clickGui.Retile then
            state.clickGui.Retile()
        end
        for _, window: any in ipairs(windows.list or {}) do
            if window.featureSettings or window.managementWindow then
                if window.root.Visible and windows.PlaceWindow then
                    windows.PlaceWindow(window, {force = true})
                else
                    window.stalePlacement = true
                end
            end
        end
        for _, record: any in ipairs(Settings.records) do
            if not record.window.root.Visible then
                record.placed = false
            end
        end
        notify("layout reset")
    end

    local recognised: string = GAME_CHECK.MM2Active and "MM2"
        or GAME_CHECK.TRSActive and "TRS"
        or GAME_CHECK.VDActive and "VD"
        or GAME_CHECK.BedFightActive and "BedFight"
        or "Universal only"

    reinjectHandle = state.wurstOptions.RegisterAction(
        "Reinject", "Reinject latest", runReinject
    )
    destructHandle = state.wurstOptions.RegisterAction(
        "Destruct", "Destruct", runDestruct
    )
    state.wurstOptions.RegisterAction("ResetLayout", "Reset layout", runResetLayout)

    local _ = recognised

    local function openWurstOptions(): ()
        if optionsRecord then
            raiseOpen(optionsRecord)
            return
        end
        local screen: Vector2 = viewport()
        optionsRecord = configWindow("WurstOptions", "Wurst Options", {
            position = Vector2.new(screen.X - WINDOW_WIDTH * 2 - 32, 220),
            anchor = uiRecord and uiRecord.window,
            settingsSized = true,
            packRows = {{"Reinject latest", nil, 26}},
        })
        refreshActionRows()
        raiseOpen(optionsRecord)
    end

    local screen: Vector2 = viewport()
    -- Small build watermark on the window the user opens first: the build
    -- number alone so a screenshot says which build it is.
    -- v192: the player asked for "0.191", not "Version 0.191", and for that
    -- number to be the SAME one the product line prints as "0.191 Release".
    -- Both now come from host.BUILD_LABEL, i.e. from SOURCE_STAMP: one stamp,
    -- every label.
    local versionTag: string = tostring(host.BUILD_LABEL or (function(): string
        local buildNumber: string? = string.match(
            tostring(SOURCE_STAMP or ""),
            "^v(%d+)"
        )
        return if buildNumber then "0." .. buildNumber else "0.0"
    end)())
    uiRecord = configWindow("UISettings", "UI Settings · " .. versionTag, {
        position = Vector2.new(screen.X - WINDOW_WIDTH - 12, 64),
        closable = false,
        settingsSized = false,
        packRows = {
            {"HackList", nil, 26},
            {state.isMobile and "Buttons" or "Keybinds", nil, 26},
            {"Windows", nil, 26},
            {"WurstOptions", nil, 26},
            {"Background", "#404040"},
            {"Accent", "#101010"},
            {"Text", "#F0F0F0"},
            {"Opacity", "0.85"},
        },
    })
    uiRecord.open = true

    actionRow(uiRecord, 1, "HackList", openHackList)
    -- A phone has no keyboard: the row that would open keybinds opens the
    -- touch-button page instead. Desktop keeps the keybinds window untouched.
    if state.isMobile then
        actionRow(uiRecord, 2, "Buttons", openButtons)
    else
        actionRow(uiRecord, 2, "Keybinds", openKeybinds)
    end
    actionRow(uiRecord, 3, "Windows", openWindows)
    actionRow(uiRecord, 4, "WurstOptions", openWurstOptions)

    local uiPanel: any = panelFor(uiRecord, "ClickGUI")

    uiPanel.optionCount = 4

    local uiSettingsValues: {[string]: any} = {}
    state.uiSettings = uiSettingsValues

    -- Palette defaults come from the LIVE theme so the swatches always show
    -- what the UI is actually drawing (the old constants drifted from the
    -- real preset and misled the colour pickers).
    local CLICKGUI_ENABLED: Color3 = Theme.enabled
    -- Theme.arrows is a v26 token: older saved themes (and the default
    -- "Wurst" preset before v26.1) never wrote it. Missing token must
    -- never abort this page — fall back to the enabled colour.
    local CLICKGUI_ARROWS: Color3 = Theme.arrows or Theme.enabled
        or Color3.fromRGB(0, 204, 0)
    local uiPaletteRows: {[string]: Frame} = {}
    local function paintPalette(labelText: string, color: Color3): ()
        local option: Frame? = uiPaletteRows[labelText]
        if not option then
            return
        end
        local bar: Frame? = option:FindFirstChild("ColorBar") :: Frame?
        local hex: TextLabel? = option:FindFirstChild("HexValue") :: TextLabel?
        if bar then
            bar.BackgroundColor3 = color
        end
        if hex then
            hex.Text = string.format(
                "#%02X%02X%02X",
                math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5),
                math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5),
                math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)
            )
        end
    end
    -- A single bad palette row (missing theme token, malformed saved
    -- colour) must never kill the whole Settings window — v26 regressed
    -- exactly here when Theme.arrows was nil and hexOf(nil) aborted
    -- SettingsPage.init before the "Show dock" toggle could restore the
    -- saved dock state. Isolate the rows and keep building the page.
    local PALETTE_ROWS: {any} = {
        {label = "Background", default = Theme.background, tokens = {"surface", "background"}},
        {label = "Accent", default = Theme.accent, tokens = {"accent", "outline"}},
        {label = "Text", default = Theme.text, tokens = {"text", "accentText"}},
        {label = "Enabled", default = Theme.enabled, tokens = {"enabled"}},
        -- v191: this row is the "Arrows" token, but it now also paints the
        -- window buttons (the Pin chip uses it too), so it is labelled
        -- "Buttons". `key` keeps the v26 config key so a saved colour
        -- is not lost by the rename.
        {label = "Buttons", key = "Arrows", default = Theme.arrows, tokens = {"arrows"}},
    }
    -- Re-apply the saved palette when the page builds: the theme starts
    -- from the preset on every execution, so without this the chosen
    -- colours were forgotten on rejoin and the UI came back with preset
    -- colours while the swatches still showed the saved ones.
    if ThemeEngine and type(ThemeEngine.SetMany) == "function" then
        for _, row: any in ipairs(PALETTE_ROWS) do
            local saved: Color3? = colorFromConfig(
                configData.values[
                    uiPanel.configKey .. "."
                        .. (row.key or row.label):gsub("%W", "")
                ],
                nil
            )
            if saved then
                local updates: {[string]: Color3} = {}
                for _, token: string in ipairs(row.tokens) do
                    updates[token] = saved
                end
                ThemeEngine.SetMany(updates)
            end
        end
    end
    local paletteOk: boolean, paletteError: string? = pcall(function(): ()
        for _, row: any in ipairs(PALETTE_ROWS) do
            local tokens: {string} = row.tokens
            local labelText: string = row.label
            local swatch: TextButton? = addColorOption(
                uiPanel,
                labelText,
                row.default or Theme.text,
                function(color: Color3): ()
                    uiSettingsValues[labelText] = color

                    if ThemeEngine and type(ThemeEngine.SetMany) == "function" then
                        local updates: {[string]: Color3} = {}
                        for _, token: string in ipairs(tokens) do
                            updates[token] = color
                        end
                        ThemeEngine.SetMany(updates)
                    elseif ThemeEngine and type(ThemeEngine.Set) == "function" then
                        for _, token: string in ipairs(tokens) do
                            ThemeEngine.Set(token, color)
                        end
                    end
                end,
                row.key
            )
            if swatch and swatch.Parent and swatch.Parent:IsA("Frame") then
                uiPaletteRows[labelText] = swatch.Parent :: Frame
            end
        end
    end)
    if not paletteOk then
        warn("[Wurst:Settings] palette rows skipped: " .. tostring(paletteError))
    end

    addNumberOption(uiPanel, "Opacity", OPACITY, 0.15, 1, function(value: number): ()
        local wanted: number = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or OPACITY, 0.15, 1)
        uiSettingsValues["Opacity"] = wanted
        -- v191: background only. windows.SetOpacity fades the panel surface;
        -- the title, labels, icons and controls stay at full opacity.
        windows.SetOpacity(wanted)
    end, "How see-through the menu BACKGROUND is. Text and controls stay fully readable at any value.", 0.01, true)

    uiSettingsValues["Tooltip opacity"] = TOOLTIP_OPACITY
    if state.featureTooltip then
        state.featureTooltip.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - TOOLTIP_OPACITY
    end

    uiSettingsValues["Max height"] = MAX_HEIGHT
    state.uiMaxHeight = MAX_HEIGHT
    uiSettingsValues["Max settings height"] = MAX_SETTINGS_HEIGHT
    maxSettingsHeight = MAX_SETTINGS_HEIGHT
    state.uiMaxSettingsHeight = MAX_SETTINGS_HEIGHT

    uiSettingsValues["Menu style"] = "Wurst"

    -- v162: the menu's own scale, so "make it like the older build" is a
    -- number and not a code change. It only touches the ClickGui UIScale; the
    -- HUD, the dock and the tooltips keep their own sizes.
    local themeShape: any = ThemeEngine and ThemeEngine.shape
    local initialScale: number = themeShape and tonumber(themeShape.scale) or 1
    uiSettingsValues["Menu scale"] = initialScale
    -- Dragging this used to run a full relayout on every single step, so the
    -- menu flickered and the windows piled on top of each other mid-drag.
    -- v181: the UIScale follows the slider immediately, and the reflow (reclamp
    -- every window into the new logical viewport) runs once the drag settles.
    local scaleReflowToken: number = 0
    addNumberOption(uiPanel, "Menu scale", initialScale, 0.7, 1.3,
        function(value: number): ()
            local shape: any = ThemeEngine and ThemeEngine.shape
            if not shape then
                return
            end
            local wanted: number = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 1, 0.7, 1.3)
            shape.scale = wanted
            uiSettingsValues["Menu scale"] = wanted
            configData.values["UI.MenuScale"] = wanted
            queueConfigSave()
            if state.clickGui and type(state.clickGui.ApplyScale) == "function" then
                state.clickGui.ApplyScale()
            end
            scaleReflowToken += 1
            local token: number = scaleReflowToken
            task.delay(0.15, function(): ()
                if token ~= scaleReflowToken then
                    return
                end
                if type(state.refreshLayout) == "function" then
                    state.refreshLayout(true)
                end
            end)
        end, "Adjust the size of menu windows on this device.", 0.01, true)

    addToggleOption(uiPanel, "Keep after teleport", true, function(value: boolean): ()
        uiSettingsValues["Keep after teleport"] = value
        local persist: any = state.teleportPersist
        if persist and type(persist.SetEnabled) == "function" then
            persist.SetEnabled(value)
            if value and persist.supported ~= true then
                notify("queue on teleport unavailable — "
                    .. "the menu cannot follow teleports here")
            end
        end
    end)

    local touchPrimary: boolean = state.isMobile == true
    if not touchPrimary then
        addToggleOption(uiPanel, "Show dock", false, function(value: boolean): ()
            uiSettingsValues["Show dock"] = value
            state.uiShowDock = value
            if state.dock and type(state.dock.SetVisible) == "function" then
                state.dock.SetVisible(value)
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Dock placement is a touch affordance; desktop does not need this action.
    if touchPrimary then
        host.addActionOption(uiPanel, "Move dock", function(): ()
            if state.dock and state.dock.BeginMove then state.dock.BeginMove() end
        end, "Drag and release the dock to save its position.")
    end

    uiRecord.placed = true
    if windows.ReflowWindow then
        windows.ReflowWindow(uiRecord.window)
    end

    if state.bitmapText and type(state.bitmapText.onReady) == "table" then
        table.insert(state.bitmapText.onReady, function(): ()
            for _, record: any in ipairs(Settings.records) do
                if record.repack then
                    record.repack()
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    state.addMenuVisibilityListener(function(visible: boolean): ()
        for _, record: any in ipairs(Settings.records) do
            if not visible and record.window.pinned then
                continue
            end
            if visible then
                record.window:SetVisible(record.open)
            else
                record.open = record.window.root.Visible
                record.window:SetVisible(false)
            end
        end
    end)
    for _, record: any in ipairs(Settings.records) do
        record.window:SetVisible(state.visible == true and record.open)
    end

    Settings.ui = uiRecord
    Settings.openKeybinds = openKeybinds
    Settings.openProfiles = openProfiles
    Settings.openHackList = openHackList
    Settings.openWurstOptions = openWurstOptions

    activeCleanup = function(): ()
        for _, record: any in ipairs(Settings.records) do
            pcall(function(): ()
                record.window:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        Settings.records = {}
        for _, connection: RBXScriptConnection in ipairs(Settings.connections) do
            pcall(function(): ()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        Settings.connections = {}
        state.uiSettings = nil
        state.wurstOptions = nil
    end
    Module.Initialized = true
    return Settings
end

function Module.destroy(): ()
    if activeCleanup then
        pcall(activeCleanup)
    end
    activeCleanup = nil
    Module.Initialized = false
end

return Module

export type OptionDefinition = {
    kind: string,
    label: string,
    default: any?,
    minimum: number?,
    maximum: number?,
    values: {string}?,
    callback: any,
    persist: boolean?,
}

export type FeatureDefinition = {
    name: string,
    description: string,
    order: number,
    onToggle: any,
    configuration: any?,
    options: {OptionDefinition}?,
}

export type WidgetLibrary = {
    addToggleOption: any,
    addActionOption: any,
    addNumberOption: any,
    addRangeOption: any,
    addCycleOption: any,
    addKeyOption: any,
    addTextOption: any,
    addColorOption: any,
    addListOption: any,
    addSectionOption: any,
    addInformationOption: any,
    setOptionVisible: any,
}

local Module = {
    Name = "Widgets",
    PlaceId = 0,
    Events = {} :: {[string]: any},
    Initialized = false,
}

local boundState: any = nil
local toggleThemeRefreshers: {() -> ()} = {}

local function runToggleThemeRefreshers(changed: any): ()
    for _, refresh: any in ipairs(toggleThemeRefreshers) do
        pcall(refresh, changed)
    end
end

local LABEL_FONT_SIZE: number = 16
local SLIDER_BAR_HEIGHT: number = 6
local SLIDER_KNOB_WIDTH: number = 16
local SLIDER_KNOB_HEIGHT: number = 16

local CHILD_INSET: number = 4
local CHILD_GAP: number = 4

function Module.init(context: any): WidgetLibrary

    local WURST_GREEN: Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 204, 0)
    local host: any = context

    local UserInputService: any = host.UserInputService
    local state: any = host.state
    boundState = state
    table.clear(toggleThemeRefreshers)
    if state then
        state.optionThemeRefresh = runToggleThemeRefreshers
        -- Other UI modules (card bind squares, window chrome) register their
        -- repainters here so palette changes reach everything on screen.
        state.registerThemeRefresh = function(refresh: any, tokens: {string}?): ()
            table.insert(toggleThemeRefreshers, function(changed)
                if tokens and changed then
                    local relevant = false
                    for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do if changed[token] then relevant = true; break end end
                    if not relevant then return end
                end
                refresh()
            end)
        end
        -- Live-apply registry for option VALUES (sliders, colours, cycles,
        -- text). Profiles and the panic reset drive the whole UI through it
        -- instead of only rewriting the saved config.
        state.valueControls = {}
    end
    local configData: any = host.configData
    local queueConfigSave: any = host.queueConfigSave
    local create: any = host.create
    local makeButton: any = host.makeButton
    local makeTextBox: any = host.makeTextBox

    local function flatTextBox(parent: Instance, initial: any): TextBox
        local box: TextBox = (makeTextBox(parent, initial) :: any) :: TextBox
        local corner: UICorner? = box:FindFirstChild("StyleCorner") :: UICorner?
        if corner then
            corner:Destroy()
        end
        return box
    end
    local makeTextLabel: any = host.makeTextLabel
    local notify: any = host.notify
    local Theme: any = host.Theme
    local ThemeEngine: any = host.ThemeEngine
    local CONTROL_FONT: any = host.CONTROL_FONT
    local ScreenGui: any = host.ScreenGui

    local PopupLayer: any = host.PopupLayer
    local trackUiConnection: any = host.trackUiConnection
    local applyKeySlotStyle: any = host.applyKeySlotStyle
    local beginKeyCapture: any = host.beginKeyCapture
    local bindActionShortcut: any = host.bindActionShortcut
    local runActionButton: any = host.runActionButton
    local colorFromConfig: any = host.colorFromConfig
    local colorToConfig: any = host.colorToConfig

    local function drawPixelIcon(
        parent: Instance,
        kind: string,
        color: Color3?,
        token: string?
    ): Frame
        local themed: boolean = token ~= nil
            and ThemeEngine ~= nil
            and Theme[token or ""] ~= nil
        local paint: Color3 = (themed and Theme[token :: string])
            or color
            or WURST_GREEN
        local existing: Instance? = (parent :: any):FindFirstChild("PixelIcon")
        if existing and existing:GetAttribute("PixelKind") == kind
            and existing:GetAttribute("PixelToken") == (token or "") then
            if not themed then
                for _, pixel in ipairs(existing:GetChildren()) do
                    if pixel:IsA("Frame") then pixel.BackgroundColor3 = paint end
                end
            end
            return existing :: Frame
        end
        if existing then existing:Destroy() end
        local sizes: {[string]: {number}} = {
            down = {14, 8},
            up = {14, 8},
            right = {8, 14},
            cross = {10, 10},
            pin = {10, 10},
            check = {12, 10},
        }
        local size: {number} = sizes[kind] or {10, 10}
        local container: Frame = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = parent,
            Name = "PixelIcon",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size[1], size[2]),
            ZIndex = (tonumber((parent :: any).ZIndex) or 1) + 1,
        }) :: any) :: Frame
        local function px(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number): ()
            local pixel: any = create("Frame", {
                Parent = container,
                BackgroundColor3 = paint,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x * 2, y * 2),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w * 2, h * 2),
                ZIndex = container.ZIndex + 1,
            })
            if themed then
                -- Token binding; Destroying removes obsolete pixels from the registry.
                ThemeEngine.Bind(pixel, "BackgroundColor3", token :: string)
            end
        end
        container:SetAttribute("PixelKind", kind)
        container:SetAttribute("PixelToken", token or "")
        if kind == "down" then
            px(0, 0, 7, 1); px(1, 1, 5, 1); px(2, 2, 3, 1); px(3, 3, 1, 1)
        elseif kind == "up" then
            px(3, 0, 1, 1); px(2, 1, 3, 1); px(1, 2, 5, 1); px(0, 3, 7, 1)
        elseif kind == "right" then
            px(0, 0, 1, 7); px(1, 1, 1, 5); px(2, 2, 1, 3); px(3, 3, 1, 1)
        elseif kind == "cross" then
            px(0, 0, 1, 1); px(4, 0, 1, 1)
            px(1, 1, 1, 1); px(3, 1, 1, 1)
            px(2, 2, 1, 1)
            px(1, 3, 1, 1); px(3, 3, 1, 1)
            px(0, 4, 1, 1); px(4, 4, 1, 1)
        elseif kind == "pin" then
            px(1, 0, 3, 3); px(2, 3, 1, 2)
        elseif kind == "check" then
            px(0, 2, 1, 1); px(1, 3, 1, 1); px(2, 4, 1, 1)
            px(3, 3, 1, 1); px(4, 2, 1, 1); px(5, 1, 1, 1)
        end
        return container
    end

    state.layoutOptionControl = function(
        option: Frame,
        control: GuiObject,
        widthScale: number?
    ): ()
        local top: number = tonumber(option:GetAttribute("ControlTop")) or 0
        local height: number = tonumber(option:GetAttribute("ControlHeight"))
            or option.Size.Y.Offset

        local scale: number = widthScale or 0.5
        control.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
        control.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, top)
        control.Size = UDim2.new(scale, -10, 0, height)
        control.ZIndex = math.max(control.ZIndex, option.ZIndex + 2)
    end

    local function createOptionRow(
        feature: any,
        labelText: string,
        _hintText: string?
    ): Frame
        feature.optionCount += 1
        feature.searchText ..= " " .. string.lower(labelText)
        local rowHeight: number = state.layout.optionRowHeight

        local option: Frame = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = feature.options,
            Name = "Option_" .. labelText:gsub("%W", ""),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = feature.optionCount,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight),
            ZIndex = feature.options.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: Frame
        table.insert(feature.optionRows, option)

        local label: TextLabel = (create("TextLabel", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Parent = option,
            Name = "OptionLabel",
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            FontFace = CONTROL_FONT,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(CHILD_INSET, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0.55, -CHILD_INSET, 0, rowHeight),
            Text = labelText,
            TextColor3 = Theme.text,
            TextSize = LABEL_FONT_SIZE,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: TextLabel
        label.Visible = true

        option:SetAttribute("ControlTop", 3)
        option:SetAttribute("ControlHeight", rowHeight - 6)

        feature.updateExpandedSize()
        return option
    end

    -- A real heading, not an invisible spacer: a capitalised caption with a
    -- hairline that runs to the right edge. Every card can group its rows
    -- without inventing its own label and drifting from the rest.
    state.addSectionOption = function(feature: any, titleText: string): Frame
        feature.optionCount += 1
        local section: Frame = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = feature.options,
            Name = "Section_" .. titleText:gsub("%W", ""),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = feature.optionCount,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, state.layout.sectionRowHeight or 22),
            Visible = true,
            ZIndex = feature.options.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: Frame
        local caption: TextLabel = (create("TextLabel", {
            Parent = section,
            Name = "SectionLabel",
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            FontFace = CONTROL_FONT,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(CHILD_INSET, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -CHILD_INSET * 2, 0, section.Size.Y.Offset),
            Text = string.upper(titleText),
            TextColor3 = Theme.textMuted,
            TextSize = 10,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = section.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: TextLabel
        caption:SetAttribute("SectionTitle", titleText)
        -- The divider sits after the caption, so long titles never overlap it.
        create("Frame", {
            Parent = section,
            Name = "SectionLine",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.outline,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.55,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 4 + math.clamp(#string.upper(titleText) * 7 + 8, 24, 220), 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -(4 + math.clamp(#string.upper(titleText) * 7 + 8, 24, 220)) - 4, 0, 1),
            ZIndex = section.ZIndex,
        })
        section:SetAttribute("SectionTitle", titleText)
        table.insert(feature.optionRows, section)
        feature.updateExpandedSize()
        return section
    end

    state.addStatOption = function(
        feature: any,
        labelText: string,
        initialValue: string?
    ): any
        local option: Frame = createOptionRow(feature, labelText, nil)
        local optionLabel: TextLabel? =
            option:FindFirstChild("OptionLabel") :: TextLabel?
        if optionLabel then
            (optionLabel :: TextLabel).Size =
                UDim2.new(0.62, -CHILD_INSET, 1, 0);
            (optionLabel :: TextLabel).TextColor3 = Theme.textMuted
        end
        local valueLabel: TextLabel = (create("TextLabel", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Parent = option,
            Name = "StatValue",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            FontFace = CONTROL_FONT,
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -CHILD_INSET, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -CHILD_INSET, 1, 0),
            Text = tostring(initialValue or "0"),
            TextColor3 = Theme.text,
            TextSize = LABEL_FONT_SIZE,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 2,
        }) :: any) :: TextLabel
        local lastText: string = tostring(initialValue or "0")
        return {
            row = option,
            label = valueLabel,
            -- v160: modules refresh their stat rows from a per-frame task. A
            -- Text assignment re-runs the label layout, so writing the same
            -- string 60 times a second was pure waste. Only a change is
            -- written now; the first call always goes through.
            set = function(newText: string): ()
                local nextText: string = tostring(newText)
                if nextText == lastText then
                    return
                end
                lastText = nextText
                if valueLabel and valueLabel.Parent then
                    valueLabel.Text = nextText
                end
            end,
        }
    end

    local function setOptionVisible(
        feature: any,
        option: GuiObject,
        visible: boolean
    ): ()
        -- Hiding the options container itself empties the whole card: every row
        -- disappears and nothing can bring them back except a rebuild. Callers
        -- that pass a control instead of its row hit exactly that, so the
        -- container is never a valid target.
        if option == nil or option == feature.options then
            warn("[Random Testing Menu] setOptionVisible refused the options container")
            return
        end
        -- addToggleOption/addCycleOption return the control inside the row while
        -- addNumberOption/addRangeOption return the row itself. Both are valid
        -- arguments, so the row is resolved here and only ever that row is
        -- hidden.
        local row: GuiObject = option
        local parent: any = option.Parent
        local container: any = feature.options
        if container ~= nil
            and parent ~= nil
            and parent ~= container
            and parent.Parent ~= nil
            and parent.Parent == container then
            row = parent
        end
        row.Visible = visible
        feature.updateExpandedSize()
    end

    local function addToggleOption(
        feature: any,
        labelText: string,
        defaultValue: boolean,
        callback: (boolean) -> (),
        hintText: string?,
        bindable: boolean?
    ): TextButton
        local optionKey: string =
            feature.configKey .. "." .. labelText:gsub("%W", "")
        local enabled: boolean? = configData.states[optionKey]
        if enabled == nil then
            enabled = defaultValue == true
        end

        local option: Frame = createOptionRow(feature, labelText, hintText)
        local button: TextButton = create("TextButton", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = option,
            Name = "OptionClickTarget",
            Active = true,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            Text = "",
            ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 2,
        }) :: TextButton

        local box: Frame = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = option,
            Name = "OptionCheckbox",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, CHILD_INSET, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
            ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 3,
        }) :: any) :: Frame

        local boxStroke: UIStroke = (create("UIStroke", {
            Parent = box,
            ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
            Color = Theme.outline,
            Thickness = 1,
            Transparency = 0.35,
        }) :: any) :: UIStroke

        -- The checkmark contrasts with the Enabled colour (which fills the
        -- box), so it stays visible whatever palette the user picks.
        local function markContrast(color: Color3): Color3
            local luminance: number =
                0.299 * color.R + 0.587 * color.G + 0.114 * color.B
            if luminance > 0.45 then
                return Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 12)
            end
            return Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 247)
        end
        local mark: Frame = drawPixelIcon(
            box,
            "check",
            markContrast(Theme.enabled or WURST_GREEN)
        )
        mark.Visible = false

        local function paintMark(): ()
            local paint: Color3 =
                markContrast(Theme.enabled or WURST_GREEN)
            for _, pixel: any in ipairs(mark:GetChildren()) do
                pcall(function(): ()
                    pixel.BackgroundColor3 = paint
                end)
            end
        end
        local optionLabel: TextLabel? =
            option:FindFirstChild("OptionLabel") :: TextLabel?
        if optionLabel then
            (optionLabel :: TextLabel).Position =
                UDim2.fromOffset(CHILD_INSET + 22 + CHILD_GAP, 0);
            (optionLabel :: TextLabel).Size =
                UDim2.new(1, -(CHILD_INSET + 22 + CHILD_GAP), 1, 0)
        end

        local function refreshOptionState(): ()
            local on: boolean = enabled :: boolean
            box.BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.enabled or Theme.surface
            box.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.5
            boxStroke.Color = on and Theme.enabled or Theme.outline
            paintMark()
            mark.Visible = on
        end

        -- Palette changes must repaint existing checkboxes, not only the
        -- ones toggled afterwards.
        table.insert(toggleThemeRefreshers, refreshOptionState)

        local function toggleOption(): ()
            if not option.Visible then return end
            enabled = not enabled
            refreshOptionState()
            configData.states[optionKey] = enabled
            callback(enabled :: boolean)
            queueConfigSave()
            notify(labelText .. ((enabled :: boolean) and " enabled" or " disabled"))
        end
        if bindable then
            -- Use the same persisted/capture-aware shortcut path as actions.
            -- Keyboard and touch toggle the checkbox, callback and saved value
            -- together; a key slot must not be swallowed by the row hit target.
            button.Size = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 1, 0)
            if optionLabel then
                optionLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.72, -(CHILD_INSET + 22 + CHILD_GAP), 1, 0)
            end
            local keyButton: TextButton = makeButton(option, "KEY", 9)
            keyButton.Name = "OptionKeybind"
            state.layoutOptionControl(option, keyButton, 0.24)
            keyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.74, -16, keyButton.Position.Y.Scale, keyButton.Position.Y.Offset)
            keyButton.ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 5
            applyKeySlotStyle(keyButton)
            keyButton.TextScaled = true
            create("UITextSizeConstraint", {Parent = keyButton, MaxTextSize = 14, MinTextSize = 8})
            bindActionShortcut(keyButton, feature.configKey .. labelText, labelText, toggleOption)
        end
        trackUiConnection(button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleOption))

        -- Programmatic state sync (e.g. a card master switch turning its
        -- sub-options off). Mirrors the listControls pattern: the visual, the
        -- persisted state and the module callback all move together.
        state.toggleControls = state.toggleControls or {}
        state.toggleControls[optionKey] = {
            -- The live checkbox, so callers (and the boot tests) can read the
            -- option without assuming what its default was.
            getChecked = function(): boolean
                return enabled :: boolean
            end,
            setChecked = function(checked: boolean): ()
                if not button.Parent then
                    return
                end
                local wanted: boolean = checked == true
                if wanted == (enabled :: boolean) then
                    return
                end
                enabled = wanted
                refreshOptionState()
                configData.states[optionKey] = enabled
                callback(enabled :: boolean)
                queueConfigSave()
            end,
        }

        refreshOptionState()
        callback(enabled :: boolean)
        return button
    end
    local function addActionOption(
        feature: any,
        labelText: string,
        callback: () -> (),
        hintText: string?,
        interaction: any?
    ): TextButton
        local option = createOptionRow(feature, labelText, hintText)
        local button = makeButton(option, interaction and interaction.hold and "HOLD" or "RUN", 11)
        button.BackgroundColor3 = state.guiStyle == "Default"
            and Theme.buttonHover
            or Theme.accentSoft

        state.layoutOptionControl(option, button, 0.26)
        local function executeAction(): ()
            if not option.Visible then return end
            runActionButton(
                button,
                "RUN",
                callback,
                labelText .. " completado",
                "[Random Testing Menu] " .. labelText
            )
        end
        local hold: boolean = interaction ~= nil and interaction.hold == true
        local held = {button = false, shortcut = false}
        local active: boolean = false
        local buttonInput: InputObject? = nil
        local function setHeld(source: string, value: boolean): ()
            if value and not option.Visible then return end
            held[source] = value
            local wanted: boolean = held.button or held.shortcut
            if active == wanted then return end
            active = wanted
            button.Text = wanted and "HELD" or "HOLD"
            if wanted then callback()
            elseif interaction and interaction.onRelease then interaction.onRelease() end
        end
        if hold then
            trackUiConnection(button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject): ()
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    if buttonInput == nil then buttonInput = input; setHeld("button", true) end
                end
            end))
            trackUiConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject): ()
                if input == buttonInput or (buttonInput and buttonInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                    buttonInput = nil
                    setHeld("button", false)
                end
            end))
            trackUiConnection(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function(): ()
                held.button = false
                buttonInput = nil
                setHeld("shortcut", false)
            end))
        else
            trackUiConnection(button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(executeAction))
        end
        local shortcutButton: TextButton =
            (makeButton(option, "KEY", 9) :: any) :: TextButton
        shortcutButton.BackgroundColor3 = state.guiStyle == "Default"
            and Theme.button
            or Theme.surfaceRaised

        state.layoutOptionControl(option, shortcutButton, 0.24)
        shortcutButton.Position = UDim2.new(
            0.74,
            -16,
            shortcutButton.Position.Y.Scale,
            shortcutButton.Position.Y.Offset
        )
        applyKeySlotStyle(shortcutButton)
        shortcutButton.TextScaled = true
        create("UITextSizeConstraint", {
            Parent = shortcutButton,
            MaxTextSize = 14,
            MinTextSize = 8,
        })
        bindActionShortcut(
            shortcutButton,
            feature.configKey .. labelText,
            labelText,
            hold and function(): () setHeld("shortcut", true) end or executeAction,
            hold and {hold = true, onRelease = function(): () setHeld("shortcut", false) end} or nil
        )
        return button :: TextButton
    end

    type ActiveSlider = {
        update: (number) -> (),
        finish: () -> (),
    }

    local activeSlider: ActiveSlider? = nil

    trackUiConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(
        input: InputObject
    ): ()
        if activeSlider
            and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            activeSlider.update(input.Position.X)
        end
    end))

    trackUiConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(
        input: InputObject
    ): ()
        if activeSlider
            and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local slider: ActiveSlider = activeSlider
            activeSlider = nil
            slider.finish()
        end
    end))

    -- Accepts all real numbers including +/- math.huge so sliders can
    -- express "infinite" (e.g. Fullbright Brightness = inf → white screen).
    local function isNumber(value: any): boolean
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value
    end

    local function formatCompactNumber(value: number): string
        if value == math.huge then return "inf" end
        if value == -math.huge then return "-inf" end
        local magnitude: number = math.abs(value)
        if magnitude >= 1e9 or (magnitude > 0 and magnitude < 1e-4) then
            return string.format("%.3e", value)
        end
        return string.format("%.12g", value)
    end

    -- When a slider's maximum is infinite, the linear position formula
    -- (value-min)/(max-min) collapses to 0 for every finite value. Use a
    -- practical display cap so the knob still moves, while the actual
    -- value (and any typed infinity) passes through untouched.
    local function effectiveMax(minimum: number, maximum: number): number
        if maximum ~= math.huge then return maximum end
        return math.max(100, math.abs(minimum) * 10)
    end

    -- Parse text-box input that may contain infinity keywords.
    local function parseNumericText(text: string): number?
        local cleaned = string.lower(text:gsub("%s+", ""))
        if cleaned == "inf" or cleaned == "infinity" or cleaned == "+inf" then
            return math.huge
        end
        if cleaned == "-inf" or cleaned == "-infinity" then
            return -math.huge
        end
        return tonumber(text)
    end

    local function addNumberOption(
        feature: any,
        labelText: string,
        defaultValue: number,
        minimum: number,
        maximum: number,
        callback: (number) -> (),
        hintText: string?,
        stepValue: number?,
        boundTyped: boolean?
    ): Frame
        local optionKey: string =
            feature.configKey .. "." .. labelText:gsub("%W", "")
        local storedValue: number? = tonumber(configData.values[optionKey])

        -- The interval is normally just a drag guide, not a limit on typed or
        -- profile values. UI controls may explicitly opt into bounded input.
        local value: number = isNumber(storedValue)
            and (storedValue :: number)
            or defaultValue
        if boundTyped then
            if value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then value = defaultValue end
            value = math.clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
        end
        local integerOnly: boolean = defaultValue % 1 == 0
            and minimum % 1 == 0
            and maximum % 1 == 0

        local option: Frame = createOptionRow(feature, labelText, hintText)

        option.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
        feature.updateExpandedSize()
        local headerLabel: TextLabel? =
            option:FindFirstChild("OptionLabel") :: TextLabel?
        if headerLabel then
            (headerLabel :: TextLabel).Size =
                UDim2.new(0.55, -CHILD_INSET, 0, 22)
        end

        local requestedStep: number? = tonumber(stepValue)
        if requestedStep ~= nil and requestedStep <= 0 then
            requestedStep = nil
        end

        local step: number = requestedStep or (integerOnly and 1 or 0.01)
        local precisionFactor: number = 1
        for _ = 1, 6 do
            if math.abs(step * precisionFactor - math.round(step * precisionFactor)) < 1e-7 then
                break
            end
            precisionFactor *= 10
        end

        option:SetAttribute("Min", minimum)
        option:SetAttribute("Max", maximum)
        option:SetAttribute("Step", step)
        option:SetAttribute("FreeNumeric", true)

        local slider: TextButton = (create("TextButton", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Parent = option,
            Name = "Slider",
            Active = true,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
            Text = "",
            ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: TextButton

        local minText: string = formatCompactNumber(minimum)
        local maxText: string = formatCompactNumber(maximum)

        local bitmapContract: any = state.bitmapText
        local function endLabelWidth(endText: string): number
            if bitmapContract and type(bitmapContract.measure) == "function" then
                return bitmapContract.measure({{text = endText}}, 14) + 4
            end
            return #endText * 11 + 4
        end
        local minWidth: number = endLabelWidth(minText)
        local maxWidth: number = endLabelWidth(maxText)
        create("TextLabel", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Parent = slider,
            Name = "MinLabel",
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            FontFace = CONTROL_FONT,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, CHILD_INSET, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, minWidth, 1, 0),
            Text = minText,
            TextColor3 = Theme.textMuted,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 1,
        })
        create("TextLabel", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Parent = slider,
            Name = "MaxLabel",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            FontFace = CONTROL_FONT,
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -CHILD_INSET, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, maxWidth, 1, 0),
            Text = maxText,
            TextColor3 = Theme.textMuted,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 1,
        })

        local track: Frame = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = slider,
            Name = "Track",
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(
                0,
                CHILD_INSET + minWidth + CHILD_GAP,
                0,
                (22 - SLIDER_BAR_HEIGHT) // 2
            ),
            Size = UDim2.new(
                1,
                -(CHILD_INSET * 2 + minWidth + maxWidth + CHILD_GAP * 2),
                0,
                SLIDER_BAR_HEIGHT
            ),
            ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: Frame

        local fill: Frame = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = track,
            Name = "Fill",
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.accent,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
            ZIndex = track.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: Frame

        local knob: Frame = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = track,
            Name = "Knob",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.text,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SLIDER_KNOB_WIDTH, SLIDER_KNOB_HEIGHT),
            ZIndex = track.ZIndex + 2,
        }) :: any) :: Frame

        local valueInput: TextBox = (flatTextBox(slider, "") :: any) :: TextBox
        valueInput.Name = "NumericValue"
        valueInput.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
        valueInput.Position = UDim2.new(1, -CHILD_INSET, 0, -22)
        valueInput.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 0, 22)
        valueInput.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        valueInput.TextColor3 = Theme.textMuted
        valueInput.TextSize = LABEL_FONT_SIZE
        valueInput.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        valueInput.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        valueInput.ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 2
        local valueStroke: UIStroke? =
            valueInput:FindFirstChild("StyleStroke") :: UIStroke?
        if valueStroke then
            (valueStroke :: UIStroke).Transparency = 1
        end

        valueInput.PlaceholderText = boundTyped
            and (formatCompactNumber(minimum) .. "–" .. formatCompactNumber(maximum))
            or "Any number (type inf for infinity)"

        local editing: boolean = false

        local function quantize(raw: number, fromSlider: boolean): number
            if not fromSlider then
                -- Most gameplay sliders intentionally accept values outside
                -- their drag range. Bounded UI controls opt in explicitly so
                -- the displayed/saved value matches what they can apply.
                return boundTyped and math.clamp(raw, minimum, maximum) or raw
            end
            -- When maximum is infinite, skip the upper clamp and stepping
            -- so an infinity typed or dragged in passes through untouched.
            if maximum == math.huge then
                if raw < minimum then raw = minimum end
                return raw
            end
            raw = math.clamp(raw, minimum, maximum)
            local stepped: number = minimum
                + math.round((raw - minimum) / step) * step
            stepped = math.round(stepped * precisionFactor) / precisionFactor
            return math.clamp(stepped, minimum, maximum)
        end
        local function setValue(
            nextValue: number,
            persist: boolean,
            _fromSlider: boolean
        ): ()
            if not isNumber(nextValue) then
                return
            end
            -- Infinity is only valid when the slider explicitly opts in
            -- by having an infinite maximum (e.g. Fullbright Brightness).
            -- On finite-range sliders like Speed, reject it so a typed
            -- "inf" or "1e999" does not corrupt the previous value.
            if (nextValue == math.huge or nextValue == -math.huge)
                and maximum ~= math.huge then
                return
            end
            value = quantize(nextValue, _fromSlider)
            -- When the slider maximum is infinite, use the display cap
            -- so the knob still moves for finite values. Infinity itself
            -- snaps the knob to the far right.
            local sliderMax: number = effectiveMax(minimum, maximum)
            local alpha: number = sliderMax == minimum
                and 0
                or math.clamp((value - minimum) / (sliderMax - minimum), 0, 1)
            fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
            knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 0.5)
            if not editing then
                valueInput.Text = formatCompactNumber(value)
            end
            callback(value)
            if persist then
                configData.values[optionKey] = value
                queueConfigSave()
            end
        end

        local function updateFromScreenX(screenX: number, origin: number, width: number): ()
            local alpha: number = math.clamp((screenX - origin) / width, 0, 1)
            setValue(minimum + (effectiveMax(minimum, maximum) - minimum) * alpha, true, true)
        end

        if state.valueControls then
            state.valueControls[optionKey] = {
                apply = function(stored: any): ()
                    setValue(tonumber(stored) or defaultValue, true)
                end,
                default = defaultValue,
            }
        end

        trackUiConnection(slider.InputBegan:Connect(function(
            input: InputObject
        ): ()
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                return
            end
            if input.Position.X > track.AbsolutePosition.X + track.AbsoluteSize.X then
                return
            end
            -- Rescaling the menu moves the track under the pointer. Keep the
            -- starting screen interval fixed for the duration of this drag.
            local dragOrigin: number = track.AbsolutePosition.X
            local dragWidth: number = math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
            local function updateDrag(screenX: number): ()
                updateFromScreenX(screenX, dragOrigin, dragWidth)
            end
            updateDrag(input.Position.X)
            activeSlider = {
                update = updateDrag,
                finish = function(): ()
                    notify(
                        labelText
                            .. ": "
                            .. formatCompactNumber(value)
                    )
                end,
            }
        end))

        trackUiConnection(valueInput.Focused:Connect(function(): ()
            editing = true
            valueInput.Text = tostring(value)
            valueInput.CursorPosition = #valueInput.Text + 1
        end))

        trackUiConnection(valueInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(): ()
            local parsed: number? = parseNumericText(valueInput.Text)
            editing = false
            if not isNumber(parsed) then
                valueInput.Text = formatCompactNumber(value)
                notify(labelText .. ": invalid numeric value")
                return
            end
            setValue(parsed :: number, true, false)
            notify(labelText .. ": " .. formatCompactNumber(value))
        end))

        task.defer(function(): ()
            if option.Parent then
                -- Migrate stale out-of-range UI values too; gameplay controls
                -- deliberately leave their old open-range profiles intact.
                local corrected: boolean = boundTyped == true and storedValue ~= nil
                    and storedValue ~= value
                setValue(value, corrected, false)
            end
        end)
        return option
    end

    state.addRangeOption = function(
        feature: any,
        labelText: string,
        definition: any
    ): Frame
        local minimum: number = tonumber(definition.min) or 0
        local maximum: number = tonumber(definition.max) or 100
        local baseKey: string =
            feature.configKey .. "." .. labelText:gsub("%W", "")
        local storedLow: number? = tonumber(configData.values[baseKey .. ".Low"])
        local storedHigh: number? = tonumber(configData.values[baseKey .. ".High"])

        local low: number = isNumber(storedLow)
            and (storedLow :: number)
            or tonumber(definition.defaultLow)
            or minimum
        local high: number = isNumber(storedHigh)
            and (storedHigh :: number)
            or tonumber(definition.defaultHigh)
            or maximum
        if low > high then
            low, high = high, low
        end
        local integerOnly: boolean = definition.integer ~= false

        local option: Frame = createOptionRow(feature, labelText, definition.hint)

        option.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
        feature.updateExpandedSize()
        local rangeLabel: TextLabel? =
            option:FindFirstChild("OptionLabel") :: TextLabel?
        if rangeLabel then
            (rangeLabel :: TextLabel).Size =
                UDim2.new(0.55, -CHILD_INSET, 0, 22)
        end
        local slider: TextButton = (create("TextButton", {
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Parent = option,
            Name = "RangeSlider",
            Active = true,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
            Text = "",
            ZIndex = option.ZIndex + 1,
        }) :: any) :: TextButton

        local track: Frame = (create("Frame", {
            Parent = option,
            Name = "Track",
